title: Construction of core@shell NiCo2S4@conductive polythiophene nanocone arrays on carbon cloth for high-performance supercapacitors
abstract: In recent years, flexible and portable supercapacitor devices have become a focus of attention in the field of energy storage. However, challenges in the selection and preparation of appropriate electrode materials remain. The hierarchical constructing of conducting polymer@transition metal sulfide composites on the flexible carbon cloth substrate is an effective strategy to achieve high-performance supercapacitors. In here, highly conductive polythiophene (Pth) nanocone arrays are hierarchically constructed on the NiCo 2 S 4 (NCS) coated carbon fiber cloth (CC). The modification of NCS electrode surface with conductive polythiophene (Pth) layer (about 6.21 S/cm) is based on a facile dip-coating process. This facile process allows the formation a conductive polythiophene (Pth) layer on the NCS nanoneedles by protecting porous NCS morphology. Pth shell not only increases the conductivity of NCS electrode but also alleviates agglomeration during charge-discharge process. The synergistic effect between NCS and Pth improves the capacitive characteristics of electrode. Compared to NCS@CC and Pth@CC electrodes, NCS@Pth(0.3)@CC composite electrode exhibits a superior specific capacitance (1632.8 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 of current density) and an outstanding retention stability (90.1 % after 5000 cycles). These impressive results emphasize the potential of the newly developed hybrid structure as a high-performance electrode material for electrochemical devices.

title: Interfacial Hydrogen Bond Engineering: Enabling Rapid 3D Assembly of MXene Thick Electrodes with High Mass Loading and Fast Charge Transport
institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
abstract: Abstract Micro‐supercapacitors (MSCs) hold great promise for powering next‐generation microelectronics. However, their practical deployment remains severely hindered by low areal energy densities (≤100 µWh cm − 2 ) under constrained footprints (<1 cm 2 )—primarily due to the challenges in constructing 3D thick electrodes with high mass loading and efficient charge transport. Herein, a scalable and cost‐effective strategy is presented for fabricating MXene‐based 3D thick electrodes (>2400 µm) by intensifying interfacial hydrogen‐bond interactions between oxygen plasma‐activated carbon felt and Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene nanosheets. This interfacial engineering approach drives the rapid and robust self‐assembly of MXene flakes into a hierarchically porous, low‐tortuosity architecture while transforming the carbon felt into a multifunctional 3D conductive framework—simultaneously enhancing structural integrity, charge carrier mobility, and post‐fabrication processability. The resulting ultra‐thick electrodes abandon inactive binder/additives and fully exploit the vertical space, maximizing active material utilization. When paired with MnO 2 nanowires/carbon nanotube hybrid cathodes, MSCs with the demonstrated MXene‐based thick anodes achieve a 2.3 V output and a high areal energy density of 818 µWh cm − 2 . This work overcomes the long‐standing trade‐off between electrode thickness and charge transport kinetics in thick electrodes and establishes a versatile framework for architecting high‐energy‐density MSCs, advancing the development of integrated microelectronics for the futu …

title: 3D Printing of Supercapacitors: Progress in Materials, Architectures, and Devices
abstract: Abstract Advances in flexible electronics are driving a growing demand for supercapacitors with arbitrary shapes and customized functions. Conventional fabrication methods struggle to meet these requirements, whereas 3D printing offers precise, rapid, and cost‐effective manufacturing of complex architectures with broad material compatibility. This review provides a comprehensive overview of recent progress in 3D printing for supercapacitor applications. Four prevalent techniques, including direct ink writing, fused deposition modeling, inkjet printing, and vat photopolymerization are first examined, highlighting their operating principles, processing characteristics, and suitability for energy storage devices. Next, representative device architectures, including sandwich‐type, interdigitated, and fiber‐shaped configurations are discussed. Printable electrodes, electrolytes, and integrated strategies for achieving fully printed supercapacitors are then critically analyzed. Finally, current challenges are outlined and future research directions proposed, with the aim of advancing high‐performance 3D‐printed supercapacitors for next‐generation energy storage.
zh_title: 超级电容器的 3D 打印：材料、架构和设备的进展
zh_abstract: 摘要 柔性电子技术的进步正在推动对具有任意形状和定制功能的超级电容器不断增长的需求。传统的制造方法很难满足这些要求，而 3D 打印可以精确、快速、经济高效地制造具有广泛材料兼容性的复杂结构。本综述全面概述了超级电容器应用 3D 打印的最新进展。首先检查了四种流行的技术，包括直接墨水书写、熔融沉积建模、喷墨打印和还原光聚合，重点介绍了它们的工作原理、加工特性以及对储能设备的适用性。接下来，讨论了代表性的器件架构，包括三明治型、叉指型和纤维状配置。然后对可印刷电极、电解质和实现完全印刷超级电容器的集成策略进行严格分析。最后，概述了当前的挑战并提出了未来的研究方向，旨在推进用于下一代储能的高性能 3D 打印超级电容器。

abstract: Graphene aerogel (GA) is characterized by its 3D interconnected conductive network, ultra-high specific surface area, and exceptional chemical stability, and has emerged as the preferred skeleton material for supercapacitors. However, the double-layer mechanism that exclusively relies on physical ion adsorption presents challenges in further enhancing its specific capacitance. Fortunately, cobalt (Co) exhibits multiple valence states and possesses a high theoretical specific capacitance. This characteristic not only enhances the capacity for ion adsorption on its surface but also introduces redox-active sites, thereby significantly contributing to the achievement of high pseudocapacitance. In this study, we successfully synthesized Co/nitrogen (N) co-doped graphene aerogel (Co-NGA) by a one-step hydrothermal co-doping strategy. By leveraging the coordination capability of N atoms within the graphene lattice, the atomic-level dispersion and stable anchoring of Co atoms were achieved. The synergistic effect resulting from the combination of a porous structure and Co/N co-doping endows this aerogel with outstanding electrochemical performance in supercapacitor applications. At a current density of 1 A/g, the specific capacitance of 5.6%Co-NGA achieves an impressive value of 2092 F/g, significantly surpassing that of NGA (390 F/g) and GA (239 F/g). Furthermore, an asymmetric supercapacitor assembled using 5.6%Co-NGA and activated carbon (AC) demonstrates great energy storage capabilities. title: Tunable transition metal oxide/carbon aerogel catalysts: Insights into oxygen reduction and supercapacitor performance
abstract: Transition metal oxide (TMO)-based catalysts are crucial for various applications in which energy is stored and converted due to their unique properties and functionality. Herein, carbon aerogel (CA) with unique properties as a catalyst support material was first prepared. Then, six different transition metal oxide catalysts (CoO/CA, NiO/CA, MnO/CA, ZnO/CA, CuO/CA, Fe 2 O 3 /CA) were synthesized by the chemical co-precipitation method. The structural and morphological properties of these different TMO/CA catalysts are reported. Electrochemical studies of the synthesized catalysts revealed promising performance in both oxygen reduction catalysis and charge storage. Notably, MnO/CA demonstrated the most favorable results for oxygen reduction, achieving a diffusion-limited current density of −2.47 mA cm −2 at 1600 rpm with an electron transfer number of 3.4. Furthermore, MnO/CA exhibited excellent stability during chronoamperometric tests, showing high current density retention and no significant morphological or structural changes as confirmed by SEM and Raman analysis before and after the test. When evaluating charge-storage capabilities, ZnO/CA emerged as the top-performer, displaying a specific capacitance of 295 F g −1 at a current load of 1 A g −1 . ZnO/CA also demonstrated remarkable stability, with its capacitance increasing with extended cycling. After 1000 cycles, the specific capacitance reached 132% of its initial value, highlighting its robust nature for energy storage applications.

title: Systematic review on 3D printed solid-state supercapacitors: Insights on printing techniques, materials, device performance, and architectures
abstract: The ongoing demand for miniaturized, portable, lightweight, wearable, and structural energy storage has annunciated solid-state supercapacitors as an integral technology, primarily based on their fast charge-discharge rates, high power densities, wide operating temperature range, and enduring cyclic stability. Solid-state or quasi-solid-state electrolytes have assisted in resolving typical drawbacks of aqueous and organic electrolytes (leakage, toxicity, etc.) and endowed desired mechanical properties (e.g., stiffness, flexibility, stretchability, durability) to supercapacitor devices, thus advancing the development of wearable consumer electronics and medical applications alike. These recent trends coupled with the emerging additive manufacturing technology (widely known as 3D printing) are steering the field of supercapacitor technology into new directions, enabling rapid prototyping and low-cost fabrication of supercapacitors with non-traditional form factors, utilizing various nanomaterials in composites (filaments, resins, and inks) and applying solid-state electrolytes with versatility. 3D printing techniques in device fabrication have included direct ink writing (DIW), fused filament deposition (FFF), stereolithography (SLA), and digital light processing (DLP). This systematic review summarizes the latest developments on 3D-printed solid-state supercapacitors, elaborating on the various additive technologies employed so far and highlighting their advantages and disadvantages. title: Integrated Design of Nickel‐Based Coordination Compound Size Control and 3D Printing to Construct Ordered Micro‐Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid development of micro supercapacitors requires electrode materials that possess both high redox activity and structural robustness. Nickel‐based coordination compounds are promising candidate materials, but their practical applications are hindered by the intense volume fluctuations and lattice strain during repeated redox reactions. The 1D coordination structure has inherent characteristics such as providing directional mechanical buffering and continuous charge transfer channels, which can effectively alleviate the above problems. However, the disordered arrangement of 1D structures in traditional electrode structures weakens their inherent advantages. Therefore, we successfully synthesized a series of printable 1D fibrous nickel‐based coordination compounds of different lengths using 4‐chlorosalicylate ligands that can transition from chelation dominant to carboxyl/hydroxyl bridged coordination mode. Utilizing 3D printing technology, we have fabricated NCS3@CNT@GO//MXene micro‐devices with an ordered layered structure. The specific capacitance of this device reached 381.36 mF cm −2 , and the energy density was 52.97 µWh cm −2 . Compared with the disordered NCS2@CNT@GO//MXene (273.84 mF cm −2 ) and NCS4@CNT@GO//MXene (337.44 mF cm −2 ), its specific capacitance increased by 39.2% and 13%, respectively, indicating that the ordered structure has an advantage in improving electrochemical performance. This work provides a universal approach for designing structured programmable electrodes suitable for micro energy storage.
zh_title: 镍基配位化合物尺寸控制与3D打印集成设计构建有序微型超级电容器
zh_abstract: 摘要 微型超级电容器的快速发展需要兼具高氧化还原活性和结构坚固性的电极材料。镍基配位化合物是有前途的候选材料，但其实际应用受到重复氧化还原反应过程中强烈的体积波动和晶格应变的阻碍。一维配位结构具有提供定向机械缓冲和连续电荷传输通道等固有特性，可以有效缓解上述问题。然而，传统电极结构中一维结构的无序排列削弱了其固有的优势。因此，我们使用4-氯水杨酸酯配体成功合成了一系列不同长度的可打印一维纤维状镍基配位化合物，可以从螯合主导模式转变为羧基/羟基桥配位模式。利用3D打印技术，我们制造了具有有序层状结构的NCS3@CNT@GO//MXene微器件。该器件的比电容达到381.36 mF cm -2 ，能量密度为52.97 µWh cm -2 。与无序的NCS2@CNT@GO//MXene（273.84 mF cm -2 ）和NCS4@CNT@GO//MXene（337.44 mF cm -2 ）相比，其比电容分别增加了39.2%和13%，表明有序结构在提高电化学性能方面具有优势。这项工作为设计适用于微能量存储的结构化可编程电极提供了一种通用方法。

title: Integrated design of electrospun cellulose-based 3D Co and CNT inserted porous carbon materials for supercapacitor and HER
abstract: Based on the features of cellulose-based carbon materials, integrating metal–organic framework (MOF) and polymers in cellulose is in favor of the electrochemical performance for supercapacitor and hydrogen evolution reaction (HER). In this work, a three dimensional (3D) porous carbon material inserted by carbon nanotubes (CNT) and Co particles was designed by an electrospinning and calcination technology. During the calcination process, MOF-74 as both nanocatalysts and carbon sources was converted to CNT and Co particles, meanwhile, CA-PVDF fibrous membranes were pyrolyzed into the porous carbon, leading to the novel multilevel structures and specific C/Co component. The type (PAN, PVDF, PVP) and mass ratio (0:1, 1:2, 2:1, 1:0) of polymers were optimized to improve the electrochemical performance. As a result, due to the rich defects from CNT, the high specific areas caused by PVDF, as well as the specific activity of Co particles, the high specific capacitance of 169.50 F g −1 was obtained at 0.5 A g −1 for CAF(2:1)CT within -1.0–0 V. CAF(2:1)C showed acceptable HER catalytic activity. Additionally, an asymmetric solid-state supercapacitor (CAF(2:1)C//CAF(2:1)CT) was built and delivered a high energy density of 25.69 Wh kg −1 , a superb cycling life during 10000 cycles, as well as a necessary practicality in circuit. This work proposed a novel hybrid biomass based carbon material, which can provide a reference for the design of electrode materials and catalysts in other fields.
zh_title: 用于超级电容器和HER的电纺纤维素基3D Co和CNT插入多孔碳材料的集成设计
zh_abstract: 基于纤维素基碳材料的特点，将金属有机骨架（MOF）和聚合物集成到纤维素中，有利于超级电容器和析氢反应（HER）的电化学性能。在这项工作中，通过静电纺丝和煅烧技术设计了一种由碳纳米管（CNT）和Co颗粒插入的三维（3D）多孔碳材料。在煅烧过程中，MOF-74作为纳米催化剂和碳源转化为CNT和Co颗粒，同时CA-PVDF纤维膜热解成多孔碳，产生新颖的多级结构和特定的C/Co组分。对聚合物的类型（PAN、PVDF、PVP）和质量比（0:1、1:2、2:1、1:0）进行优化，以提高电化学性能。结果，由于CNT的丰富缺陷、PVDF引起的高比面积以及Co粒子的比活性，CAF(2:1)CT在-1.0–0 V内于0.5 A g -1 时获得了169.50 F g -1 的高比电容。CAF(2:1)C表现出可接受的HER催化活性。此外，还构建了非对称固态超级电容器（CAF(2:1)C//CAF(2:1)CT），并具有25.69 Wh kg -1 的高能量密度、10000次循环的优异循环寿命以及必要的电路实用性。该工作提出了一种新型杂化生物质基碳材料，可为其他领域的电极材料和催化剂的设计提供参考。

title: Multiscale modelling of supercapacitors with hierarchical structure
abstract: Structural supercapacitors (SSCs) are a class of multifunctional composites that simultaneously provide load-carrying and energy storage capacities. This paper presents a physics-based continuum multiscale electrochemical model aimed at understanding the influence of design decisions on the electrochemical performance of mechanically robust supercapacitors (SCs). The approach was exemplified by considering carbon aerogel-modified carbon fibre-reinforced multifunctional electrodes in a room-temperature ionic liquid (RTIL) electrolyte. The new pseudo 4D (P4D) multiscale model integrates a 3D macroscopic dynamic model to solve the charge transport while coupling a 1D microscopic equilibrium electric double layer (EDL) model to determine the local voltage-dependent double layer capacitance of the porous structural electrode. The numerical model was evaluated to simulate the conventional electrochemical device characterisation methods: cyclic voltammetry, galvanostatic charging and discharging, and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. The model achieved prediction errors below 10 % for specific energy and capacitance, and around 20 % for specific power. Additionally, an asymmetrical electrochemical behaviour was predicted on the symmetric cell, exhibiting an unbalanced potential window and capacitance at the negative and positive electrodes. Overall, the proposed P4D multiscale electrochemical model provides a powerful tool for analysing, developing, and optimising SSCs and more general SCs with porous electrodes.
zh_title: 具有分层结构的超级电容器的多尺度建模
zh_abstract: 结构超级电容器（SSC）是一类多功能复合材料，可同时提供承载和储能能力。本文提出了一种基于物理的连续多尺度电化学模型，旨在了解设计决策对机械坚固的超级电容器（SC）电化学性能的影响。该方法通过考虑室温离子液体（RTIL）电解质中的碳气凝胶改性碳纤维增强多功能电极来举例说明。新的伪4D（P4D）多尺度模型集成了3D宏观动态模型来解决电荷传输问题，同时耦合1D微观平衡双电层（EDL）模型来确定多孔结构电极的局部电压相关双层电容。评估数值模型以模拟传统的电化学器件表征方法：循环伏安法、恒电流充电和放电以及电化学阻抗谱。该模型的比能量和电容预测误差低于 10%，比功率预测误差约为 20%。此外，还预测对称电池会出现不对称的电化学行为，在负极和正极处表现出不平衡的电位窗口和电容。总体而言，所提出的 P4D 多尺度电化学模型为分析、开发和优化 SSC 以及具有多孔电极的更通用的 SC 提供了强大的工具。

title: An Electric Field‐Enhanced Ultrahigh Energy Density Micro‐Supercapacitors Printed by High Precision Maskless Photolithography
institutions: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
East China University of Science and Technology
abstract: Abstract Micro‐supercapacitors (MSCs) are crucial for powering micro‐electromechanical systems (MEMS) and microelectronic devices due to their miniature size and high energy storage capacity. However, the achievement of printable high‐energy‐density MSCs with smaller size is still challenging. Herein, high‐precision (2 µm) maskless lithography is utilized on Submicron (SU‐8) photoresist successfully printing an ultrahigh energy density MSCs on silicon substrates with an effective electrode area of only 0.01 mm 2 . By incorporating the design of bent electrodes, the electric field strength between electrodes is greatly enhanced and leads to the improvements of device performance. The fabricated MSCs exhibit an unprecedently high area‐specific capacitance of up to 2.13 mF cm −2 at a scan rate of 10 mV s −1 , and excellent cyclic stability with the MSCs retaining 91.7% of their capacitive properties after 4000 cycles. Moreover, the MSCs achieve an ultrahigh energy density of 218 µWh cm −2 , surpassing both traditional carbon‐based MSCs and various hybrid MSCs. This work is expected to promote the broader application of MSCs in MEMS technology and microelectronic devices.
zh_title: 高精度无掩模光刻印刷电场增强超高能量密度微型超级电容器
zh_abstract: 摘要 微型超级电容器（MSC）由于其微型尺寸和高能量存储容量，对于为微机电系统（MEMS）和微电子设备供电至关重要。然而，实现更小尺寸的可打印高能量密度间充质干细胞仍然具有挑战性。在此，利用高精度（2 µm）无掩模光刻技术在亚微米（SU-8）光刻胶上成功地在硅基板上印刷了超高能量密度的MSC，有效电极面积仅为0.01 mm 2 。通过结合弯曲电极的设计，电极之间的电场强度大大增强，从而提高了器件性能。所制造的 MSC 在 10 mV s -1 的扫描速率下表现出前所未有的高面积比电容，高达 2.13 mF cm -2 ，并且具有出色的循环稳定性，MSC 在 4000 次循环后仍保留 91.7% 的电容特性。此外，MSC实现了218 µWh cm -2 的超高能量密度，超过了传统的碳基MSC和各种混合MSC。这项工作有望促进MSC在MEMS技术和微电子器件中更广泛的应用。

title: Sustainable electrospun carbon fibre electrodes from dealkaline lignin: Towards enhanced energy storage in supercapacitors
abstract: Pursuing advanced materials from renewable sources is critical to achieving sustainable development goals. In this study, we report, for the first time, the use of dealkaline lignin as a precursor for electrospun carbon nanofibers, addressing the challenges posed by the variability of lignin sources and extraction methods on carbon fibre properties. High-surface-area carbon nanofibers were synthesised via electrospinning a dealkaline lignin and cellulose acetate solution in a binary solvent system (dimethylformamide and methanol), followed by controlled thermal treatment. The structural evolution of the fibres under varying heat treatment conditions was systematically investigated using electron microscopy, electron diffraction, and Raman spectroscopy, revealing the gradual transition from amorphous carbon to a turbostratic structure. By tuning annealing temperatures, the surface area of the carbon fibres was optimised within the range of 222–405.8 m 2 g −1 . The resulting non-activated carbon fibre electrodes demonstrated superior rate capability (86 F g −1 over a current density range of 1–10 A g −1 ). The electrodes delivered desirable energy, power densities, and robust cycling stability over 10,000 cycles when assembled into a symmetric supercapacitor. This work highlights the potential of lignin-derived carbon fibres as sustainable and efficient energy storage materials, addressing the growing global demand for renewable energy technologies.
zh_title: 由脱碱木质素制成的可持续电纺碳纤维电极：增强超级电容器的能量存储
zh_abstract: 从可再生资源中获取先进材料对于实现可持续发展目标至关重要。在这项研究中，我们首次报告使用脱碱木质素作为电纺碳纳米纤维的前体，解决了木质素来源和提取方法的可变性对碳纤维性能带来的挑战。通过在二元溶剂系统（二甲基甲酰胺和甲醇）中静电纺丝脱碱木质素和醋酸纤维素溶液，然后进行受控热处理，合成了高表面积碳纳米纤维。利用电子显微镜、电子衍射和拉曼光谱系统地研究了纤维在不同热处理条件下的结构演变，揭示了从无定形碳到乱层结构的逐渐转变。通过调节退火温度，碳纤维的表面积优化在222–405.8 m 2 g -1 范围内。所得非活化碳纤维电极表现出优异的倍率性能（在1-10 A g -1 的电流密度范围内为86 F g -1 ）。当组装成对称超级电容器时，电极可提供理想的能量、功率密度和超过 10,000 次循环的稳健循环稳定性。这项工作凸显了木质素衍生碳纤维作为可持续、高效储能材料的潜力，满足全球对可再生能源技术日益增长的需求。

title: A freestanding co-doped Fe3O4/C electrode for high-energy-density solid-state sodium-ion asymmetric supercapacitors
abstract: Emerging high-power and energy supercapacitors (SCs) are a widely tracked goal for applications in transportation and energy storage systems. Herein, a well-synthesized Co-doped iron oxide carbon nanocomposite (Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C) thin film is deposited on nickel foam (NF) via a simple hydrothermal method and serves as a freestanding electrode for high-power and energy Na + ion asymmetric SCs (N-ASCs). The Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C framework, with a high specific surface area (41.03 m 2 /g), provides a three-dimensional, highly conductive network for fast charge transport and allows moderate loading of active materials (2 mg/cm 2 ). Moreover, porous Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C uniformly anchored on the NF current collector enables a rapid charge intercalation-deintercalation rate due to the increase in redox active sites of Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C and their good contact with conductive NF substrate as compared with pristine Fe 3 O 4 /C. As a result, the unique integrated electrode with a 3-D architecture exhibits a high specific capacitance of 1440 F/g at 2 A/g and an outstanding rate capability of 560 F/g at 12 A/g in 2 M NaOH electrolyte. Capacitance retention of 91.8% with Coulombic efficiency of 98.7% at 2 A/g over 5000 GCD cycles, and good cycling stability, suggesting great potential for high-performance Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C//AC N-ASCs. Moreover, the N-ASCs exhibits a high specific capacitance of 330 F/g at 2 A/g and an impressive specific energy density of 103.1 Wh/kg at a high-power density of 8437.5 W/kg. zh_abstract: 新兴的高功率和高能超级电容器（SC）是交通和储能系统应用中广泛关注的目标。在此，通过简单的水热方法在泡沫镍（NF）上沉积了良好合成的钴掺杂氧化铁碳纳米复合材料（Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C）薄膜，并用作高功率和能量Na + 离子不对称SC（N-ASC）的独立电极。 Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C框架具有高比表面积（41.03 m 2 /g），为快速电荷传输提供三维高导电网络，并允许适度负载活性材料（2 mg/cm 2 ）。此外，与原始Fe 3 O 4 /C相比，由于Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C氧化还原活性位点的增加以及与导电NF基材的良好接触，均匀锚定在NF集流体上的多孔Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C能够实现快速的电荷嵌入-脱嵌速率。因此，具有 3D 架构的独特集成电极在 2 M NaOH 电解质中表现出 2 A/g 时 1440 F/g 的高比电容和 12 A/g 时 560 F/g 的出色倍率性能。在 5000 个 GCD 循环中，2 A/g 下的电容保持率为 91.8%，库伦效率为 98.7%，并且循环稳定性良好，表明高性能 Co@Fe 3 O 4 /C//AC N-ASC 的巨大潜力。此外，N-ASC在2 A/g下表现出330 F/g的高比电容，在8437.5 W/kg的高功率密度下表现出令人印象深刻的103.1 Wh/kg的比能量密度。因此，这项研究表明了其开发新能源方法的巨大潜力……

title: Sinki-derived activated carbon for dual applications in supercapacitors and dye removal
abstract: • Activated carbon derived from sinki (AC-S) demonstrated a high surface area of 1278 m 2 /g. • 3D structure with combined micropores and mesopores. • The AC-S exhibited a specific capacitance of 192 F/g at the current density of 0.5 A/g. • 107 % capacitance retention after 5000 cycles. • Effective adsorptive removal of methylene blue (MB) dye. Transforming food waste into activated carbon for use as a supercapacitor electrode material and dye adsorption represents an effective approach to meeting energy requirements and addressing environmental challenges. In this study, activated carbon was synthesized from sinki, a traditional Nepalese dish produced by fermenting radish roots, through carbonization and activation under a nitrogen atmosphere. The resulting activated carbon from sinki (AC-S) exhibited a three-dimensional (3D) porous structure comprising both micro- and mesopores, with a specific surface area of 1278 m 2 /g. X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman spectroscopy, and Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR) confirmed the formation of both amorphous and crystalline carbon structures. When used as a supercapacitor electrode, the AC-S demonstrated favorable electrochemical behavior, attaining a specific capacitance of 192 F/g at 0.5 A/g and a notable enhancement in cyclic stability, reaching 107.5% after 5000 cycles. Furthermore, the ACS was evaluated for its dye-adsorption efficiency in aqueous solution, showing promising results for removing methylene blue (MB) from water. title: Bagasse-derived activated carbon/MoS₂ electrodes for solid-state supercapacitors
abstract: Sustainable energy storage requires eco-friendly, high-performance electrodes to replace expensive, fossil-fuel-derived carbons. Although biomass-derived carbons are renewable, they typically exhibit limited electrochemical performance. Molybdenum disulfide (MoS₂) possesses high theoretical capacitance but is constrained by restacking and low conductivity. In this study, C-MoS₂ nanocomposites were synthesized by combining activated carbon derived from sugarcane bagasse (surface area: 1070 m 2 /g) with MoS₂ at different concentrations using a one-step hydrothermal process. The layer-by-layer assembly strategy enabled sequential deposition of the C–MoS₂ composite onto the current collector, leading to enhanced electrochemical performance. The resulting solid-state supercapacitor, utilizing a PVA/H₂SO₄ gel electrolyte, delivered a specific capacitance of 465.87 F/g at 0.67 A/g, an energy density of 32.4 Wh/kg, and a power density of 333.6 W/kg. It retained 97.66% of its capacitance after 5000 cycles. These findings demonstrate the transformation of agricultural waste into a cost-effective, high-performance electrode material, offering a sustainable and potentially scalable solution for next-generation supercapacitors.

zh_abstract: 可持续能源存储需要环保、高性能的电极来替代昂贵的化石燃料碳。尽管生物质衍生的碳是可再生的，但它们通常表现出有限的电化学性能。二硫化钼 (MoS2) 具有高理论电容，但受到重新堆叠和低电导率的限制。在本研究中，采用一步水热法将甘蔗渣活性炭（表面积：1070 m 2 /g）与不同浓度的 MoS2 相结合，合成了 C-MoS2 纳米复合材料。逐层组装策略使得 C-MoS2 复合材料能够顺序沉积到集流体上，从而增强电化学性能。由此产生的固态超级电容器采用 PVA/H2SO4 凝胶电解质，在 0.67 A/g 电流下的比电容为 465.87 F/g，能量密度为 32.4 Wh/kg，功率密度为 333.6 W/kg。 5000 次循环后，其电容仍保持在 97.66%。这些发现表明，农业废物可以转化为具有成本效益的高性能电极材料，为下一代超级电容器提供可持续且具有潜在可扩展性的解决方案。

title: Freestanding MoS2@Mn-NiO@rGO network composite electrode for high-energy flexible asymmetric supercapacitor applications
abstract: Two-dimensional molybdenum disulfide (2D MoS 2 ) has emerged as a promising electrode material for flexible supercapacitors (FSCs) due to its layered structure, excellent mechanical flexibility, large surface-to-volume ratio, and superior electrochemical performance. However, its low electrical conductivity and tendency toward layer restacking significantly limit its rate capability and long-term cyclability. Herein, we developed a three-dimensional (3D) heterostructure, MoS 2 @Mn-NiO@rGO, by uniformly growing MoS 2 mesospheres and Mn-NiO nanoparticles directly on the surface of reduced graphene oxide (rGO) sheets via a facile hydrothermal method. The MoS 2 @Mn-NiO@rGO electrode exhibited excellent mechanical flexibility and superior electrochemical properties compared with two control electrodes (MoS₂ and MoS 2 @rGO), obtaining a specific capacitance of ∼1094 F·g −1 at a current density of 1 A·g −1 . The superior performance of the 3D composite electrode is attributed to the synergistic effect of the distinctive interconnected network with abundant reaction sites and large enhancement of charge transport. A high mass loading (∼12.5 mg·cm −2 ) asymmetric supercapacitor (ASC) in the MoS 2 @Mn-NiO@rGO//AC configuration demonstrated a specific capacitance of ∼166.23 F·g −1 at 1 A·g −1 and excellent capacitance retention of ∼95.5% after 10,000 cycles at 3 A·g −1 . Moreover, the ASC device showed a high energy density of ∼51.94 Wh·kg −1 at a power density of ∼751 W·kg −1 . Besides, two ASC cells in series could power four LEDs (3 mm, 1.5 V each), thereby confirming the energy st …
zh_title: 用于高能柔性非对称超级电容器应用的独立式MoS2@Mn-NiO@rGO网络复合电极
zh_abstract: 二维二硫化钼（2D MoS 2 ）由于其层状结构、优异的机械柔性、大的比表面积和优异的电化学性能，已成为一种有前景的柔性超级电容器（FSC）电极材料。然而，其低电导率和层重新堆叠的趋势严重限制了其倍率性能和长期循环性能。在此，我们通过简单的水热方法直接在还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）片的表面上均匀生长MoS 2 中间球和Mn-NiO纳米粒子，开发了一种三维（3D）异质结构MoS 2 @Mn-NiO@rGO。与两种对照电极（MoS2和MoS 2 @rGO）相比，MoS 2 @Mn-NiO@rGO电极表现出优异的机械柔韧性和优异的电化学性能，在1 A·g -1 的电流密度下获得~1094 F·g -1 的比电容。 3D复合电极的优越性能归因于独特的互连网络与丰富的反应位点和电荷传输的大幅增强的协同效应。 MoS 2 @Mn-NiO@rGO//AC结构中的高质量负载（∼12.5 mg·cm -2 ）非对称超级电容器（ASC）表现出在1 A·g -1 下的比电容为∼166.23 F·g -1 ，并且在3 A·g -1 下经过10,000次循环后，电容保持率为∼95.5%。此外，ASC器件在~751 W·kg -1 的功率密度下表现出~51.94 Wh·kg -1 的高能量密度。此外，两个串联的 ASC 电池可以为四个 LED（每个 3 mm，1.5 V）供电，从而确认了能源标准……

title: Bridging Monolayer MXenes With PEDOT:PSS for High‐Mass‐Loading Ultrahigh‐Rate Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT Supercapacitors with high mass loadings (>10 mg cm – 2 ) typically struggle to deliver ultrahigh‐rate performance because of sluggish mass and charge transport. This challenge is further exacerbated when using 2D electrode materials, which tend to undergo random self‐restacking driven by weak interlayer interactions. Here, we report a unilaminating and bridging strategy to construct ordered poly(3,4‐ethylenedioxythiophene):poly(styrenesulfonate) (PEDOT:PSS)–bridged Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene (sMX‐PP) by finely modulating these weak interactions. The bridging mechanism arises from hydrogen bonding and electrostatic interactions between PEDOT:PSS and single‐layer Ti 3 C 2 T x , effectively preventing restacking and promoting ion/electron transport. As a result, the sMX‐PP electrode with a high mass loading of 11.2 mg cm −2 delivers a specific capacitance of 165 F g −1 at an ultrahigh current density of 100 A g −1 . Furthermore, asymmetric supercapacitors assembled with activated carbon retain 58% of their capacitance as the current density increases from 3 to 70 A g −1 . This work provides a feasible approach to mitigating the performance degradation of MXene electrodes under simultaneous ultrahigh‐rate and high‐mass‐loading conditions, thus advancing the practical deployment of supercapacitors in ultrahigh‐power applications.
zh_title: 使用 PEDOT:PSS 桥接单层 MXene，用于大质量负载超高倍率超级电容器
zh_abstract: 摘要 由于质量和电荷传输缓慢，具有高质量负载 (>10 mg cm – 2 ) 的超级电容器通常难以提供超高倍率性能。当使用二维电极材料时，这一挑战会进一步加剧，因为二维电极材料往往会在弱层间相互作用的驱动下发生随机自重堆叠。在这里，我们报告了一种单层和桥接策略，通过精细调节这些弱相互作用来构建有序聚（3,4-乙烯二氧噻吩）：聚（苯乙烯磺酸）（PEDOT：PSS）-桥接Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene（sMX-PP）。桥接机制源于PEDOT:PSS和单层Ti 3 C 2 T x 之间的氢键和静电相互作用，有效防止重新堆叠并促进离子/电子传输。结果，具有11.2 mg cm -2 高质量负载的sMX-PP电极在100 A g -1 的超高电流密度下提供165 F g -1 的比电容。此外，当电流密度从3 A g -1 增加到70 A g -1 时，用活性炭组装的不对称超级电容器保留了58%的电容。这项工作提供了一种可行的方法来减轻 MXene 电极在同时超高倍率和高质量负载条件下的性能下降，从而推动超级电容器在超高功率应用中的实际部署。

title: Cascaded Spatial Confinement Enables Simultaneous Ultrahigh Energy and Power Densities in Planar Micro-Supercapacitors
institutions: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
abstract: Planar microsupercapacitors (P-MSCs) with high power density and conformal configurations could provide on-chip power supply in the design of highly integrated electronics. However, achieving a breakthrough in overall energy within a finite footprint requires establishing an effective structure-performance relationship. Here, we present a cascaded spatial confinement strategy to construct a 3D interlocked P-MSC that couples force fields with charge transport/storage behavior, enabling ion-electron enrichment. Laser-etched pyramid microarrays on graphite current collectors create capillary forces that confine both electrode slurry and electrolyte to build a compact conduction network, while establishing a robust ion-electron interaction interface, significantly facilitating ion accessibility and kinetics. Using Zn//active carbon (AC) P-MSC as an example, the strategy boosts active material utilization by over 2-fold, and delivers an outstanding energy density of 117.5 mWh cm –3 and a power density of 2382.0 mW cm –3, exceeding those reported for Zn//AC P-MSCs by several to tens of times, and surpassing nearly all existing Zn-based P-MSCs in areal performance. The approach demonstrates reliable universality across various P-MSC systems (eight types are verified). Integrated devices show notable advantages in powering miniaturized electronics and flexible displays, possessing a voltage output approximately 4.7 times that of a same-sized dry battery, and are also configured as emergency power chips to charge smartphones.
zh_title: 级联空间限制可在平面微型超级电容器中同时实现超高能量和功率密度
zh_abstract: 具有高功率密度和保形配置的平面微型超级电容器（P-MSC）可以在高度集成电子设备的设计中提供片上电源。然而，在有限的占地面积内实现整体能量的突破需要建立有效的结构-性能关系。在这里，我们提出了一种级联空间限制策略来构建 3D 联锁 P-MSC，将力场与电荷传输/存储行为耦合起来，从而实现离子电子富集。石墨集流体上的激光蚀刻金字塔微阵列产生毛细管力，限制电极浆料和电解质以构建紧凑的传导网络，同时建立强大的离子-电子相互作用界面，显着促进离子可及性和动力学。以Zn//活性炭（AC）P-MSC为例，该策略将活性材料利用率提高了2倍以上，并具有117.5 mWh cm –3 的出色能量密度和2382.0 mW cm –3 的功率密度，比报道的Zn//AC P-MSC数倍至数十倍，并且在面积性能上超越了几乎所有现有的Zn基P-MSC。该方法证明了各种 P-MSC 系统的可靠通用性（已验证八种类型）。集成器件在为小型电子产品和柔性显示器供电方面显示出显着的优势，其电压输出约为同尺寸干电池的4.7倍，并且还可以配置为应急电源芯片为智能手机充电。

title: Covalent Amorphous Alumina‐Hydrogenated Graphene Materials With Integrated Proton Radiation Shielding and Energy Storage Capability for Space Electronics
institutions: Chang Gung University of Science and Technology
abstract: ABSTRACT The development of adaptive material platforms that integrate proton radiation shielding with energy storage capabilities is critical for achieving both miniaturization and cost‐effective reliability in space electronics. Here, we present an industrially viable technology for fabricating covalent amorphous alumina‐hydrogenated graphene (AHG) films that can attenuate energetic protons, store electrical energy, and adapt to downsizing. Specifically, the fabrication involves thermal‐driven precipitation and crystallization of carbon species into hydrogenated graphene layers, along with oxidation of aluminum into amorphous alumina, on a nickel‐copper alloy surface. AHG films exhibit effective attenuation of energetic protons (15.2 MeV, 4.3 × 10 12 p/cm 2 ), primarily attributed to proton trapping via C─H bond formation within the film matrix. Moreover, AHG films are laser‐scribed into interdigitated electrodes for constructing micro‐supercapacitors (µ‐SCs) with impressive energy (8.33 mWh/cm 3 ) and power (130 mW/cm 3 ) densities. Operando measurements of the AHG µ‐SCs demonstrate their dual functions in reducing the incident protons by ∼1.9 MeV in energy and ∼5.8 × 10 11 protons/cm 2 in fluence, while maintaining stable capacitive behavior with ∼93% capacitance retained after the severe irradiation. These findings suggest significant potential for developing single multifunctional products as a replacement for both traditional radiation shields and energy storage devices in next‐generation space electronics.
zh_title: 用于空间电子的具有集成质子辐射屏蔽和储能能力的共价非晶氧化铝-氢化石墨烯材料
zh_abstract: 摘要：开发将质子辐射屏蔽与能量存储功能相结合的自适应材料平台对于实现空间电子产品的小型化和具有成本效益的可靠性至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种工业上可行的技术，用于制造共价非晶态氧化铝氢化石墨烯（AHG）薄膜，该薄膜可以衰减高能质子、存储电能并适应小型化。具体来说，该制造涉及在镍铜合金表面上热驱动碳物质沉淀和结晶成氢化石墨烯层，以及将铝氧化成无定形氧化铝。 AHG 薄膜表现出高能质子的有效衰减（15.2 MeV，4.3 × 10 12 p/cm 2 ），这主要归因于通过薄膜基质内的 C─H 键形成捕获质子。此外，AHG 薄膜被激光刻划成叉指电极，用于构建具有令人印象深刻的能量（8.33 mWh/cm 3 ）和功率（130 mW/cm 3 ）密度的微型超级电容器（μ-SC）。 AHG µ-SC 的操作测量证明了它们的双重功能，可将入射质子的能量减少约 1.9 MeV，注量减少约 5.8 × 10 11 质子/cm 2 ，同时保持稳定的电容行为，在严重照射后保留约 93% 的电容。这些发现表明，开发单一多功能产品作为下一代空间电子产品中传统辐射屏蔽和储能设备的替代品具有巨大潜力。

title: Heteroatom‐Doped Porous Carbons for Binder‐Free and Metal‐Free Supercapacitors: Design Strategies and Future Perspectives
abstract: Binder‐free and metal‐free electrodes are emerging as sustainable alternatives to traditional supercapacitors that use non‐conductive binders and heavy metal components. This article discusses the recent advances in heteroatom‐doped porous carbons (such as N, B, P, S and O) designed to enhance supercapacitor performance. It highlights materials that eliminate inactive components, improve charge transport and increase mechanical flexibility. The article summarises the key synthesis strategies, including solution‐phase doping, electrospinning, 3D printing, thermal reduction, biomass‐derived carbonisation and conducting polymer‐based methods. It critically examines how heteroatom doping influences surface chemistry, electrical conductivity and pseudocapacitive behaviour. Special attention has been given to the structural and electrochemical performance of these materials in flexible, solid‐state and scalable device formats. This article emphasises the transformative potential of doped, binder‐free and metal‐free carbon electrodes in designing next‐generation supercapacitors, especially suited for portable, wearable and sustainable energy storage technologies.
zh_title: 用于无粘合剂和无金属超级电容器的杂原子掺杂多孔碳：设计策略和未来展望
zh_abstract: 无粘合剂和无金属电极正在成为使用非导电粘合剂和重金属成分的传统超级电容器的可持续替代品。本文讨论了旨在增强超级电容器性能的杂原子掺杂多孔碳（如 N、B、P、S 和 O）的最新进展。它重点介绍了消除非活性成分、改善电荷传输和提高机械灵活性的材料。本文总结了关键的合成策略，包括溶液相掺杂、静电纺丝、3D 打印、热还原、生物质衍生的碳化和基于导电聚合物的方法。它批判性地研究了杂原子掺杂如何影响表面化学、导电性和赝电容行为。人们特别关注这些材料在柔性、固态和可扩展设备形式中的结构和电化学性能。本文强调了掺杂、无粘合剂和无金属碳电极在设计下一代超级电容器中的变革潜力，特别适合便携式、可穿戴和可持续能源存储技术。

title: Research Progress on the Application of Graphene Aerogel in the Field of Electrochemical Energy Storage
abstract: ABSTRACT The rise of effective systems of electrochemical energy storage is today a research hotspot in the conditions of transformation of the global energy structure and the large‐scale integration of new energy. Solving the problem of poor conductivity and structural stability in current electrode materials, graphene aerogels have appeared as the best materials to solve the existing technological bottlenecks since they bear considerably good electrical conductivity, extremely large specific surface area, and stable structure. The current paper takes a systematic review of the research advances in the study of graphene aerogels and outlines the preparation methods, including in situ assembly, chemical cross‐linking, the template method, 3D printing technology, and the sustainable synthesis method of biomass, in which such preparation methodologies can affect material microstructure. It is on this foundation that this research study examines the action mechanisms and applications of these materials in supercapacitors, zinc‐air batteries, and lithium‐ion batteries. It offers a deep examination of ways of performance optimization through building composite structures that consist of carbonaceous materials, covalent organic frameworks, and metal compounds. Finally, technical challenges are summarized and future trends forecasted to guide the design of novel, efficient energy storage devices.
zh_title: 石墨烯气凝胶在电化学储能领域的应用研究进展
zh_abstract: 摘要 在全球能源结构转型和新能源大规模融合的背景下，有效的电化学储能系统的兴起是当今的研究热点。针对目前电极材料导电性和结构稳定性差的问题，石墨烯气凝胶因其具有良好的导电性、极大的比表面积和稳定的结构而成为解决现有技术瓶颈的最佳材料。本文系统回顾了石墨烯气凝胶的研究进展，概述了石墨烯气凝胶的制备方法，包括原位组装、化学交联、模板法、3D打印技术和生物质可持续合成方法，其中这些制备方法会影响材料的微观结构。正是在此基础上，本研究探讨了这些材料在超级电容器、锌空气电池和锂离子电池中的作用机制和应用。它通过构建由碳质材料、共价有机骨架和金属化合物组成的复合结构，深入研究了性能优化的方法。最后，总结了技术挑战并预测了未来趋势，以指导新颖、高效的储能设备的设计。

title: From agricultural waste to high-energy supercapacitors: carbon dots-enhanced hierarchical porous carbon derived from walnut shells
abstract: Walnut shells serve as a sustainable precursor for the synthesis of carbon dots incorporates porous carbon. By systematically investigating the relationship between alkali-carbon ratios and electrochemical performance, this study highlights the energy storage potential of walnut shell-derived carbon materials. • Porous carbon was obtained by treating natural walnut shells with convenient methods. • Carbon dots was successfully anchored on the surface of the carbon material. • PC-2 achieved a specific capacitance as high as 389 F g −1 at 2 mV s −1 . • After 5000 cycles, PC-2//PC-2 maintains 106 % cycle efficiency. Converting agricultural waste into high-value energy materials is key to sustainable development. Herein, a synergistic carbonization-activation method was used to fabricate hierarchical porous carbon (HPC) embedded with carbon dots (CDs) from walnut shells, addressing low surface activity in conventional biomass-derived carbons. With an optimized KOH-to-carbon ratio (2:1), the resulting PC-2 has a 3D porous network, with CDs anchored on pore walls. It exhibits a maximum specific capacitance of 389 F g −1 at 2 mV s −1 , which is benefited from CDs-facilitated fast electron transfer and hierarchical pores-enabled efficient ion diffusion. Assembled into a symmetrical supercapacitor, PC-2 delivers 18.6 Wh kg −1 at 23.3 W kg −1 and 106% performance retention after 5000 cycles. This scalable, eco-friendly route offers insights for designing CDs-integrated structures for next-generation energy storage.
zh_title: 从农业废弃物到高能超级电容器：源自核桃壳的碳点增强分级多孔碳
zh_abstract: 核桃壳是合成含有多孔碳的碳点的可持续前体。通过系统研究碱碳比与电化学性能之间的关系，本研究强调了核桃壳衍生碳材料的储能潜力。 • 多孔碳是通过方便的方法处理天然核桃壳而获得的。 • 碳点成功固定在碳材料的表面。 • PC-2 在2 mV s -1 下实现了高达389 F g -1 的比电容。 • 5000 次循环后，PC-2//PC-2 保持106% 的循环效率。将农业废弃物转化为高价值能源材料是可持续发展的关键。在此，采用协同碳化-活化方法来制造嵌入核桃壳碳点（CD）的分级多孔碳（HPC），解决了传统生物质衍生碳的低表面活性问题。通过优化 KOH 与碳的比例 (2:1)，所得 PC-2 具有 3D 多孔网络，CD 锚定在孔壁上。它在2 mV s -1 下表现出389 F g -1 的最大比电容，这得益于碳点促进的快速电子转移和分层孔隙实现的高效离子扩散。 PC-2 组装成对称超级电容器后，可在 23.3 W kg -1 下提供 18.6 Wh kg -1 功率，并且在 5000 次循环后性能保持率为 106%。这种可扩展、环保的路线为设计下一代能量存储的 CD 集成结构提供了见解。

title: Mn-doped MoS <sub>2</sub> -based nano-cored-yarn electrode with high voltage energy storage
abstract: Yarn-like energy storage devices are recognized for their high integrability, wearable compatibility, and mechanical flexibility. However, integrating multi-dimensional nanomaterials with varying energy storage synergies in situ on a single yarn while ensuring high binding stability and energy density remains a significant challenge. Herein, the 1T/2H phase Mn-doped MoS<sub>2</sub> was synthesized via a one-step hydrothermal method, optimizing the doping ratio and lattice distortion induced by cationic point defects, which effectively extends the layer spacing and mitigates the hazardous and challenging conditions typically required for the synthesis of the 1T phase. Subsequently, nano-cored-yarn electrodes were fabricated with activated carbon fibers as the core layer and CF/MnₓMoS<sub>2</sub>-CNF nanofibers as the shell layer through conjugated electrospinning, followed by twisting, winding and carbonization. Due to the unique structural design and effective defect regulation, coordination inhibits water decomposition in aqueous electrolytes at high operating voltages, resulting in the stable electrochemical performance at an output voltage of 1.6 V for the assembled nano-cored-yarn solid-state supercapacitors (NYCs). The symmetrically NYCs achieved a maximum energy density of 308.7 μWh/cm³ (power density of 5.5 mW/cm³) and a maximum power density of 16.9 mW/cm³ (energy density of 258.1 μWh/cm³), which still maintained 86.4% of the original capacity after 5,000 charge/discharge cycles. zh_title: Mn掺杂MoS 2 基纳米芯纱高压储能电极
zh_abstract: 类纱线储能装置因其高集成性、可穿戴兼容性和机械灵活性而受到认可。然而，将具有不同能量存储协同作用的多维纳米材料原位集成在单根纱线上，同时确保高结合稳定性和能量密度仍然是一个重大挑战。在此，通过一步水热法合成了1T/2H相Mn掺杂MoS2，优化了掺杂比例和由阳离子点缺陷引起的晶格畸变，有效地扩展了层间距并减轻了合成1T相通常所需的危险和挑战性条件。随后，以活性炭纤维为芯层、CF/MnₓMoS2-CNF纳米纤维为壳层，通过共轭静电纺丝、加捻、缠绕和碳化制备了纳米芯纱电极。由于独特的结构设计和有效的缺陷调节，在高工作电压下配位可抑制水性电解质中的水分解，从而使组装的纳米芯纱固态超级电容器（NYC）在输出电压为1.6 V时具有稳定的电化学性能。对称NYC的最大能量密度为308.7 μWh/cm3（功率密度为5.5 mW/cm3），最大功率密度为16.9 mW/cm3（能量密度为258.1 μWh/cm3），在5000次充放电循环后仍保持原始容量的86.4%。这项研究为……的设计和集成提供了创新的想法和解决方案。

title: Bamboo‐Based Carbon Fiber/Carbon Nanosheet Composite Flexible Supercapacitor
abstract: The primary factors affecting the performance of supercapacitors are ion diffusion, storage, and electron conduction. A unique composite structure combining elongated carbon fibers and void‐filling carbon nanosheets can simultaneously enhance ion diffusion, storage, and charge conduction. Herein, bamboo fibers treated with delignification are used as raw materials. Through a simple chemical delignification process, followed by compression into sheets and carbonization, elongated carbon fiber/carbon nanosheet composite structures are prepared. Supercapacitors made with symmetric electrodes from these bamboo‐based composite materials exhibit a specific capacitance of 97.2 F g −1 at a current density of 0.25 A g −1 . The bamboo‐based composite sheets demonstrate excellent flexibility and conductivity due to the stacking of carbon fibers and carbon nanosheets, forming abundant layered voids and a 3D network structure. This layered 3D network structure endows the PVA/H 3 PO 4 gel electrolyte with excellent permeability. The bamboo‐based carbon fiber/carbon nanosheet composite interdigitated flexible solid‐state supercapacitor achieves an areal capacitance of 10.59 mF cm −2 at a current density of 5 μA cm −2 and retains 0.99 mF cm −2 even at 200 μA cm −2 . After undergoing various folding angles and 200 folds, the CV curves of the interdigitated flexible solid‐state supercapacitor show minimal changes in shape and enclosed area, demonstrating excellent flexibility and folding durability.

institutions: Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China
abstract: The rapid development of wearable and flexible electronics has imposed stringent demands on portable energy storage devices, requiring both high energy density and facile structural processability. Therefore, developing direct ink writing (DIW) printable polyaniline (PANI)-based micro-supercapacitors (MSCs) with high charge storage capability is of great significance. However, current printable PANI electrodes often suffer from low active mass loading and poor charge transport, severely limiting their practical application. Herein, we report a solvent-assisted self-assembly strategy combined with DIW 3D printing to fabricate MXene/PANI composite gel electrodes for high-performance MSCs. A molecularly homogeneous MXene/PANI composite was obtained via spontaneous desolvation-driven self-assembly, forming a hierarchical 3D porous network where PANI nanoparticles intercalate between MXene nanosheets as conductive bridges. The resulting MXene/PANI gel ink exhibits excellent printability, high viscosity and shape fidelity, enabling precise DIW printing of thick, high-mass-loading electrodes. Benefiting from its integrated 3D conductive network and efficient ion diffusion pathways, the electrode achieves a high specific capacitance of 264.5 F g –1, 84% retention at 10 A g –1, and 96.8% capacitance retention after 6000 cycles. The quasi-solid-state MSCs deliver an ultrahigh areal capacitance of 2950 mF cm –2, an energy density of 331.9 μWh cm –2, and a power density of 9 mW cm –2 . This work establishes a scalable route for designing high-loading pseudocapacitive electrodes via DIW …

title: Reinforcing bio-electronic networks in microbial cement composites using conductive carbon nanomaterials for structural energy storage
abstract: Microbial cement supercapacitors have emerged as a new form of structural energy-storage material, in which electroactive bacteria and their metabolites create bio-electronic pathways within cement matrices. However, the conductivity and connectivity of such biologically derived pathways remain limited in the heterogeneous cement environment, restricting charge transport and energy-storage performance. Here, conductive carbon nanomaterials were introduced to reinforce these pathways and to construct an inorganic–organic bio-electronic network in microbial cement composites. By integrating Shewanella oneidensis MR-1 with multi-walled carbon nanotubes and graphene oxide, we demonstrate that carbon nanomaterials can effectively bridge microbial conductive domains and improve network continuity within cement. The optimized composite (0.3 wt% nanocarbon) achieved a gravimetric capacitance of approximately 213.1 F g −1 and an energy density of about 43.2 Wh kg −1 , representing increases of over 1.2-fold and 0.85-fold, respectively, compared with the control sample. More importantly, the cyclic voltammetry area increased by up to 2.5 times, while the internal resistance decreased to 2.3 kΩ, indicating substantially improved electron transport. The composite also maintained 82% capacitance retention after 10,000 cycles. Microstructural observations confirm that the enhanced performance originates from the formation of a spatially continuous inorganic–organic conductive network composed of carbon nanomaterials and electroactive microorganisms. title: Metastable Nickel Carbide Enables Programmable Evolution of Nanoporous Carbon Architectures
abstract: ABSTRACT Designing nanoporous carbon materials with controllable structure and functionality is a central challenge for electrochemical energy storage. Here we demonstrate metastable Ni 3 C as a transformable scaffold enabling programmable synthesis of nanoporous carbon architectures through pathway‐dependent structural evolution. Starting from a bicontinuous nanoporous Ni 3 C framework, metastability arising from weak Ni–C bonding permits controlled transformation via thermal decomposition, chemical dealloying, and cyclic carbide–metal–carbide evolution, yielding mesoporous graphene (MG), hierarchical nanoporous amorphous carbon (np‐C), and an integrated MG/np‐C composite, respectively. These pathways preserve mesoscale structural continuity while directing carbon reconstruction toward graphitic or amorphous configurations, producing distinct pore hierarchies, carbon ordering, and electronic transport properties. As electrodes for supercapacitors and sodium‐ion batteries, MG provides highly conductive networks, np‐C offers micropore‐rich structures with high charge‐storage density, whereas the MG/np‐C composite integrates these complementary attributes to deliver enhanced electrochemical performance. This work establishes metastable phase mediation as a pathway‐controlled strategy for engineering nanoporous carbon architectures and related functional materials.

zh_abstract: 摘要 设计具有可控结构和功能的纳米多孔碳材料是电化学储能的核心挑战。在这里，我们展示了亚稳态 Ni 3 C 作为可变形支架，能够通过路径依赖的结构演化实现纳米多孔碳结构的可编程合成。从双连续纳米多孔 Ni 3 C 框架开始，弱 Ni-C 键合产生的亚稳定性允许通过热分解、化学脱合金和循环碳化物-金属-碳化物演化进行受控转变，分别产生介孔石墨烯（MG）、分级纳米多孔无定形碳（np-C）和集成的 MG/np-C 复合材料。这些路径保留了介观结构的连续性，同时将碳重构引导至石墨或无定形构型，产生不同的孔隙层次结构、碳排序和电子传输特性。作为超级电容器和钠离子电池的电极，MG提供高导电网络，np-C提供富含微孔的结构和高电荷存储密度，而MG/np-C复合材料集成了这些互补属性以提供增强的电化学性能。这项工作将亚稳态相介导建立为工程纳米多孔碳结构和相关功能材料的途径控制策略。

title: CoNi–P/MXene With Yolk–Shell Hollow Structure as High‐Performance Supercapacitor Electrode Material
abstract: Transition metal phosphides exhibit high specific capacitance. However, their practical application is limited by volume expansion and structural instability during charging and discharging. In this study, a CoNi–P yolk–shell structure was synthesized using hydrothermal and calcination methods and combined with two‐dimensional titanium carbide (MXene) to construct a stable CoNi–P/MXene conductive network. The yolk–shell structure mitigates volume effects and shortens the electron transport path, while MXene enhances the structural stability and cycle life. The CoNi–P/MXene composite exhibits a specific capacitance of 964 F g −1 . In addition, adjusting the MXene content affects the electrochemical performance. Notably, an asymmetric supercapacitor using CoNi–P/MXene and activated carbon as the positive and negative electrodes, respectively, displays a capacitance retention rate of 90.1% after 16,000 cycles at a current density of 5 A g −1 and delivers an energy density of 44.64 Wh kg −1 at a power density of 800 W kg −1 . Therefore, the proposed CoNi–P/MXene electrode material shows excellent prospects for energy storage applications.

title: Opportunities of Highly Oxidized Single‐Walled Carbon Nanotubes for Electrochemical and Electromechanical Applications
abstract: One‐dimensional single‐walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) are strong candidates for providing highly conductive networks in electrodes. However, SWCNTs tend to aggregate in liquid or solid media due to their high aspect ratio and hydrophobic characteristics. This review summarizes recent developments in highly oxidized SWCNTs and their applications in electrical and electrochemical devices. Highly oxidized SWCNTs (Ox‐SWCNTs) represent an emerging class of functional carbon nanomaterials in which a high density of oxygenated surface groups is introduced while largely preserving the intrinsic sp 2 ‐hybridized framework. Recent advances in chlorate‐based oxidation, mechanochemical kneading, and subsequent defect‐healing treatments now enable precise control over oxidation chemistry with minimal structural degradation. These developments provide dispersant‐free, solution‐processable SWCNTs that exhibit enhanced interfacial compatibility and tunable chemical reactivity. Their applications in wet spinning of conducting fibers, textile supercapacitors, chemical sensors, triboelectric devices, and Si/nanocarbon hybrid anodes for Li‐ion batteries are introduced. Highly functionalized SWCNTs could serve as a scalable and environmentally responsible materials platform, with applicability extending from catalysis and sensing to advanced battery technologies and flexible electronics.

zh_abstract: 一维单壁碳纳米管（SWCNT）是在电极中提供高导电网络的有力候选者。然而，由于单壁碳纳米管的高长径比和疏水特性，它们在液体或固体介质中容易聚集。本综述总结了高度氧化的单壁碳纳米管的最新进展及其在电气和电化学设备中的应用。高度氧化的SWCNT（Ox-SWCNT）代表了一类新兴的功能性碳纳米材料，其中引入了高密度的氧化表面基团，同时在很大程度上保留了固有的sp 2 杂化框架。氯酸盐氧化、机械化学捏合和随后的缺陷修复处理方面的最新进展现在可以精确控制氧化化学，同时将结构降解降至最低。这些进展提供了无分散剂、可溶液加工的单壁碳纳米管，其表现出增强的界面相容性和可调节的化学反应性。介绍了它们在导电纤维湿法纺丝、纺织超级电容器、化学传感器、摩擦电器件和锂离子电池硅/纳米碳混合阳极中的应用。高度功能化的单壁碳纳米管可以作为可扩展且对环境负责的材料平台，其适用性从催化和传感扩展到先进的电池技术和柔性电子产品。

title: Progress and Emerging Architectures of MXene‐Based Electrodes for Advanced Supercapacitors
institutions: Bangalore Medical College and Research Institute
abstract: Two‐dimensional MXenes have emerged as leading candidates for advanced supercapacitors, leveraging their metallic conductivity, controllable surface functionalities, and layered morphology for rapid ion diffusion. Despite these inherent advantages, realizing their full potential is hindered by challenges such as nanosheet restacking, limited interlayer spacing, and long‐term electrochemical instability. To overcome these limitations, research has shifted beyond basic material tuning to focus on the rational design of advanced electrode architectures. This review consolidates the state‐of‐the‐art progress in this architectural evolution, highlighting cutting‐edge strategies including: engineered intercalation/deintercalation systems for tunable interlayer spacing; hierarchical nanostructuring to create 3D porous frameworks; and hybridization with polymers, metals, and biomass‐derived carbons. We also examine the critical role of atomic‐level tailoring through heteroatom doping and defect modulation, alongside the accelerating influence of machine learning and computational modeling for predictive design. Finally, we address critical challenges related to oxidation stability, scalability, and environmental safety, offering a perspective on future opportunities where these advanced architectures can transform MXene‐based supercapacitors into sustainable, high‐performance energy storage technologies.

zh_abstract: 二维 MXene 已成为先进超级电容器的主要候选者，利用其金属导电性、可控表面功能和用于快速离子扩散的层状形态。尽管有这些固有的优势，但纳米片重新堆叠、有限的层间距和长期电化学不稳定性等挑战阻碍了它们充分发挥潜力。为了克服这些限制，研究已经从基本材料调整转向先进电极结构的合理设计。这篇综述巩固了这种架构演变的最先进进展，强调了尖端策略，包括：用于可调层间距的工程嵌入/脱嵌系统；分层纳米结构创建 3D 多孔框架；以及与聚合物、金属和生物质衍生的碳的杂化。我们还研究了通过杂原子掺杂和缺陷调制进行原子级定制的关键作用，以及机器学习和计算模型对预测设计的加速影响。最后，我们解决了与氧化稳定性、可扩展性和环境安全相关的关键挑战，并展望了这些先进架构可以将基于 MXene 的超级电容器转变为可持续、高性能储能技术的未来机遇。

abstract: ABSTRACT To design nanostructured electrodes capable of sustaining both high energy and power in sodium‐ion supercapacitors, we present a mechanistically defined synthesis strategy that couples interfacial nano‐pitting of carbon frameworks with in situ sulfate‐substituted crystallization of Na 2.85 V 2 (PO 4 ) 2.85 (SO 4 ) 0.15 (NVPS) nanodots. By integrating phosphate–sulfate ultracentrifugation pretreatment with brief thermal annealing, NVPS nanodots (5 nm) are homogeneously dispersed and tightly anchored along multi‐walled carbon nanotube (MWCNT) networks. Mechanistic analysis revealed that a bifunctional role of Na 2 SO 4 : it induces localized sodification‐assisted etching that forms ≈5 nm nanopits serving as confined nucleation cavities, while sulfate species participate in NVPS crystallization within these domains. Concurrent redeposition of sodified carbon fragments during ultracentrifugation further reinforces interfacial stability, producing nanodots electronically bridged and mechanically stabilized by the carbon matrix. The resulting NVPS/MWCNT composites exhibit exceptional rate capability, delivering 97 mAh g −1 (83% of the theoretical capacity) at 1000C, corresponding to a full charge–discharge cycle of 3.6 s. This ultrafast behavior originates from the formation of robust, strongly coupled nanodot–carbon junctions that facilitate rapid electron transport and sodium‐ion intercalation. title: Synchrotron Imaging and Modeling of Gel Polymer Electrolyte Transport in Hierarchical Carbon Aerogels for Supercapacitors
abstract: Abstract Hierarchically porous carbon aerogels offer significant potential for next-generation energy storage, yet controlling their structure and electrolyte infiltration remains a key challenge. Here, we develop fully biobased carbon aerogels (CAs) derived from a lignin-cellulose nanocrystal blend via ice-templating and carbonization. The resulting anisotropic hierarchical porous structures are infused with poly(vinyl alcohol)-potassium hydroxide gel polymer electrolyte to form semi-solid composite electrodes. Time-resolved synchrotron X-ray microtomography enables direct visualization of structural evolution during carbonization and three-dimensional electrolyte infiltration. Image-based pore-scale modeling performed directly on reconstructed synchrotron X-ray tomographic volumes reveals how the real hierarchical pore network governs gel electrolyte distribution, accessible porosity, and ion transport pathways. The results show that aligned and interconnected pore networks enable deep, uniform electrolyte penetration, reduce transport tortuosity, and increase electrochemically active volume. The structure-transport-performance relationship is validated by electrochemical testing of symmetric supercapacitors, demonstrating stable capacitance and reduced internal resistance. This work establishes a concept for renewable porous carbon electrodes and introduces a scalable CA-gel electrolyte system for high-performance solid-state energy storage.
zh_title: 超级电容器分层碳气凝胶中凝胶聚合物电解质传输的同步加速器成像和建模
zh_abstract: 摘要 分级多孔碳气凝胶为下一代储能提供了巨大潜力，但控制其结构和电解质渗透仍然是一个关键挑战。在这里，我们通过冰模板和碳化从木质素-纤维素纳米晶体混合物中开发出全生物基碳气凝胶（CA）。将所得各向异性分层多孔结构注入聚（乙烯醇）-氢氧化钾凝胶聚合物电解质，形成半固体复合电极。时间分辨同步加速器 X 射线显微断层扫描可以直接可视化碳化和三维电解质渗透过程中的结构演变。直接在重建的同步加速器 X 射线断层扫描体积上进行基于图像的孔隙尺度建模，揭示了真实的分层孔隙网络如何控制凝胶电解质分布、可及孔隙率和离子传输路径。结果表明，排列和互连的孔隙网络能够实现深度、均匀的电解质渗透，减少传输曲折，并增加电化学活性体积。通过对称超级电容器的电化学测试验证了结构-传输-性能关系，证明了稳定的电容和降低的内阻。这项工作建立了可再生多孔碳电极的概念，并引入了用于高性能固态储能的可扩展的 CA-凝胶电解质系统。

title: Spray drying-assisted co-activation of lignin-derived porous carbon using potassium hydroxide and potassium carbonate for enhanced supercapacitor performance
institutions: Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City
Ho Chi Minh City University of Science
abstract: The increasing demand for sustainable and high-power supercapacitors has driven the search for biomass-derived carbon materials with controllable pore architectures. This work represents the first report on the use of a spray drying-assisted co-activation method to synthesize porous carbon materials derived from lignin, potassium hydroxide (KOH), and potassium carbonate (K 2 CO 3 ). The influence of the K 2 CO 3 /KOH mass ratio and carbonization temperature on particle morphology, pore characteristics, and electrochemical performance was investigated. The combination of KOH and K 2 CO 3 offers a promising co-activation strategy that balances micropore generation and mesopore enlargement, thereby enabling precise control over pore size distribution and achieving hierarchical micro-mesoporous structures. The optimized porous carbon samples were employed as supercapacitor electrodes, delivering a high specific capacitance of 293.1 F/g (three-electrode system) and 123.8 F/g (two-electrode system) at 0.5 A/g. The electrodes also exhibited excellent rate capability (retaining 78% capacitance at 5 A/g), and stable cycling performance (preserving 80% capacitance after 10,000 cycles). These superior properties are attributed to the synergistic pore network and surface oxygen functionalities that enhance ion accessibility and wettability. Moreover, compared to conventional activation methods, the reduced KOH usage highlights the eco-efficiency of this process, enabling sustainable synthesis of high-performance lignin-derived porous carbons for future supercapacitor technologies.

zh_abstract: 对可持续和高功率超级电容器的需求不断增长，推动了对具有可控孔隙结构的生物质衍生碳材料的探索。这项工作代表了第一份关于使用喷雾干燥辅助共活化方法合成源自木质素、氢氧化钾（KOH）和碳酸钾（K 2 CO 3 ）的多孔碳材料的报告。研究了K 2 CO 3 /KOH质量比和碳化温度对颗粒形貌、孔隙特征和电化学性能的影响。 KOH和K 2 CO 3 的组合提供了一种有前景的共激活策略，可以平衡微孔生成和介孔扩大，从而能够精确控制孔径分布并实现分层微介孔结构。优化后的多孔碳样品用作超级电容器电极，在0.5 A/g电流下具有293.1 F/g（三电极系统）和123.8 F/g（两电极系统）的高比电容。该电极还表现出优异的倍率性能（在 5 A/g 下保持 78% 的电容）和稳定的循环性能（10,000 次循环后保持 80% 的电容）。这些优越的性能归因于协同孔网络和表面氧功能，增强了离子的可及性和润湿性。此外，与传统的活化方法相比，KOH用量的减少凸显了该过程的生态效率，使得可持续合成高性能木质素衍生的多孔碳用于未来的超级电容器技术成为可能。

abstract: According to the waste management concept, the biomass and spent Li-ion batteries have been valorized to synthesize sustainable supercapacitor electrodes. The reference samples are porous activated carbon (AC) and another composite containing few-layer graphene (FLG) from commercial expanded graphite. The addition of RSG and FLG to activated carbon increases capacitance by approximately 70% and 50%, with significant stability at extreme conditions (high current density and potential sweep rate), thus maintaining the energy density with power density increase. The capacitance retention increases from 48% (and 49%) for porous carbon to 89% (and 83%) and 81% (and 78%) for AC/RSG (and AC/FLG) composites, at 17.7 A/g (and 200 mV/s). The cyclic stability test for the best-performing composite (AC/RSG) revealed 94% capacitance retention and 99.6% Coulombic efficiency over 5000 cycles at 4.4 A/g. abstract: The rapid demand for sustainable energy storage materials has drawn significant attention to zeolitic imidazolate framework-8 (ZIF-8). Despite its promise, the intrinsically low electrical conductivity of ZIF-8 restricts efficient charge transport, thereby limiting its overall supercapacitor (SC) performance. To overcome this drawback, ZIF-8 was hybridized with graphene oxide (GO) through an interfacial assembly strategy. The resulting GO@ZIF-8 composite electrode delivered an exceptional specific capacity of 824 F g –1 at 0.5 A g –1, far surpassing that of pristine GO (71.6 F g –1 ) and ZIF-8 (191 F g –1 ). When configured into a symmetric supercapacitor (SSC), the optimized composite achieved a capacitance of 372 mF cm –2 at 1.75 mA cm –2, while maintaining 91.1% of its initial capacity over 7000 cycles, underscoring its excellent cycling durability and demonstrating efficient surface utilization and outstanding rate capability. The device also delivered favorable energy and power densities, confirming its practical applicability. The superior electrochemical behavior arises from the synergistic combination of the high surface area and porosity of ZIF-8 with the conductive GO framework, which collectively enhances ion accessibility and charge transfer. title: Ambient‐Air Electrolyte Activation as a Simple Post‐Treatment Strategy to Enhance Graphene Supercapacitor Performance
abstract: ABSTRACT Supercapacitors based on reduced graphene oxide (rGO) are promising next‐generation energy storage devices, yet their performance remains limited by suboptimal energy storage density. Here, we report an innovative post‐treatment strategy in which residual electrolyte acid passively activates rGO electrodes simply by storage in ambient air after initial electrochemical measurements. This facile process increased the specific capacitance by 16%–39% (up to 107 F/g) without the need for additional chemical or thermal treatments. Systematic analysis revealed that the activation effect was strongly dependent on the initial oxidation level of rGO: high‐oxidation electrodes experienced pore narrowing and reduced rate capability, whereas low‐oxidation electrodes exhibited pore widening and enhanced high‐rate performance. These findings demonstrate a simple, low‐cost, and scalable approach to post‐fabrication activation of carbon‐based supercapacitors, offering a new pathway to enhance next‐generation energy storage devices.

zh_abstract: 摘要 基于还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）的超级电容器是有前途的下一代储能设备，但其性能仍然受到次优储能密度的限制。在这里，我们报告了一种创新的后处理策略，其中残余电解质酸只需在初始电化学测量后储存在环境空气中即可被动激活 rGO 电极。这种简便的工艺无需额外的化学或热处理即可将比电容提高 16%–39%（高达 107 F/g）。系统分析表明，活化效果强烈依赖于rGO的初始氧化水平：高氧化电极经历孔变窄和倍率性能降低，而低氧化电极表现出孔变宽并增强高倍率性能。这些发现展示了一种简单、低成本且可扩展的碳基超级电容器制造后激活方法，为增强下一代储能设备提供了新途径。

title: Biomass‐Derived Carbon Integrated With Activated Carbon Cloth as a Binder‐Free Carbon Architecture for Tunable Charge Storage in Asymmetric Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT Carbon architectures have attracted significant attention as binder‐free electrodes for high‐performance supercapacitors because of their excellent electrical conductivity and structural stability. Herein, a hierarchical carbon architecture was constructed by integrating biomass‐derived carbon (BMC) with activated carbon cloth (ACC) to form a self‐supported ACC/BMC electrode. The conductive ACC framework facilitates rapid electron transport, while BMC provides abundant electrochemically active sites for charge storage. In 6 M KOH electrolyte, the ACC/BMC electrode delivered a high areal capacitance of 1156.8 mF cm − 2 at 4 mA cm − 2 . Electrochemical kinetic analysis revealed a b ‐value of 0.99 and a capacitive contribution above 95%, indicating predominantly surface‐controlled charge‐storage behavior. The electrode also exhibited low charge‐transfer resistance, while XPS analysis confirmed the presence of defect sites and heteroatom‐containing functional groups that enhanced electrochemical activity. Electrolyte‐dependent investigations demonstrated superior capacitive performance in an alkaline electrolyte compared with a neutral electrolyte. Furthermore, asymmetric supercapacitors assembled using ACC/BMC as the negative electrode and either P‐doped NiMoO 4 /MoO 2 or TiN@MnO 2 as the positive electrode achieved volumetric energy densities of 4.64 and 5.61 mWh cm − 3 , respectively. These findings demonstrate the potential of ACC/BMC as a high‐performance binder‐free electrode for advanced supercapacitor applications.
zh_title: 生物质衍生碳与活性炭布集成作为无粘合剂碳结构，用于不对称超级电容器中的可调电荷存储
zh_abstract: 摘要：碳结构作为高性能超级电容器的无粘合剂电极，由于其优异的导电性和结构稳定性而引起了广泛关注。在此，通过将生物质衍生碳（BMC）与活性炭布（ACC）集成以形成自支撑ACC/BMC电极，构建了分层碳结构。导电ACC框架有利于快速电子传输，而BMC则提供丰富的电化学活性位点用于电荷存储。在 6 M KOH 电解质中，ACC/BMC 电极在 4 mA cm - 2 电流下提供 1156.8 mF cm - 2 的高面积电容。电化学动力学分析显示 b 值为 0.99，电容贡献高于 95%，表明主要是表面控制的电荷存储行为。该电极还表现出较低的电荷转移电阻，而 XPS 分析证实了缺陷位点和含杂原子官能团的存在，从而增强了电化学活性。电解质依赖性研究表明，与中性电解质相比，碱性电解质具有更优越的电容性能。此外，使用ACC/BMC作为负极和P掺杂NiMoO 4 /MoO 2 或TiN@MnO 2 作为正极组装的不对称超级电容器分别实现了4.64和5.61 mWh cm - 3 的体积能量密度。这些发现证明了 ACC/BMC 作为先进超级电容器应用的高性能无粘合剂电极的潜力。

title: Electrolyte‐Dependent Charge Storage Kinetics in Sugarcane Bagasse‐Derived Activated Carbon for Aqueous Supercapacitors
institutions: National Nuclear Energy Agency of Indonesia
abstract: ABSTRACT Although sugarcane bagasse‐derived activated carbon has been widely studied for supercapacitor electrodes, its electrolyte‐dependent charge‐storage kinetics remain less clearly understood. Herein, sugarcane bagasse‐derived activated carbon (SBAC) was prepared via precarbonization, KOH impregnation, and chemical activation under an N 2 atmosphere, and used as a model biomass‐derived carbon to examine how 2 M KOH and 2 M KCl regulate electrochemical behavior. The obtained SBAC exhibited a micropore‐dominated porous structure with a high specific surface area of 1024 m 2 g − 1 and oxygen‐containing surface functional groups. Electrochemical evaluation revealed higher capacitance in KOH (202 ± 7 F g − 1 ) than in KCl (152.7 ± 1.7 F g − 1 ) at 0.5 A g − 1 . Based on Bode plot, capacitive relaxation, and Warburg analyses, KOH provided lower solution resistance, faster capacitive relaxation, and lower diffusion resistance, enabling higher charge storage. To further validate its practical applicability, a symmetric SBAC//SBAC CR2032 cell was assembled using 2 M KOH, delivering 6.78 Wh kg − 1 and ∼94% retention after 10,000 cycles.

title: Transforming biomass to graphitic carbon: Catalytic mechanisms, structural refinement, and emerging applications
abstract: Conventional graphite production strategies-both the extraction of natural graphite and graphitization of fossil-derived carbon at temperatures of ∼3000 °C- are highly energy-intensive and contribute to environmental burden. Therefore, graphite production via decarbonization strategies is gaining traction as a means of reducing waste and supporting circular economy principles. Biomass-derived carbon exhibits amorphous or turbostratic nature based on its precursors. Through graphitization at temperatures of 2500 °C-3000 °C, its amorphous structure can be converted into highly ordered graphitic layers. Structural refinement of biomass-derived graphitic carbon can be achieved using suitable catalysts (transition metals including Fe, Ni, and Co) and optimizing processing parameters such as temperature, time, and heating methods. Structural changes achieved through graphitization enhance the functionality of biomass-derived graphitic carbon, rendering it suitable for advanced applications such as energy storage (lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries and supercapacitors), electrocatalysis (ORR, HER, and OER), electromagnetic interference shielding, and environmental remediation. In this review, we examine various methods used for achieving catalytic graphitization and the effect of different processing parameters on the structural evolution from biomass to graphitic carbon. Additionally, this review investigates the mechanism underlying graphitization and trade-off between porosity and surface area. title: Recent Advances in Carbon Cathode Materials toward High‐Performing Zinc‐Ion Hybrid Supercapacitors
institutions: Agency for Science, Technology and Research
abstract: Aqueous zinc-ion hybrid supercapacitors (ZHSCs) have emerged as promising next-generation electrochemical energy-storage devices due to their intrinsic safety, low cost, and ability to combine the high energy density of batteries with the high power density and long lifespan of supercapacitors. However, development is still in its infancy, and challenges include the limited performance of the capacitive/pseudocapacitive cathode material, whose structure and chemistry largely determine the device's energy-storage capabilities. Carbon materials, particularly porous carbons, have been extensively studied as cathode materials in ZHSCs. Recent advancements-including activated carbons, template-assisted carbons, metal-organic-framework-derived carbons, and biomass-derived carbons-have enabled significant progress in tailoring pore structures, chemical functionalities, and electronic properties to enhance zinc-ion energy storage. This review summarizes these developments, examining their synthesis methods and the design principles shaping their electrochemical behavior. Additionally, strategies of heteroatom doping and hybridization were critically evaluated, highlighting pathways to enhance electronic/ionic conductivities and pseudocapacitance. Finally, remaining challenges-including limited tunability of pore structures, incomplete mechanistic understanding, and restricted performance-were outlined, along with future directions for rational design and scalable synthesis. This review offers an updated perspective on engineering carbon cathode materials for high-performing ZHSCs a …

title: Nonwoven‐Based Textile Architectures for Energy Storage Applications: Materials, Preparation, Characterization, and Prospects
abstract: ABSTRACT The growing demand for portable electronics, electric vehicles, and wearable devices has created an urgent need for energy storage systems for flexible and sustainable applications. Nonwoven‐based textiles have recently attracted significant attention as promising platforms for such applications because of their unique features like high porosity, interconnected fiber networks, mechanical flexibility, and lightweight nature, which enable efficient ion transport, strong electrode‐electrolyte interaction, and robust device performance. This review provides a comprehensive perspective on nonwoven‐based textile materials for energy storage, focusing on materials design, fabrication strategies, characterization techniques, and potential applications. A range of material systems, including carbon fibers, conductive polymers, metal oxides, and hybrid nanocomposites are discussed, with how their integration into nonwoven frameworks can enhance electrochemical performance. Key fabrication approaches, such as electrospinning, melt‐blowing, solvent casting, phase inversion, and surface functionalization, are examined in controlling fiber morphology, porosity, and conductivity. The review explores practical applications in supercapacitors, lithium‐ion batteries, flexible electronics, and wearable energy devices, highlighting both their versatility and scalability. abstract: : Almond shell, a representative lignocellulosic biomass, is employed as a precursor to fabricate porous carbons with tunable local graphitic nanocrystalline domains and hierarchical porosity via H 2 SO 4 pretreatment followed by H 3 PO 4 activation and high-temperature pyrolysis. Comprehensive structural analyses reveal 6 M H 2 SO 4 pretreatment leads to lignin enrichment and promotes locally ordered graphitic domains, while constructing a mesopore-dominated network with a specific surface area of 1180 m 2 g -1 and mesopore fraction of 97.7%. In contrast, excessive acid pretreatment at 12 M shifts the pore structure toward smaller pores and introduces more oxygen-containing groups. In 6 M KOH aqueous electrolyte, a symmetric supercapacitor based on the best performing material AC6-600(1000) delivers high specific capacitance of 152.9 F g -1 at 1 A g -1 , retaining 83.2% of that capacitance at 20 A g -1 . It also maintains 81.1% of its initial capacitance after 100000 cycles at 10 A g -1 . A flexible, free-standing, high-mass-loading electrode (∼14.3 mg cm -2 ) fabricated from AC6-600(1000) achieves areal capacitance of 1715.2 mF cm -2 , areal energy density of 228.7 μWh cm -2 , further confirm the excellent rate capability of AC6-600(1000). Density functional theory (DFT) calculations show locally ordered carbon surfaces exhibit stronger adsorption toward K + ions, establishing a correlation between nanocrystalline order and interfacial charge storage. title: Toward the development of flexible printed electrodes on carbon cloth for solid-state supercapacitors
abstract: The important growing demand for flexible and wearable smart electronic devices has driven the urgent need for cost-effective, safe and flexible energy storage devices. In response to this challenge, we propose the development of a flexible supercapacitor based on carbon xerogel (CX) as the negative electrode and manganese dioxide (MnO 2 ) as the positive electrode, both printed onto a carbon cloth substrate. Comprehensive structural and electrochemical characterisations were performed using a combination of Raman, ATR-FTIR and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) to elucidate the relationship between the chemical structure and performance. Combined spectroscopic analysis reveals that the MnO 2 is predominantly amorphous with short-range α-MnO 2 -like ordering and a mixed of Mn 4+ /Mn 3+ sites associated with Mn structural defects and oxygen vacancies. These mixed-valence centres promote fast, reversible surface redox reactions, thereby enhancing pseudocapacitive charge storage while preserving structural stability during cycling. The resulting device demonstrates superior performance, with a high specific capacitance of 580 mF·cm −2 and an energy density of 261 μWh·cm −2 at a power density of 2 mW·cm −2 . However, lower performances were observed when the flexible electrodes were assembled into free-standing devices. Furthermore, the fabricated devices were subjected to various mechanical and flexibility tests while powering a ring-shaped LED module containing 30 LEDs integrated into a lab-coat textile. The two devices in series maintained stable illumination for 50 s wi …
