title: Azaisoindigo and Triphenylamine-Based Hybrid Material: Design, Carbon Nanotube Decoration, and Supercapacitor Applications Using a PA-NI Gel Electrolyte
abstract: Supercapacitors are widely regarded as highly promising energy-storage devices owing to their high capacitance, excellent power density, and outstanding long-term cycling stability. Moreover, flexible and binder-free nanomaterials play a crucial role in the development of advanced supercapacitor devices and systems. Herein, we report AIG-TPA2-SWCNT, a donor–acceptor–donor hybrid that integrates azaisoindigo (AIG) and triphenylamine (TPA) with single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs). The AIG-TPA2 material was hybridized with SWCNTs for the first time, and the resulting AIG-TPA2-SWCNT hybrid was employed as a flexible, free-standing supercapacitor electrode using a polyphosphoric acid (PA) and nonionic surfactant (NI)-based gel electrolyte. The hybrid electrode demonstrated remarkable supercapacitor performance and energy-storage properties with an excellent power density of 5000 W kg −1, a maximum energy density of 3.38 Wh kg −1 at 0.1 A g −1 and a maximum specific capacitance of 112 F g −1 at 0.1 mV s −1 . Regarding the galvanostatic charge−discharge (GCD) results, 10,000-cycle stability was achieved with a coulombic efficiency about 100%. These findings highlight the potential of AIG-TPA2 and SWCNT-based hybrid materials as flexible and bendable electrodes for energy storage.
zh_title: 基于氮杂靛蓝和三苯胺的混合材料：使用 PA-NI 凝胶电解质的设计、碳纳米管装饰和超级电容器应用
zh_abstract: 超级电容器因其高电容量、优异的功率密度和出色的长期循环稳定性而被广泛认为是极具前景的储能器件。此外，柔性且无粘合剂的纳米材料在先进超级电容器器件和系统的开发中发挥着至关重要的作用。在此，我们报告了 AIG-TPA2-SWCNT，一种将氮杂靛蓝（AIG）和三苯胺（TPA）与单壁碳纳米管（SWCNT）集成的供体-受体-供体杂化物。 AIG-TPA2材料首次与SWCNT混合，所得AIG-TPA2-SWCNT混合材料采用多磷酸（PA）和非离子表面活性剂（NI）基凝胶电解质作为柔性、独立式超级电容器电极。该混合电极表现出卓越的超级电容器性能和储能特性，功率密度高达5000 W kg -1 ，0.1 A g -1 下的最大能量密度为3.38 Wh kg -1 ，0.1 mV s -1 下的最大比电容为112 F g -1 。关于恒电流充放电 (GCD) 结果，实现了 10,000 次循环稳定性，库仑效率约为 100%。这些发现凸显了 AIG-TPA2 和基于 SWCNT 的混合材料作为柔性可弯曲电极用于储能的潜力。

title: In situ electrodeposition of nickel cobalt sulfide/double hydroxide heterostructure on carbon cloth as a binder-free electrode for supercapacitors
abstract: Construction of heterostructure free-standing electrodes with excellent electrochemical performance has become a hot-spot direction for supercapacitor (SC) application recently. However, the preparation of core-shell heterostructure via traditional hydrothermal or chemical bath deposition usually suffers from process complexity and time-consuming. To improve the efficiency, here, a simple two-step electrodeposition is applied to construct nickel cobalt sulfide/double hydroxide core-shell heterostructure on carbon cloth (CC) (denoted as NCS@NCOH/CC) to serve as a binder-free electrode for supercapacitors. Benefited from the high conductivity of NCS layer and nanoporous microstructure of NCOH layer as well as the high capacitances of them, the resultant NCS@NCOH/CC electrode can deliver a specific capacitance of 805.0 F g −1 at 3 A g −1 , which can maintain 571 F g −1 at 30 A g −1 , corresponding to a retention rate of 70.9%. When successively charging and discharging under 10 A g −1 for 7000 cycles, a capacitance retention of 77.5% can be obtained, demonstrating its good cycling performance. This work presents a feasible strategy for assembling NCS@NCOH heterostructure by electrodeposition as a binder-free electrode for energy storage devices.
zh_title: 碳布上原位电沉积镍钴硫化物/双氢氧化物异质结构作为超级电容器无粘合剂电极
zh_abstract: 构建具有优异电化学性能的异质结构自支撑电极已成为近年来超级电容器（SC）应用的热点方向。然而，通过传统的水热或化学浴沉积制备核壳异质结构通常工艺复杂且耗时。为了提高效率，这里采用简单的两步电沉积在碳布（CC）（表示为NCS@NCOH/CC）上构建镍钴硫化物/双氢氧化物核壳异质结构，作为超级电容器的无粘合剂电极。受益于NCS层的高电导率和NCOH层的纳米多孔微结构以及它们的高电容，所得到的NCS@NCOH/CC电极在3 A g -1 下可以提供805.0 F g -1 的比电容，在30 A g -1 下可以保持571 F g -1 ，对应于70.9%的保留率。在10 A g -1 下连续充放电7000次循环时，电容保持率为77.5%，表现出良好的循环性能。这项工作提出了一种通过电沉积组装NCS@NCOH异质结构作为储能装置的无粘合剂电极的可行策略。

title: Free-Standing Boron-Doped Graphene Hydrogel Buckypaper Fabricated via Zinc-Plate Reduction for High-Performance Supercapacitors
abstract: High Resolution Image Download MS PowerPoint Slide Graphene offers exceptional mechanical flexibility and superior electrical conductivity that are highly desirable for next-generation supercapacitors; however, its intrinsic strong π–π stacking interactions severely hinder energy-storage performance by blocking active redox sites and restricting ion-accessible pathways. To address these limitations, we developed a binder-free, free-standing, boron-doped graphene hydrogel buckypaper with a hierarchical architecture. In this study, a mixed suspension of thermally activated boron-doped expanded graphene (BT-rGO) and graphene oxide (GO) was integrated via a redox reaction using a Zn plate as a substrate, enabling the instantaneous fabrication of a free-standing BT-rGO/Zn-rGO hydrogel buckypaper. The boron-doped graphene framework exhibits enhanced wettability, facilitating efficient electrolyte ion transportation, while the heteroatom-induced uneven charge distribution modulates the local electronegativity and improves electroconductivity throughout the free-standing hydrogel buckypaper network. The electrochemically enhanced E-BT-rGO 3 /Zn-rGO 1 hydrogel buckypaper (BT-rGO:GO mass ratio = 3:1) delivers a high specific capacitance of 443.63 F g –1 at 2 mA cm –2 and maintains 88% capacitance retention after 10,000 cycles at 50 mA cm –2 . title: Bio‐Guided Synthesis of Bimetallic Organic Frameworks for Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT The development of green and sustainable advanced energy storage materials represents an urgent demand in the energy sector. Conventional synthesis methods often struggle to simultaneously achieve both high metal content and dispersion of metal particles, while also being associated with high energy consumption and environmental pollution. To address this challenge, this study proposes a novel strategy of plant as a green factory guided synthesis, utilizing the aquatic plant Myriophyllum Aquaticum as a living reactor. By leveraging its intrinsic physiological processes, a bimetallic metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) hybrid precursor is synthesized in situ within the stems via stepwise absorption and ion exchange, realizing a plant self‐driven synthesis of MOFs in plant. Furthermore, by exploiting the bio‐confinement effect provided by the plant's natural channels and the structural confinement inherent to the MOF, the precursor is converted through controlled pyrolysis into nitrogen‐doped carbon‐supported composites with bimetal or bimetallic compounds. When NiCo/nitrogen‐doped porous carbon is used as the negative electrode material and NiCoO x /nitrogen‐doped porous carbon as the positive electrode material, the synthesized materials deliver high specific capacitances of 237.8 F·g −1 and 257.6 C·g −1 , respectively. title: Synergistic fabrication of nitrogen-doped hierarchical porous carbons from lavender straw for high-performance supercapacitor applications
abstract: In this study, we propose a novel synergistic activation-doping method to produce nitrogen-doped activated carbon(LNAC) from lavender straw, a renewable biomass source. By activating the material with potassium hydroxide and doping it with nitrogen via melamine at 800 °C, we achieved a high specific surface area of 1648.78 m 2 /g and a nitrogen content of 9.75%. The LNAC features a well-organized hierarchical pore structure that facilitates rapid ion transport, enhancing its electrochemical performance. Electrochemical tests showed that, in a three-electrode setup, the material delivered a specific capacitance of 635.1 F/g at a current density of 1 A/g. Furthermore, when used in a coin-type symmetric supercapacitor with a 6 M KOH electrolyte, it achieved an impressive energy density of 13.69 Wh/kg at a power density of 498 W/kg. This outstanding performance is attributed to the combined effects of an optimized pore structure, which enhances the electric double-layer capacitance(EDLC), and the significant pseudocapacitance contributed by 45.75% pyrrolic nitrogen. Additionally, graphitic nitrogen improves electrical conductivity, accelerating charge transfer. Our approach offers a sustainable and environmentally friendly solution for transforming agricultural waste into high-performance electrode materials, addressing both waste management challenges and the increasing demand for advanced energy storage technologies.

title: ZIF-derived nitrogen-doped carbon/silicon composites for asymmetric lithium-ion capacitors
abstract: Lithium-ion capacitors (LICs) are attracting interest as energy storage devices that bridge the gap between batteries and supercapacitors, offering both high energy and power density. However, the challenge lies in developing electrode materials that can combine high capacity with long-term stability. Silicon, despite its high theoretical capacity, suffers from severe volume changes during cycling, while traditional carbon materials are stable but often lack sufficient capacity. Herein, a ZIF-8-derived nitrogen-doped porous carbon (NPC) framework was employed as a conductive scaffold to stabilize silicon nanoparticles (Si NPs) for high-capacity anodes. Si NPs were incorporated into the porous NPC network via solvothermal treatment and anchored by subsequent pyrolysis, producing an NPC/Si composite in which NPC serves as the N-doped carbon matrix and a continuous electron pathway. In the NPC/Si anode composite, the micropore-dominated porosity and mechanical flexibility of NPC provide ion-accessible voids to buffer silicon volume expansion upon lithiation and sustain a robust carbon–silicon contact during cycling, nitrogen doping enhances electronic conductivity and interfacial affinity, and silicon contributes high lithium-storage capacity. These features together enable enhancing electrode stability and capacity retention. The NPC/Si anode electrode with 8.7% silicon content delivered 1053 mAh g −1 at 0.1 A g −1 and sustained 230 mAh g −1 after 1000 cycles at 5 A g −1 . title: Regulating MXene Functionalization and Oxidation for High‐Rate, High Mass‐Loading Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT Unlocking the commercial potential of MXene electrodes in high‐energy supercapacitors requires overcoming a fundamental limitation: severe performance decay at increased electrode thickness and mass loading. This work resolves the intrinsic trade‐off between surface functionalization and oxidation in MXene chemistry regulation by constructing a controlled redox environment. A urea‐assisted hydrothermal process effectively removes inert –F terminations while inducing the formation of a 3D MXene hydrogel enriched with –N active sites. Concurrently, L‐ascorbic acid is introduced as an antioxidant to suppress structural oxidation and enhance stability. As a result, the optimized MXene exhibits superior rate capability and long‐term cycling stability under high mass loadings. Specifically, at 10.97 mg cm −2 , a high specific capacitance of 597 F g −1 is achieved at 1 A g −1 , with 69.66% retention at 50 A g −1 , significantly outperforming that of pristine MXene (23.44%) and N‐doped MXene (59.03%). Even at an ultrahigh loading of 108.64 mg cm −2 , 44.50% of the capacitance is retained (from 564 F g −1 to 251 F g −1 ) over the current density range of 1 to 20 A g −1 . This work establishes an effective strategy for designing high‐performance MXene‐based electrodes via reaction pathway regulation, enabling practical operation at commercially relevant mass loadings.

title: Structural Power Composites Based on High Mass Loading Zn‐Ion Hybrid Supercapacitors with Metal Mesh Current Collectors and Aramid Nanofiber/Glass Fiber Composite Electrolytes
institutions: Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics
abstract: ABSTRACT A multifunctional electrode design is proposed for structural power composites (SPCs) by integrating high‐mass‐loading Zn‐ion hybrid supercapacitor (ZHSC) components with stainless steel (SS) mesh current collectors. A combined wet–dry processing route was developed to overcome fabrication challenges in thick electrodes, such as compositional inhomogeneity and drying‐induced cracking. The resulting freestanding activated carbon (AC) films were thermally laminated onto SS mesh to form ACSS electrodes with strong interfacial adhesion and improved electrical conductivity. A complementary ZnSS electrode was fabricated by calendering Zn foil onto SS mesh, enhancing mechanical robustness and electrical properties. The electrodes were assembled on opposite sides of an aramid nanofiber/glass fiber (ANFGF) composite electrolyte and subsequently protonated to enable strong interfacial bonding through the ANF network. The resulting ZHSC‐SPC device demonstrates capacitive charge storage, with areal capacitance scaling linearly with electrode stacking while retaining gravimetric performance. The device delivers a specific capacitance of 72.2 F g −1 , areal capacitance of 1284.3 mF cm −2 , energy density of 516 µWh cm −2 , and power density of 6.2 mW cm −2 , with 76% retention after 500 cycles. Mechanical tests confirm high performance, with a tensile strength of 114 MPa and an elastic modulus of 2.8 GPa, demonstrating suitability for structural energy storage applications.

zh_abstract: 摘要：通过将高质量负载锌离子混合超级电容器（ZHSC）组件与不锈钢（SS）网状集电器集成，提出了一种用于结构功率复合材料（SPC）的多功能电极设计。开发了一种湿-干相结合的加工路线，以克服厚电极的制造挑战，例如成分不均匀性和干燥引起的开裂。将所得的独立式活性炭 (AC) 薄膜热层压到 SS 网上，形成具有强界面粘附力和改善导电性的 ACSS 电极。通过将锌箔压延到不锈钢网上来制造互补的 ZnSS 电极，从而增强机械强度和电气性能。将电极组装在芳族聚酰胺纳米纤维/玻璃纤维（ANFGF）复合电解质的相对两侧，随后质子化以通过ANF网络实现强界面结合。由此产生的 ZHSC-SPC 器件展示了电容性电荷存储，面积电容随电极堆叠呈线性缩放，同时保持重量性能。该器件的比电容为72.2 F g -1 ，面积电容为1284.3 mF cm -2 ，能量密度为516 µWh cm -2 ，功率密度为6.2 mW cm -2 ，500次循环后保留率为76%。机械测试证实了其高性能，拉伸强度为 114 MPa，弹性模量为 2.8 GPa，证明了其适用于结构储能应用。

title: Advances in carbon architectures for high-performance supercapacitors: Challenges and future perspectives
institutions: PSG INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY AND APPLIED RESEARCH
abstract: The increasing demand for rapid-charging, long-life energy storage in electric mobility, wearable electronics, and grid systems has expedited the development of supercapacitors. Carbon-based electrodes continue to lead the field due to their tunable porosity, high conductivity, and structural stability. However, challenges such as low energy density, sluggish ion transport in thick electrodes, and restacking of low-dimensional nanocarbons remain major bottlenecks. While much research focuses on understanding charge-storage mechanisms and improving carbon architectures, there is limited discussion of functionalization strategies, the role of heteroatoms, and the integration of carbon-based pseudocapacitive components into scalable devices. This review provides a critical overview of recent advancements in carbon electrode engineering strategies from the last two to three years. The discussions link structure–property relationships across zero- to three-dimensional architectures, highlighting transformative approaches such as hierarchical pore design, binder-free architecture, and flexible device integration. This review also covers sustainable carbon sources, scalable fabrication routes, and synergy between electric double-layer and pseudocapacitive contributions. Additionally, we analyze key scientific and manufacturing challenges, particularly emerging directions toward high-mass-loading electrodes and next-generation flexible supercapacitors. By presenting a unified roadmap, this review aims to advance sustainable, high-energy carbon-based supercapacitor technologies and  …

zh_abstract: 电动汽车、可穿戴电子产品和电网系统对快速充电、长寿命储能的需求不断增长，加速了超级电容器的发展。碳基电极由于其可调节的孔隙率、高电导率和结构稳定性而继续引领该领域。然而，低能量密度、厚电极中离子传输缓慢以及低维纳米碳的重新堆叠等挑战仍然是主要瓶颈。虽然许多研究都集中在理解电荷存储机制和改进碳结构上，但对功能化策略、杂原子的作用以及将碳基赝电容元件集成到可扩展设备中的讨论却很有限。这篇综述对过去两三年碳电极工程策略的最新进展进行了批判性概述。这些讨论将零维到三维架构的结构-性能关系联系起来，强调了分层孔隙设计、无粘合剂架构和灵活的器件集成等变革性方法。本综述还涵盖了可持续碳源、可扩展的制造路线以及双电层和赝电容贡献之间的协同作用。此外，我们还分析了关键的科学和制造挑战，特别是大质量负载电极和下一代柔性超级电容器的新兴方向。通过提出统一的路线图，本次审查旨在推进可持续、高能碳基超级电容器技术和……

title: Magnetically Induced Ordered Structure‐Assisted Defect Engineering Strategy for High‐Performance All‐Pseudocapacitive Film Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT Film supercapacitors, due to their light weight and good flexibility, are ideal power sources for wearable electronic devices. However, due to the limited research on pseudocapacitive film electrode materials, achieving high energy density for film supercapacitor remains a challenge. Here, the film anode (Fe@Fe 3 O 4 /CNTs) and cathode (NiCo‐NiCo compound/CNTs) were prepared by the vacuum filtration technology. Density functional theory calculations combined with experimental results revealed that oxygen vacancies can induce the formation of dense localized charge aggregation regions at the Fe/Fe 3 O 4 interface, significantly enhancing the charge transfer rate in electrochemical reactions, enabling the anode to achieve a specific capacity of 7.88 F cm −2 (749.1 C g −1 ) at a high mass loading of 16.7 mg cm −2 . Meanwhile, after introducing oxygen vacancies, the adhesion energy at the interface significantly increased, enhancing the binding strength between Fe and Fe 3 O 4 , making it less prone to peeling due to current shock during long‐term charge and discharge cycles, thereby improving the cycling stability of the Fe‐based anode (76% capacitance retention after 20 000 cycles). The all‐pseudocapacitive film supercapacitor successfully assembled obtains an excellent energy density of 1.362 mWh cm −2 (122.5 Wh kg −1 ) at a total mass loading of 27.8 mg cm −2 , far exceeding previously reported values.
zh_title: 高性能全赝电容薄膜超级电容器的磁致有序结构辅助缺陷工程策略
zh_abstract: 摘要 薄膜超级电容器由于重量轻、柔韧性好，是可穿戴电子设备的理想电源。然而，由于赝电容薄膜电极材料的研究有限，实现薄膜超级电容器的高能量密度仍然是一个挑战。这里，通过真空过滤技术制备了薄膜阳极（Fe@Fe 3 O 4 /CNTs）和阴极（NiCo-NiCo化合物/CNTs）。密度泛函理论计算结合实验结果表明，氧空位可以诱导Fe/Fe 3 O 4 界面处形成致密的局域电荷聚集区域，显着提高电化学反应中的电荷转移速率，使阳极在16.7 mg cm -2 的高质量负载下实现7.88 F cm -2 (749.1 C g -1 )的比容量。同时，引入氧空位后，界面处的粘附能显着增加，增强了Fe与Fe 3 O 4 之间的结合强度，使其在长期充放电循环中不易因电流冲击而发生剥离，从而提高了铁基负极的循环稳定性（20 000次循环后电容保持率为76%）。成功组装的全赝电容薄膜超级电容器在27.8 mg cm -2 的总质量负载下获得了1.362 mWh cm -2 (122.5 Wh kg -1 )的优异能量密度，远远超过了之前报道的值。

title: Synergistic Integration of Redox‐Active Deep Eutectic Gel Electrolyte and Hierarchical CNT@ZIF‐Derived Porous Carbon for Advanced Micro‐Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT The progression of miniaturized energy storage solutions necessitates the harmonious integration of high energy density, mechanical flexibility, and environmental resilience. In this study, we introduce a high‐performance quasi‐solid‐state micro‐supercapacitor (MSC) that utilizes a synergistic design approach: a redox‐active hybrid deep eutectic solvent (HDES) gel electrolyte in conjunction with a hierarchically structured carbon nanotube coated with ZIF‐8‐derived porous carbon electrode (designated as CNT@ZFC). The optimized electrolyte formulated from LiClO 4 , dimethyl sulfoxide, water, and K 3 [Fe(CN) 6 ] delivers a high ionic conductivity (1.4 mS cm −1 ) and a broad electrochemical stability window (2.5 V), facilitating rapid ion transport and stable redox reactions. Complementing this, the CNT@ZFC electrode provides a robust electron‐conductive framework with a high surface area, ensuring maximum accessibility to electroactive sites. The resulting MSC achieves a superior areal capacitance of 26.04 mF cm −2 at 0.2 mA cm −2 , a maximum energy density of 0.015 mWh cm −2 , and an exceptional stability of 97.3% retention. Notably, the device demonstrates remarkable environmental adaptability, maintaining stable electrochemical performance down to −20°C. This work provides a scalable strategy for integrating redox‐enhanced DES electrolytes with conductive hybrid carbon architectures to advance the next generation of robust, high‐energy miniaturized power sources.
zh_title: 用于先进微型超级电容器的氧化还原活性深共晶凝胶电解质和多级CNT@ZIF衍生多孔碳的协同集成
zh_abstract: 摘要 小型化储能解决方案的发展需要高能量密度、机械灵活性和环境适应能力的和谐结合。在这项研究中，我们介绍了一种高性能准固态微型超级电容器（MSC），它采用协同设计方法：氧化还原活性混合深共晶溶剂（HDES）凝胶电解质与涂有ZIF-8衍生的多孔碳电极（指定为CNT@ZFC）的分层结构碳纳米管相结合。由LiClO 4 、二甲基亚砜、水和K 3 [Fe(CN) 6 ]配制而成的优化电解质具有高离子电导率（1.4 mS cm -1 ）和宽电化学稳定性窗口（2.5 V），有利于快速离子传输和稳定的氧化还原反应。作为补充，CNT@ZFC 电极提供了具有高表面积的强大电子传导框架，确保了电活性位点的最大可及性。由此产生的MSC在0.2 mA cm -2 下实现了26.04 mF cm -2 的优异面积电容、0.015 mWh cm -2 的最大能量密度以及97.3%保留率的卓越稳定性。值得注意的是，该器件表现出卓越的环境适应性，在低至-20°C的温度下仍能保持稳定的电化学性能。这项工作提供了一种可扩展的策略，将氧化还原增强型 DES 电解质与导电混合碳结构相集成，以推进下一代强大的高能小型电源。

title: Examining paper-based laser-induced graphene and its δ-MnO2 nanocomposite for flexible solid-state supercapacitors: Towards the powering of sustainable and disposable electronics
abstract: Paper-based laser-induced graphene (paper-LIG) was employed as a sustainable and low-cost electrode for the development of flexible all-solid-state micro-supercapacitors (MSCs). The CO 2 laser scribing generates a porous, conductive 3D multilayered graphene network directly on cellulose paper substrates, eliminating the need for inks, transfer steps or binders. When assembled with a PVA:LiClO 4 gel polymer electrolyte in symmetric configuration, paper-LIG electrodes delivered a capacitance of ∼2.0 mF/cm 2 at 18.5 μA/cm 2 , governed primarily by electric double-layer charge storage. To improve energy density, a conformal pseudocapacitive coating of δ-MnO 2 nanostructures was electrodeposited onto the LIG scaffold. This composite MSC exhibited an increased capacitance of ∼50 mF/cm 2 , corresponding to an energy density of 6 μWh/cm 2 , while maintaining a maximum power above 0.1 mW/cm 2 . Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and temperature-dependent measurements confirmed that ionic transport within the polymer electrolyte rather than electrode kinetics, is the dominant factor limiting device performance. This detailed and systematic comparison between carbon-based and pseudocapacitive paper-LIG architectures highlights both the promise of δ-MnO 2 -functionalized LIG for boosting energy density, the mechanisms beyond its cycling aging and the critical role of electrolyte in the MSCs performance. These findings provide design guidelines for scalable, disposable energy storage solutions compatible with emerging flexible and wearable electronic platforms. • Laser-induced graph …

title: Flower-like MoS2/graphene nanocomposite for scalable fabrication of high-performance flexible all-solid-state asymmetric micro-supercapacitor
abstract: Micro-supercapacitors are crucial for integrating energy storage into increasingly complex electronic systems, e.g., consumer and wearable electronics, which require appropriate miniaturization. We report here a scalable and cost-effective process to produce an all-solid-state asymmetric micro-supercapacitor based on nanostructured flower-like MoS 2 /graphene cathode and activated carbon anode. The MoS 2 /graphene nanocomposites were synthesized via a hydrothermal method, leveraging the synergistic effect of pseudocapacitive MoS 2 and highly conductive graphene to enhance electrode capacitance and cycling stability. Facile bar-coating and laser cutting techniques were employed to fabricate the asymmetric micro-supercapacitor. The device has a stable operating voltage of 1.6 V, and achieves an impressive area capacitance of 183.7 mF cm −2 , and a maximum area energy density of 65.3 mWh cm −2 , which is the highest areal energy density among MoS 2 -based micro-supercapacitors. In addition, the device exhibits outstanding cycling durability with 94% capacitance retention after 10,000 charge−discharge cycles. The electrochemical performance remains stable under various bending conditions, demonstrating the device's exceptional mechanical flexibility, thereby advancing its practical application as a power source in next-generation wearable technologies.
zh_title: 花状MoS2/石墨烯纳米复合材料用于可扩展制造高性能柔性全固态不对称微型超级电容器
zh_abstract: 微型超级电容器对于将能量存储集成到日益复杂的电子系统中至关重要，例如消费类和可穿戴电子产品，这些系统需要适当的小型化。我们在这里报告了一种可扩展且具有成本效益的工艺，用于生产基于纳米结构花状 MoS 2 /石墨烯阴极和活性炭阳极的全固态不对称微型超级电容器。通过水热法合成了MoS 2 /石墨烯纳米复合材料，利用赝电容MoS 2 和高导电石墨烯的协同效应来增强电极电容和循环稳定性。采用简便的棒涂和激光切割技术来制造不对称微型超级电容器。该器件具有1.6 V的稳定工作电压，并实现了令人印象深刻的183.7 mF cm -2 的面积电容和65.3 mWh cm -2 的最大面积能量密度，这是MoS 2 基微型超级电容器中最高的面积能量密度。此外，该器件还表现出出色的循环耐久性，在 10,000 次充放电循环后电容保持率为 94%。电化学性能在各种弯曲条件下保持稳定，展示了该设备卓越的机械灵活性，从而推进了其作为下一代可穿戴技术电源的实际应用。

title: In-Situ anchoring of amorphous NixB nanoparticles onto Nb2CTx MXene nanosheets for high-performance asymmetric supercapacitors
abstract: An amorphous nickel boride/niobium carbide MXene (Ni x B/Nb 2 CT x ) composite was designed and synthesized via a combined HF-assisted etching and in-situ chemical reduction strategy. The uniform anchoring of 0D Ni x B nanoparticles within the multilayered Nb 2 CT x nanosheets led to the formation of a robust composite with favorable interfacial interactions, abundant active sites, and improved charge transport pathways. The composite was directly coated on carbon cloth, which served as a flexible and conductive substrate to ensure efficient electron collection and mechanical stability of the electrode, while not contributing to electrochemical capacitance. Detailed structural and electrochemical analyses indicate that the integration of Ni x B with Nb 2 CT x influences the electronic environment, improves redox activity, and promotes ion diffusion, thereby contributing to enhanced charge storage kinetics. Among the as-prepared samples, the optimized Ni x B/Nb 2 CT x -50 electrode delivers a specific capacitance of 606.7 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 , demonstrating a moderate rate capability with a capacitance retention of 43.2% from 1 to 20 A g −1 . Furthermore, an asymmetric supercapacitor assembled with Ni x B/Nb 2 CT x -50 and reduced graphene oxide (rGO) electrodes achieved a remarkable energy density of 46.7 Wh kg −1 at a power density of 825 W kg −1 . This work provides new insights into the interfacial engineering of amorphous transition metal boride-MXene hybrids toward next-generation high energy density supercapacitor applications.

zh_abstract: 通过结合高频辅助蚀刻和原位化学还原策略，设计并合成了非晶硼化镍/碳化铌 MXene (Ni x B/Nb 2 CT x ) 复合材料。 0D Ni x B 纳米粒子均匀锚定在多层 Nb 2 CT x 纳米片内，形成了坚固的复合材料，具有良好的界面相互作用、丰富的活性位点和改进的电荷传输路径。该复合材料直接涂覆在碳布上，碳布作为柔性导电基材，以确保电极的有效电子收集和机械稳定性，同时不增加电化学电容。详细的结构和电化学分析表明，Ni x B 与 Nb 2 CT x 的结合影响电子环境，提高氧化还原活性，并促进离子扩散，从而有助于增强电荷存储动力学。在所制备的样品中，优化的Ni x B/Nb 2 CT x -50 电极在1 A g -1 下的比电容为606.7 F g -1 ，表现出中等倍率性能，从1到20 A g -1 的电容保持率为43.2%。此外，由Ni x B/Nb 2 CT x -50和还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）电极组装的不对称超级电容器在825 W kg -1 的功率密度下实现了46.7 Wh kg -1 的显着能量密度。这项工作为下一代高能量密度超级电容器应用的非晶过渡金属硼化物-MXene 混合材料的界面工程提供了新的见解。

title: Intercalation effect of mono and divalent metal cations into Ti3C2Tx layers electrode for high performance asymmetric coin cell supercapacitors
abstract: Metal cation intercalation is an effective strategy for enhancing the ion transport properties of layered Ti₃C₂Tₓ MXene electrodes. In this study, multilayered Ti₃C₂Tₓ was intercalated with monovalent (K + , Li + , and Na + ) and divalent (Mg 2+ , Zn 2+ , and Fe 2+ ) metal ions via a simple wet-chemical etching and stirring process, followed by the fabrication of coin-cell asymmetric supercapacitors. Structural characterization confirmed successful intercalation and revealed that K + ions induced the large expansion of the Ti₃C₂Tₓ interlayer spacing, as evidenced by the shift of the (002) diffraction peak from 8.47° to 7.05°. The enhanced performance is attributed to the low hydration energy of K + , which facilitates efficient desolvation and rapid ion transport within the MXene galleries. Consequently, the K + -intercalated Ti₃C₂Tₓ electrode exhibited a high specific capacitance of 808.5 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 in a three-electrode configuration. A K + -Ti₃C₂Tₓ//activated carbon coin-cell asymmetric supercapacitor achieved a specific capacitance of 42.5 F g −1 , an energy density of 23.3 Wh kg −1 , and a maximum power density of 1281.9 W kg −1 , while retaining 81.3% of its initial capacitance after 10,000 charge–discharge cycles. These results demonstrate that K + intercalation effectively enhances the electrochemical performance of Ti₃C₂Tₓ and offers a practical approach for developing high-performance MXene-based energy storage devices.

zh_abstract: 金属阳离子嵌入是增强层状 Ti3C2T3 MXene 电极离子传输性能的有效策略。在这项研究中，通过简单的湿化学蚀刻和搅拌工艺，多层Ti₃C2Tₓ嵌入一价（K + 、Li + 和Na + ）和二价（Mg 2+ 、Zn 2+ 和Fe 2+ ）金属离子，然后制造纽扣电池不对称超级电容器。结构表征证实了成功的插层，并揭示了 K + 离子引起 Ti3C2T3 层间距的大幅膨胀，（002）衍射峰从 8.47° 移动到 7.05° 证明了这一点。性能的增强归因于 K + 的低水合能，这有利于 MXene 通道内的高效去溶剂化和快速离子传输。因此，K + 插入的Ti 3 C 2 T 3 电极在三电极结构中在1 A g -1 下表现出808.5 F g -1 的高比电容。 K + -Ti₃C2Tₓ//活性炭纽扣电池非对称超级电容器的比电容为42.5 F g −1 ，能量密度为23.3 Wh kg −1 ，最大功率密度为1281.9 W kg −1 ，同时在10,000次充放电循环后仍保留其初始电容的81.3%。这些结果表明，K + 嵌入有效增强了 Ti₃C2Tₓ 的电化学性能，并为开发高性能 MXene 基储能器件提供了一种实用方法。

abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid development of smart equipment and emerging energy technologies demands structural components that are lightweight, mechanically robust, energy‐dense, and geometrically versatile. Yet load‐bearing electrochemical energy‐storage devices remain constrained by the challenge of simultaneously improving electrode activity and ion/electron transport while maintaining mechanical robustness. Here, we report a low‐cost 3D printing strategy for the integrated fabrication of load‐bearing Zn‐ion hybrid supercapacitors using functional core–shell continuous carbon fiber prepreg filaments, where “fully 3D‐printed” refers to the one‐step additive manufacturing of the structural framework (electrodes and electrolyte matrix) followed by necessary post‐printing treatments (supercritical foaming and gelation) to activate electrochemical performance. On the electrode side, supercritical fluid‐assisted laser‐induced graphitization converts continuous carbon fiber bundles into hierarchical porous graphene cathodes, delivering a 2.4‐fold increase in areal capacitance over conventional LIG electrodes. On the electrolyte side, a biphasic PP/PVA semi‐solid electrolyte is engineered by supercritical foaming to construct interconnected open ion‐transport channels, increasing the ionic conductivity from 0.5 to 4.2 mS cm − 1 . Together, these designs enable fully 3D‐printed continuous fiber devices with integrated mechanical load‐bearing and electrochemical energy‐storage functions. However, current methods employed for the deposition of active materials onto textiles show substantial inconsistency, leading to varying electrochemical performance in ESDs, thereby limiting their applicability. institutions: Parc Científic de la Universitat de València
Centro de Investigación y de Estudios Avanzados del Instituto Politécnico Nacional
abstract: The transition to renewable energy systems requires sustainable, high-performance energy storage materials. Here, we report a simple and scalable layer-by-layer assembly strategy to fabricate hybrid supercapacitor electrodes composed of lignin, multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs), and Mn 2 C MXene, followed by controlled carbonization. Lignin, an abundant and renewable by-product of the pulp and paper industry, serves as a low-cost carbon precursor, enabling a circular and sustainable approach to electrode design. Carbonization at 900 K converts lignin into a conductive, graphitized carbon matrix while maintaining MXene's electrochemical functionality, resulting in a hierarchical architecture that suppresses MXene restacking and facilitates rapid ion and electron transport. The optimized electrode delivers a high specific capacitance of 186.7 F g −1 , representing a more than seven-fold improvement compared with non‑carbonized electrodes, along with an energy density of 6.48 Wh kg −1 at a power density of 2.33 kW kg −1 . Excellent cycling stability is achieved, with 87.7% capacitance retention after 1000 charge–discharge cycles. These results demonstrate the potential of lignin-derived MXene composites as sustainable and high-performance electrode materials for advanced supercapacitors, supporting the development of affordable and clean energy storage technologies in alignment with United Nations Sustainable Development Goal 7.

zh_abstract: 向可再生能源系统的过渡需要可持续的高性能储能材料。在这里，我们报告了一种简单且可扩展的逐层组装策略，用于制造由木质素、多壁碳纳米管（MWCNT）和Mn 2 C MXene组成的混合超级电容器电极，然后进行受控碳化。木质素是纸浆和造纸工业的一种丰富且可再生的副产品，可作为低成本的碳前体，实现电极设计的循环和可持续方法。 900 K 下的碳化可将木质素转化为导电的石墨化碳基质，同时保持 MXene 的电化学功能，从而形成分层结构，抑制 MXene 重新堆积并促进快速离子和电子传输。优化后的电极具有186.7 F g -1 的高比电容，与非碳化电极相比提高了七倍以上，功率密度为2.33 kW kg -1 时能量密度为6.48 Wh kg -1 。实现了出色的循环稳定性，1000 次充放电循环后电容保持率为 87.7%。这些结果证明了木质素衍生的 MXene 复合材料作为先进超级电容器的可持续和高性能电极材料的潜力，支持开发负担得起的清洁能源存储技术，符合联合国可持续发展目标 7。

title: Unlocking Native Defects in Carbon Fibers via Helical Strain Engineering for High‐Performance Stretchable Supercapacitors
abstract: Abstract Carbon fiber's (CF) inherent chemical inertness limits its use in wearable energy textiles. This study introduces an innovative helical strain engineering strategy to activate CF's latent electrochemical activity by controllably generating cross‐sectional defects. This low‐energy, scalable mechanical process induces programmable microfracture, creating high‐performance, burr‐enriched CF yarns (CFYs) for stretchable supercapacitors. Controlled twisting coupled with pre‐stretched polyurethane and polyester fibers formed native microdefects with exposed active edge sites and an interconnected 3D conductive network. The optimized CFY4 substrate exhibited ultra‐low resistivity (0.22 Ω·cm), 40% reversible stretchability, and a burr density of 6.51%. Additionally, in situ polymerization of polypyrrole (PPy) on CFY4 produced a pseudocapacitive electrode (CFY4@PPy) with a mass‐specific capacitance of 141.41 F g −1 at 0.3 A g −1 , which was 2.5 times higher compared to pristine CF@PPy. The assembled symmetric yarn‐based supercapacitor achieved a wide voltage window of 2.5 V, high energy density of 53.94 Wh kg −1 at 500 W kg −1 , cyclic voltammetry curve stability under 30% tensile conditions. Successful demonstrations powering LEDs, sensors, and wearables confirm practical viability. This work provides a new paradigm in carbon material engineering while demonstrating how controlled mechanical deformation can unlock the hidden electrochemical potential of CF for next‐generation wearable energy textiles.
zh_title: 通过高性能可拉伸超级电容器的螺旋应变工程解锁碳纤维的固有缺陷
zh_abstract: 摘要 碳纤维（CF）固有的化学惰性限制了其在可穿戴能源纺织品中的应用。这项研究引入了一种创新的螺旋应变工程策略，通过可控地产生横截面缺陷来激活CF的潜在电化学活性。这种低能耗、可扩展的机械工艺可引发可编程微断裂，从而为可拉伸超级电容器创造高性能、毛刺丰富的 CF 纱线 (CFY)。受控扭曲与预拉伸的聚氨酯和聚酯纤维相结合，形成了具有暴露的活性边缘位点和互连的 3D 导电网络的原生微缺陷。优化后的CFY4基板表现出超低电阻率（0.22 Ω·cm）、40%可逆拉伸性和6.51%的毛刺密度。此外，聚吡咯（PPy）在CFY4上的原位聚合产生了赝电容电极（CFY4@PPy），在0.3 A g -1 时质量比电容为141.41 F g -1 ，比原始CF@PPy高2.5倍。组装的对称纱线基超级电容器实现了2.5 V的宽电压窗口、500 W kg -1 下53.94 Wh kg -1 的高能量密度、30%拉伸条件下循环伏安曲线的稳定性。为 LED、传感器和可穿戴设备供电的成功演示证实了实际可行性。这项工作提供了碳材料工程的新范例，同时展示了受控机械变形如何释放碳纤维隐藏的电化学潜力，用于下一代可穿戴能源纺织品。

title: Enhanced Supercapacitor Performance through Morphology Engineering of CNC-Derived Chiral Nematic Activated Carbon Aerogels
institutions: Basque Center for Materials, Applications and Nanostructures
abstract: Cellulose nanocrystals (CNCs) are of great interest for electrochemical energy storage systems owing to their large surface area, intriguing self-assembly, renewability, and surface functionality. The chiral nematic organization of CNCs enables free-standing, hierarchical electrode materials that upon carbonization can be used in supercapacitors. KOH-activated carbon aerogels from chiral nematic CNCs have been reported previously in the literature, but the optimization of their nanostructure for performance enhancement has not yet been explored. In this context, this article reports the use of a factorial experimental design process to systematically tune the morphology and porosity of these aerogels. Through careful manipulation of fabrication conditions assisted by Design of Experiments (DOE), aerogels with specific surface areas from 300 to 1600 m 2 g –1 and micropore volumes of 30–70% are achieved, and the sample-to-sample variance in surface area has been decreased by an order of magnitude in comparison to previous work. The influence of these morphological features on specific capacitance and cycling stability of aerogel-based supercapacitor electrodes is explored, and the effect of chiral nematic organization is demonstrated. This systematic study─the first in the literature to investigate pore structure optimization in CNC-based aerogel electrodes─offers a blueprint for advances in electrode materials design for future energy storage applications.

zh_abstract: 纤维素纳米晶体（CNC）由于其大表面积、有趣的自组装、可再生性和表面功能而在电化学储能系统中引起了极大的兴趣。 CNC 的手性向列组织使得独立式分层电极材料在碳化后可用于超级电容器。之前的文献中已经报道过来自手性向列 CNC 的 KOH 活性炭气凝胶，但尚未探索其纳米结构的优化以增强性能。在这种情况下，本文报告了使用析因实验设计过程来系统地调整这些气凝胶的形态和孔隙率。通过在实验设计 (DOE) 的协助下仔细控制制造条件，获得了比表面积为 300 至 1600 m 2 g –1 和微孔体积为 30-70% 的气凝胶，并且与之前的工作相比，样品间的表面积差异已降低了一个数量级。探讨了这些形态特征对气凝胶基超级电容器电极的比电容和循环稳定性的影响，并证明了手性向列组织的影响。这项系统研究是文献中首次研究基于 CNC 的气凝胶电极的孔隙结构优化，为未来储能应用的电极材料设计的进步提供了蓝图。

title: Advanced Functional Materials Research: Paving the Way for Technological Innovation and Beyond
abstract: The evolution of human civilization has always been driven by technological innovation, which in turn fundamentally relies on advancements in materials. From the Stone Age to the Mechanical Age and finally to the Electronic and Information Ages, every leap forward in human progress has stemmed from breakthroughs in materials science and engineering. As we are now transitioning from the Information Age to the Artificial Intelligence Age, increasingly stringent requirements are being placed on the development of advanced functional materials. In particular, materials with exceptional multifunctionality, sustainability, and adaptability to complex environments are becoming particularly important. Meeting these challenges requires continuous exploration in the field of functional materials through the integration of innovative manufacturing methods, advanced characterization techniques, and intelligent computational tools. This integration can deepen our understanding of material properties and help design and develop novel materials, thereby supporting the technological advancements in fields such as optics, electronics, energy, catalysis, biomedicine, and sensors. Therefore, extensive efforts have been devoted to exploring and advancing functional materials to meet the needs of next-generation technologies and sustainable development. Against this backdrop, international conferences have become important platforms for sharing innovative ideas and promoting collaborations among global researchers in various fields. Through these exchanges, the global materials community can jo …
zh_title: 先进功能材料研究：为技术创新及超越铺平道路
zh_abstract: 人类文明的演进始终由技术创新驱动，而技术创新从根本上依赖于材料的进步。从石器时代到机械时代，再到电子信息时代，人类进步的每一次飞跃都源于材料科学与工程的突破。当前，我们正从信息时代转向人工智能时代，对先进功能材料的开发提出了越来越严格的要求。特别是具有卓越多功能性、可持续性和复杂环境适应性的材料变得尤为重要。应对这些挑战需要通过集成创新制造方法、先进表征技术和智能计算工具，在功能材料领域不断探索。这种集成可以加深我们对材料特性的理解，帮助设计和开发新型材料，从而支持光学、电子、能源、催化、生物医学和传感器等领域的技术进步。因此，人们致力于探索和推进功能材料，以满足下一代技术和可持续发展的需求。在此背景下，国际会议已成为全球各领域研究人员分享创新思想、促进合作的重要平台。通过这些交流，全球材料界可以……

abstract: We are pleased to introduce this Special Issue on Nano-Energy Materials, published in Advanced Energy Materials, as a collective effort from multi-disciplinary faculty at Peking University. They are actively pursuing cutting-edge research in the following areas: 1) nanomaterials and micro-nano …

zh_abstract: 我们很高兴地向您介绍这期纳米能源材料特刊，该特刊由北京大学多学科教师共同努力发表在《先进能源材料》上。我们也借此机会庆祝材料科学与工程系（MSE）成立十周年。 MSE是在2005年北京大学工学院重建一年后，由陈十一院长和王中林教授发起的。当时，它被命名为先进材料与纳米技术系，其使命是促进新兴先进材料及相关技术的科学研究，而不是传统材料。在CoE和北京大学其他学院（化学、物理、信息学院）的支持下，我们的MSE在过去的十年里在各个方面都取得了成功的发展。在严格的招聘标准和终身教职制度下，MSE教员人数稳步增长，目前已达到17人，预计几年后将达到25人。教师大多具有长期在国外从事研究或教学的经历，大部分是教育部长江学者、国家自然科学基金委杰出青年基金、国家自然科学基金委优秀青年等知名基金或人才计划获得者，近期引进的教师均是国家青年千人计划获得者。他们正在以下领域积极开展前沿研究：1）纳米材料和微纳……

title: KOH activation of carbon-based materials for energy storage
abstract: Because of their availability, adjustable microstructure, varieties of forms, and large specific surface area, porous carbon materials are of increasing interest for use in hydrogen storage adsorbents and electrode materials in supercapacitors and lithium–sulfur cells from the viewpoint of social sustainability and environmental friendliness. Therefore, much effort has been made to synthesize and tailor the microstructures of porous carbon materials via various activation procedures (physical and chemical activation). In particular, the chemical activation of various carbon sources using KOH as the activating reagent is very promising because of its lower activation temperature and higher yields, and well-defined micropore size distribution and ultrahigh specific surface area up to 3000 m2 g−1 of the resulting porous carbons. In this feature article, we will cover recent research progress since 2007 on the synthesis of KOH-activated carbons for hydrogen and electrical energy storage (supercapacitors and lithium–sulfur batteries). The textural properties and surface chemistry of KOH-activated carbons depend on not only the synthesis parameters, but also different carbon sources employed including fossil/biomass-derived materials, synthetic organic polymers, and various nanostructured carbons (e.g. carbon nanotubes, carbon nanofibers, carbon aerogels, carbide-derived carbons, graphene, etc.). Following the introduction to KOH activation mechanisms and processing technologies, the characteristics and performance of KOH-activated carbons as well as their relationships are summa …
zh_title: 用于储能的碳基材料的 KOH 活化
zh_abstract: 由于其可用性、可调节的微观结构、多种形式和大的比表面积，从社会可持续发展和环境友好的角度来看，多孔碳材料在超级电容器和锂硫电池的储氢吸附剂和电极材料中的应用越来越受到关注。因此，人们付出了很多努力来通过各种活化程序（物理和化学活化）来合成和定制多孔碳材料的微观结构。特别是，使用KOH作为活化剂对各种碳源进行化学活化非常有前景，因为它具有较低的活化温度和较高的产率，并且所得多孔碳具有明确的微孔尺寸分布和高达3000 m2 g−1的超高比表面积。在这篇专题文章中，我们将介绍自 2007 年以来用于氢和电能存储（超级电容器和锂硫电池）的 KOH 活性炭合成的最新研究进展。 KOH活性炭的结构特性和表面化学不仅取决于合成参数，还取决于所使用的不同碳源，包括化石/生物质衍生材料、合成有机聚合物和各种纳米结构碳（例如碳纳米管、碳纳米纤维、碳气凝胶、碳化物衍生碳、石墨烯等）。介绍了KOH活化机理和加工技术，总结了KOH活性炭的特性、性能以及它们之间的关系……

title: High power electrochemical capacitors based on carbon nanotube electrodes
abstract: Carbon nanotube sheet electrodes have been prepared from catalytically grown carbon nanotubes of high purity and narrow diameter distribution, centered around 80 Å. Our study shows that the electrodes are free-standing mats of entangled nanotubes with an open porous structure almost impossible to obtain with activated carbon or carbon fiber. These properties are highly desirable for high power and long cycle life electrochemical capacitors. Specific capacitances of 102 and 49 F/g were measured at 1 and 100 Hz, respectively, on a single cell device with 38 wt % H2SO4 as the electrolyte. The same cell had a power density of &gt;8000 W/kg.

zh_title: 基于碳纳米管电极的高功率电化学电容器
zh_abstract: 碳纳米管片电极由催化生长的高纯度碳纳米管和窄直径分布（中心在 80 埃左右）制备而成。我们的研究表明，电极是独立的缠结纳米管垫，具有开孔结构，几乎不可能用活性炭或碳纤维获得。这些特性对于高功率和长循环寿命的电化学电容器来说是非常理想的。在以 38 wt% H2SO4 作为电解质的单电池装置上，在 1 Hz 和 100 Hz 下测得的比电容分别为 102 和 49 F/g。相同的电池具有＞8000W/kg的功率密度。

title: Graphene-based materials for supercapacitor electrodes – A review
abstract: The graphene-based materials are promising for applications in supercapacitors and other energy storage devices due to the intriguing properties, i.e. , highly tunable surface area, outstanding electrical conductivity, good chemical stability and excellent mechanical behavior. This review summarizes recent development on graphene-based materials for supercapacitor electrodes, based on their macrostructural complexity, i.e. , zero-dimensional (0D) (e.g. free-standing graphene dots and particles), one-dimensional (1D) (e.g. fiber-type and yarn-type structures), two-dimensional (2D) (e.g. graphenes and graphene-based nanocomposite films), and three-dimensional (3D) (e.g. graphene foam and hydrogel-based nanocomposites). There are extensive and on-going researches on the rationalization of their structures at varying scales and dimensions, development of effective and low cost synthesis techniques, design and architecturing of graphene-based materials, as well as clarification of their electrochemical performance. It is indicated that future studies should focus on the overall device performance in energy storage devices and large-scale process in low costs for the promising applications in portable and wearable electronic, transport, electrical and hybrid vehicles.
zh_title: 用于超级电容器电极的石墨烯基材料——综述
zh_abstract: 由于石墨烯基材料具有高度可调的表面积、出色的导电性、良好的化学稳定性和优异的机械性能，因此在超级电容器和其他储能设备中的应用前景广阔。本文根据其宏观结构的复杂性，即零维（0D）（例如独立的石墨烯点和颗粒）、一维（1D）（例如纤维型和纱线型结构）、二维（2D）（例如石墨烯和石墨烯基纳米复合材料薄膜）和三维（3D），总结了用于超级电容器电极的石墨烯基材料的最新进展。 （例如石墨烯泡沫和水凝胶基纳米复合材料）。人们对不同尺度和尺寸的结构合理化、开发有效且低成本的合成技术、石墨烯基材料的设计和构建以及阐明其电化学性能进行了广泛且持续的研究。这表明未来的研究应集中在储能器件的整体性能和低成本的大规模工艺上，以实现在便携式和可穿戴电子、运输、电动和混合动力汽车等领域的有前景的应用。

title: Preparation of Highly Conductive Graphene Hydrogels for Fabricating Supercapacitors with High Rate Capability
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
abstract: Graphene hydrogels prepared via hydrothermal reduction of graphene oxide dispersions (GH-Hs) were further reduced with hydrazine (Hz) or hydroiodic acid (HI) to improve their conductivities. The chemically reduced graphene hydrogels possess high conductivities of 1.3–3.2 S m –1, which are 1 order of magnitude higher than that of a GH-H (0.3 S m –1 ). The supercapacitor based on the Hz-reduced GH-H exhibited a high specific capacitance of 220 F g –1 at 1 A g –1, and this capacitance can be maintained for 74% as the discharging current density was increased up to 100 A g –1 . Furthermore, it showed high power density and long cycle life. The high-performances of this supercapacitor make it promising for high rate charge/discharge applications.
zh_title: 用于制造高倍率超级电容器的高导电石墨烯水凝胶的制备
zh_abstract: 通过水热还原氧化石墨烯分散体（GH-Hs）制备的石墨烯水凝胶进一步用肼（Hz）或氢碘酸（HI）还原以提高其电导率。化学还原石墨烯水凝胶具有1.3-3.2 S m –1 的高电导率，比GH-H (0.3 S m –1 )高1个数量级。基于赫兹降低的GH-H的超级电容器在1 A g –1 时表现出220 F g –1 的高比电容，并且当放电电流密度增加到100 A g –1 时，该电容可以保持74%。此外，它还表现出高功率密度和长循环寿命。这种超级电容器的高性能使其有望用于高倍率充电/放电应用。

title: Towards ultrahigh volumetric capacitance: graphene derived highly dense but porous carbons for supercapacitors
abstract: A small volumetric capacitance resulting from a low packing density is one of the major limitations for novel nanocarbons finding real applications in commercial electrochemical energy storage devices. Here we report a carbon with a density of 1.58 g cm(-3), 70% of the density of graphite, constructed of compactly interlinked graphene nanosheets, which is produced by an evaporation-induced drying of a graphene hydrogel. Such a carbon balances two seemingly incompatible characteristics: a porous microstructure and a high density, and therefore has a volumetric capacitance for electrochemical capacitors (ECs) up to 376 F cm(-3), which is the highest value so far reported for carbon materials in an aqueous electrolyte. More promising, the carbon is conductive and moldable, and thus could be used directly as a well-shaped electrode sheet for the assembly of a supercapacitor device free of any additives, resulting in device-level high energy density ECs.
zh_title: 迈向超高体积电容：石墨烯衍生的高密度多孔碳用于超级电容器
zh_abstract: 低堆积密度导致的小体积电容是新型纳米碳在商业电化学储能装置中实际应用的主要限制之一。在这里，我们报道了一种密度为1.58 g cm(-3)的碳，是石墨密度的70%，由紧密互连的石墨烯纳米片构成，它是通过石墨烯水凝胶的蒸发诱导干燥产生的。这种碳平衡了两个看似不相容的特性：多孔微结构和高密度，因此电化学电容器（EC）的体积电容高达376 F cm(-3)，这是迄今为止报道的水性电解质中碳材料的最高值。更有前途的是，碳具有导电性和可成型性，因此可以直接用作形状良好的电极片，用于组装超级电容器器件，无需任何添加剂，从而产生器件级高能量密度EC。

title: Hydrous Ruthenium Oxide Nanoparticles Anchored to Graphene and Carbon Nanotube Hybrid Foam for Supercapacitors
abstract: In real life applications, supercapacitors (SCs) often can only be used as part of a hybrid system together with other high energy storage devices due to their relatively lower energy density in comparison to other types of energy storage devices such as batteries and fuel cells. Increasing the energy density of SCs will have a huge impact on the development of future energy storage devices by broadening the area of application for SCs. Here, we report a simple and scalable way of preparing a three-dimensional (3D) sub-5 nm hydrous ruthenium oxide (RuO2) anchored graphene and CNT hybrid foam (RGM) architecture for high-performance supercapacitor electrodes. This RGM architecture demonstrates a novel graphene foam conformally covered with hybrid networks of RuO2 nanoparticles and anchored CNTs. SCs based on RGM show superior gravimetric and per-area capacitive performance (specific capacitance: 502.78 F g(-1), areal capacitance: 1.11 F cm(-2)) which leads to an exceptionally high energy density of 39.28 Wh kg(-1) and power density of 128.01 kW kg(-1). The electrochemical stability, excellent capacitive performance, and the ease of preparation suggest this RGM system is promising for future energy storage applications.
zh_title: 用于超级电容器的水合氧化钌纳米颗粒锚定在石墨烯和碳纳米管混合泡沫上
zh_abstract: 在现实生活中，超级电容器（SC）通常只能与其他高能量存储设备一起用作混合系统的一部分，因为与电池和燃料电池等其他类型的能量存储设备相比，其能量密度相对较低。提高SC的能量密度将拓宽SC的应用领域，对未来储能设备的发展产生巨大影响。在这里，我们报告了一种简单且可扩展的方法，用于制备用于高性能超级电容器电极的三维（3D）亚5纳米水合氧化钌（RuO2）锚定石墨烯和碳纳米管混合泡沫（RGM）架构。这种 RGM 架构展示了一种新型石墨烯泡沫，其共形地覆盖有 RuO2 纳米颗粒和锚定碳纳米管的混合网络。基于RGM的SC表现出优异的重量和单位面积电容性能（比电容：502.78 F g(-1)，面积电容：1.11 F cm(-2)），从而实现39.28 Wh kg(-1)的极高能量密度和128.01 kW kg(-1)的功率密度。电化学稳定性、优异的电容性能和易于制备表明该 RGM 系统在未来的储能应用中具有广阔的前景。

title: Ultrathin MnO2 nanofibers grown on graphitic carbon spheres as high-performance asymmetric supercapacitor electrodes
abstract: Growing MnO2 nanofibers on graphitic hollow carbon spheres (GHCS) is conducted by refluxing GHCS in a KMnO4 aqueous solution aimed to enhance the electrochemically active surface area of MnO2. The stoichiometric redox reaction between GHCS and MnO4− yields GHCS–MnO2 composites with controllable MnO2 content. It is found that these ultrathin MnO2 nanofibers are vertically grown on the external surface of the GHCS, yielding a composite electrode showing good electron transport, rapid ion penetration, fast and reversible Faradic reaction, and excellent rate performance when used as supercapacitor electrode materials. An asymmetric supercapacitor cell with GHCS–MnO2 as the positive electrode and GHCS as the negative electrode can be reversibly charged/discharged at a cell voltage of 2.0 V in a 1.0 mol L−1 Na2SO4 aqueous electrolyte, delivering an energy density of 22.1 Wh kg−1 and a power density of 7.0 kW kg−1. The asymmetric supercapacitor exhibits an excellent electrochemical cycling stability with 99% initial capacitance and 90% coulombic efficiency remained after 1000 continuous cycles measured using the galvanostatic charge–discharge technique.
zh_title: 在石墨碳球上生长的超薄 MnO2 纳米纤维作为高性能不对称超级电容器电极
zh_abstract: 通过在 KMnO4 水溶液中回流 GHCS 来在石墨空心碳球 (GHCS) 上生长 MnO2 纳米纤维，旨在增强 MnO2 的电化学活性表面积。 GHCS 和 MnO4− 之间的化学计量氧化还原反应产生具有可控 MnO2 含量的 GHCS-MnO2 复合材料。研究发现，这些超细MnO2纳米纤维在GHCS的外表面上垂直生长，产生的复合电极在用作超级电容器电极材料时表现出良好的电子传输、快速的离子渗透、快速可逆的法拉第反应以及优异的倍率性能。以GHCS-MnO2为正极、GHCS为负极的非对称超级电容器电池可以在1.0 mol L−1 Na2SO4水电解质中以2.0 V的电池电压可逆充电/放电，提供22.1 Wh kg−1的能量密度和7.0 kW kg−1的功率密度。该非对称超级电容器表现出优异的电化学循环稳定性，使用恒电流充放电技术测量连续循环1000次后，初始电容仍为99%，库仑效率仍为90%。

title: Review of nanostructured carbon materials for electrochemical capacitor applications: advantages and limitations of activated carbon, carbide‐derived carbon, zeolite‐templated carbon, carbon aerogels, carbon nanotubes, onion‐like carbon, and graphene
journal: Wiley Interdisciplinary Reviews Energy and Environment
abstract: Electric double layer capacitors, also called supercapacitors, ultracapacitors, and electrochemical capacitors, are gaining increasing popularity in high power energy storage applications. Novel carbon materials with high surface area, high electrical conductivity, as well as a range of shapes, sizes and pore size distributions are being constantly developed and tested as potential supercapacitor electrodes. This article provides an overview of the electrochemical studies on activated carbon, carbide derived carbon, zeolite‐templated carbon, carbon aerogel, carbon nanotube, onion‐like carbon, and graphene. We discuss the key performance advantages and limitations of various nanostructured carbon materials and provide an overview of the current understanding of the structure–property relationships related to the transport and adsorption of electrolyte ions on their surfaces, specific and volumetric capacitance, self‐discharge, cycle life, electrolyte stability, and others. We discuss the impact of microstructural defects, pore size distribution, pore tortuosity, chemistry and functional groups on the carbon surface, nanoscale curvature, and carbon‐electrolyte interfacial energy. Finally, we review state‐of‐the art commercial large scale applications of supercapacitors, including their use in smart grids and distributed energy storage, hybrid electric and electric vehicles, energy efficient industrial equipment, ships, wind power stations, uninterruptible power supplies, power backup, and consumer devices. zh_title: 用于电化学电容器应用的纳米结构碳材料综述：活性炭、碳化物衍生碳、沸石模板碳、碳气凝胶、碳纳米管、洋葱状碳和石墨烯的优点和局限性
zh_abstract: 双电层电容器，也称为超级电容器、超级电容器和电化学电容器，在高功率储能应用中越来越受欢迎。具有高表面积、高电导率以及各种形状、尺寸和孔径分布的新型碳材料正在不断开发和测试，作为潜在的超级电容器电极。本文概述了活性炭、碳化物衍生碳、沸石模板碳、碳气凝胶、碳纳米管、洋葱状碳和石墨烯的电化学研究。我们讨论了各种纳米结构碳材料的关键性能优势和局限性，并概述了目前对其表面电解质离子传输和吸附、比电容和体积电容、自放电、循环寿命、电解质稳定性等结构-性能关系的理解。我们讨论了微观结构缺陷、孔径分布、孔隙扭曲度、碳表面化学和官能团、纳米级曲率和碳电解质界面能的影响。最后，我们回顾了超级电容器最先进的商业大规模应用，包括其在智能电网和分布式储能、混合动力电动和电动汽车、节能工业设备、船舶、风力发电站、不间断电源、备用电源和消费设备中的应用。 《电线能源环境》2014 年，3：424–473。 doi：10.1002/wene.102 这篇文章……

title: Electrode materials for aqueous asymmetric supercapacitors
institutions: Collaborative Innovation Center of Chemistry for Energy Materials
abstract: An asymmetric supercapacitor (ASC) is a supercapacitor based on two different electrode materials. One electrode is based on redox (Faradic) reactions with or without non-faradic reactions, and the other one is mostly based on electric double-layer (non-Faradic or electrostatic) absorption/desportion. Aqueous electrolytes have higher ionic conductivity, larger capacitance and better safety than the organic electrolytes. Herein, some key electrode materials for aqueous ASCs are primarily reviewed, which provide a new direction for power sources to have higher energy density at high power densities, compared with traditional capacitors. Their negative electrode materials include carbonaceous materials (porous carbons, carbon nanotubes and graphene), oxides (V2O5 and MoO3) and their composites, and their positive electrode materials include carbonaceous materials, oxides (RuO2, MnO2, MoO3, V2O5, PbO2, Co3O4), Ni(OH)2, intercalation compounds (LiCoO2, LiMn2O4, Li[NiCoMn]1/3O2, NaMnO2 and KMnO2). We describe the latest work on these electrode materials, and a particular focus is directed to the fabrication and electrochemical performance of various nanostructured electrode materials and some assembled ASCs. Finally, the future trends and prospects on advanced energy storage materials are suggested.
zh_title: 水性不对称超级电容器电极材料
zh_abstract: 非对称超级电容器（ASC）是基于两种不同电极材料的超级电容器。一种电极基于具有或不具有法拉第反应的氧化还原（法拉第）反应，另一种电极主要基于电双层（非法拉第或静电）吸收/放出。水系电解质比有机电解质具有更高的离子电导率、更大的电容和更好的安全性。本文主要综述了水性ASCs的一些关键电极材料，为电源在高功率密度下比传统电容器具有更高的能量密度提供了新的方向。其负极材料包括碳质材料（多孔碳、碳纳米管和石墨烯）、氧化物（V2O5和MoO3）及其复合材料，正极材料包括碳质材料、氧化物（RuO2、MnO2、MoO3、V2O5、PbO2、Co3O4）、Ni（OH）2、插层化合物（LiCoO2、LiMn2O4、 Li[NiCoMn]1/3O2、NaMnO2 和 KMnO2）。我们描述了这些电极材料的最新工作，特别关注各种纳米结构电极材料和一些组装的 ASC 的制造和电化学性能。最后，对先进储能材料的未来发展趋势和前景进行了展望。

title: 3D Printed Graphene Based Energy Storage Devices
abstract: 3D printing technology provides a unique platform for rapid prototyping of numerous applications due to its ability to produce low cost 3D printed platforms. Herein, a graphene-based polylactic acid filament (graphene/PLA) has been 3D printed to fabricate a range of 3D disc electrode (3DE) configurations using a conventional RepRap fused deposition moulding (FDM) 3D printer, which requires no further modification/ex-situ curing step. To provide proof-of-concept, these 3D printed electrode architectures are characterised both electrochemically and physicochemically and are advantageously applied as freestanding anodes within Li-ion batteries and as solid-state supercapacitors. These freestanding anodes neglect the requirement for a current collector, thus offering a simplistic and cheaper alternative to traditional Li-ion based setups. Additionally, the ability of these devices' to electrochemically produce hydrogen via the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) as an alternative to currently utilised platinum based electrodes (with in electrolysers) is also performed. The 3DE demonstrates an unexpectedly high catalytic activity towards the HER (-0.46 V vs. SCE) upon the 1000th cycle, such potential is the closest observed to the desired value of platinum at (-0.25 V vs. SCE). We subsequently suggest that 3D printing of graphene-based conductive filaments allows for the simple fabrication of energy storage devices with bespoke and conceptual designs to be realised.
zh_title: 3D 打印石墨烯储能装置
zh_abstract: 3D 打印技术由于能够生产低成本 3D 打印平台，因此为众多应用的快速原型制作提供了独特的平台。在此，使用传统的 RepRap 熔融沉积成型 (FDM) 3D 打印机对基于石墨烯的聚乳酸长丝（石墨烯/PLA）进行 3D 打印，以制造一系列 3D 圆盘电极（3DE）配置，无需进一步修改/异位固化步骤。为了提供概念验证，这些 3D 打印电极结构具有电化学和物理化学特征，并且可以有利地用作锂离子电池内的独立阳极和固态超级电容器。这些独立式阳极忽略了对集电器的要求，从而为传统的锂离子设置提供了一种简单且更便宜的替代方案。此外，这些装置还具有通过析氢反应（HER）以电化学方式产生氢气的能力，作为当前使用的铂基电极（在电解槽中）的替代品。在第 1000 个循环时，3DE 显示出对 HER 的出乎意料的高催化活性（-0.46 V vs. SCE），这种电势是观察到的最接近铂所需值（-0.25 V vs. SCE）的。随后，我们建议基于石墨烯的导电丝的 3D 打印可以通过定制和概念设计来简单制造能量存储设备。

title: Layered Graphene Oxide Nanostructures with Sandwiched Conducting Polymers as Supercapacitor Electrodes
abstract: We demonstrate a general approach to the preparation of layered graphene oxide structures with sandwiched conducting polymers of different morphologies. The approach is conceptualized on the basis of the electrostatic interactions between negatively charged graphene oxide sheets and positively charged surfactant micelles. A graphene oxide-polypyrrole composite prepared from this approach exhibited an excellent electrocapacitive performance with a high specific capacitance over 500 F g(-1). Good rate performance and cycle ability were realized by the composite electrode. The simple method described here opens up a generalized route to making a wide range of graphene oxide-based and graphene-based composite materials for applications beyond electrochemical energy storage.
zh_title: 夹层导电聚合物的层状氧化石墨烯纳米结构作为超级电容器电极
zh_abstract: 我们展示了一种制备具有不同形态夹层导电聚合物的层状氧化石墨烯结构的通用方法。该方法的概念是基于带负电的氧化石墨烯片和带正电的表面活性剂胶束之间的静电相互作用。通过该方法制备的氧化石墨烯-聚吡咯复合材料表现出优异的电电容性能，比电容超过500 F g(-1)。该复合电极实现了良好的倍率性能和循环性能。这里描述的简单方法开辟了一条通用途径，用于制造各种氧化石墨烯基和石墨烯基复合材料，用于电化学储能以外的应用。

title: Sustainable nitrogen-doped porous carbon with high surface areas prepared from gelatin for supercapacitors
institutions: China University of Mining and Technology
abstract: Gelatin, a renewable animal derivative composed of various proteins, was used as a precursor for nitrogen-doped porous carbon with high surface areas for supercapacitors for the first time. The preparation procedure is very simple, including the carbonization of gelatin under inert atmosphere, followed by NaOH activation of the carbonized char at 600 °C for 1 h. The porosity and surface chemistry of the carbon depend strongly on the weight ratio of NaOH/char, with the specific surface area and nitrogen content varying between 323 and 3012 m2 g−1 and between 0.88 and 9.26 at%, respectively. The unique microstructure and nitrogen functionalities enable the carbon to exhibit a high capacitance of up to 385 F g−1 in 6 mol L−1 KOH aqueous electrolytes, attributed to the co-contribution of double layer capacitance and pseudo-capacitance. It also shows excellent rate capability (235 F g−1 remained at 50 A g−1) and cycle durability, making it a promising electrode material for supercapacitors.
zh_title: 由明胶制备的具有高表面积的可持续氮掺杂多孔碳，用于超级电容器
zh_abstract: 明胶是一种由多种蛋白质组成的可再生动物衍生物，首次被用作超级电容器高表面积氮掺杂多孔碳的前体。制备过程非常简单，包括在惰性气氛下碳化明胶，然后在600℃下用NaOH活化碳化炭1小时。碳的孔隙率和表面化学很大程度上取决于NaOH/炭的重量比，比表面积和氮含量分别在323和3012 m2 g−1之间变化以及在0.88和9.26 at%之间变化。独特的微观结构和氮功能使碳在6 mol L−1 KOH水电解质中表现出高达385 F g−1的高电容，这归因于双层电容和赝电容的共同贡献。它还表现出优异的倍率性能（235 F g−1 保持在 50 A g−1）和循环耐久性，使其成为超级电容器的有前途的电极材料。

title: High-performance flexible supercapacitors based on electrochemically tailored three-dimensional reduced graphene oxide networks
institutions: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Mohali
Institute of Nano Science and Technology
abstract: Abstract A simple approach for growing porous electrochemically reduced graphene oxide (pErGO) networks on copper wire, modified with galvanostatically deposited copper foam is demonstrated. The as-prepared pErGO networks on the copper wire are directly used to fabricate solid-state supercapacitor. The pErGO-based supercapacitor can deliver a specific capacitance (C sp ) as high as 81±3 F g −1 at 0.5 A g −1 with polyvinyl alcohol/H 3 PO 4 gel electrolyte. The C sp per unit length and area are calculated as 40.5 mF cm −1 and 283.5 mF cm −2 , respectively. The shape of the voltammogram retained up to high scan rate of 100 V s −1 . The pErGO-based supercapacitor device exhibits noticeably high charge-discharge cycling stability, with 94.5% C sp retained even after 5000 cycles at 5 A g −1 . Nominal change in the specific capacitance, as well as the shape of the voltammogram, is observed at different bending angles of the device even after 5000 cycles. The highest energy density of 11.25 W h kg −1 and the highest power density of 5 kW kg −1 are also achieved with this device. The wire-based supercapacitor is scalable and highly flexible, which can be assembled with/without a flexible substrate in different geometries and bending angles for illustrating promising use in smart textile and wearable device.
zh_title: 基于电化学定制三维还原氧化石墨烯网络的高性能柔性超级电容器
zh_abstract: 摘要 展示了一种在铜线上生长多孔电化学还原氧化石墨烯 (pErGO) 网络的简单方法，并用恒电流沉积的泡沫铜进行了修改。铜线上制备的 pErGO 网络直接用于制造固态超级电容器。基于pErGO的超级电容器在使用聚乙烯醇/H 3 PO 4 凝胶电解质时可以在0.5 A g -1 下提供高达81±3 F g -1 的比电容（C sp ）。每单位长度和面积的C sp 分别计算为40.5 mF cm -1 和283.5 mF cm -2 。伏安图的形状保持到100V s -1 的高扫描速率。基于pErGO的超级电容器装置表现出极高的充放电循环稳定性，即使在5 A g -1 下循环5000次后仍保留94.5%的C sp 。即使在 5000 次循环后，在器件的不同弯曲角度下仍可观察到比电容的标称变化以及伏安图的形状。该器件还实现了11.25 W h kg -1 的最高能量密度和5 kW kg -1 的最高功率密度。基于线的超级电容器具有可扩展性和高度柔性，可以在有/没有柔性基板的情况下以不同的几何形状和弯曲角度进行组装，以展示其在智能纺织品和可穿戴设备中的应用前景。

title: Biomass-derived carbon electrode materials for supercapacitors
abstract: This review provides a summary of recent research progress towards biomass-derived carbon electrode materials, including specific cellulose-, lignin- and hemicellulose-derived carbon electrode materials, for supercapacitors.

zh_abstract: 本综述总结了超级电容器用生物质衍生的碳电极材料的最新研究进展，包括特定的纤维素、木质素和半纤维素衍生的碳电极材料。

title: Biomass-Derived Carbon Fiber Aerogel as a Binder-Free Electrode for High-Rate Supercapacitors
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
abstract: A flexible carbon fiber aerogel with a very high surface area for supercapacitor application is reported by carbonization and chemical activation of low-cost natural cotton with KOH. The carbon fibers in the aerogel present as a twisted and tubular structure. Depending on the amount of KOH used in the activation process, the specific surface area of aerogels ranges from 1536 to 2436 m 2 g –1, while their electrical conductivity remains ∼860 S m –1 . In spite of pore size in the range of 1.0–4.0 nm and pore volume mainly contributed by micropores, the carbon aerogel exhibits a high specific capacitance of 283 F g –1 (1 A g –1 ) in 6 M KOH aqueous electrolyte and retains a high capacitance retention of 224 F g –1 at current density up to 100 A g –1 . Importantly, a symmetric capacitor built with the aerogel electrodes exhibits a rather small time constant (0.56 s). The superior capacitive performance of a CF electrode is closely related to its distinct structural advantage. The tubular carbon fibers that are several millimeters in length offer ultralong electronic and ionic pathways, while plenty of nanopores on the fiber walls created by KOH activation enable fast ion transport across the walls. Our results demonstrate that capacitive performance of the traditional microporous carbon, which is characterized by poor ion kinetics, can be significantly enhanced by properly engineering the electrode architecture.
zh_title: 生物质衍生碳纤维气凝胶作为高倍率超级电容器的无粘合剂电极
zh_abstract: 通过用 KOH 对低成本天然棉进行碳化和化学活化，报道了一种具有非常高表面积的柔性碳纤维气凝胶，可用于超级电容器应用。气凝胶中的碳纤维呈现为扭曲的管状结构。根据活化过程中使用的 KOH 量，气凝胶的比表面积范围为 1536 至 2436 m 2 g –1，而其电导率保持为 ∼860 S m –1 。尽管孔径在1.0-4.0 nm范围内且孔体积主要由微孔贡献，但碳气凝胶在6 M KOH水性电解质中表现出283 F g –1 (1 A g –1 )的高比电容，并在电流密度高达100 A g –1时保持224 F g –1的高电容保持率。重要的是，用气凝胶电极构建的对称电容器表现出相当小的时间常数（0.56 s）。 CF电极优越的电容性能与其独特的结构优势密切相关。长度为几毫米的管状碳纤维提供超长的电子和离子通道，而纤维壁上由 KOH 活化产生的大量纳米孔可实现快速离子跨壁传输。我们的结果表明，传统微孔碳的电容性能具有较差的离子动力学特征，通过正确设计电极结构可以显着增强其电容性能。

title: Interaction between Nitrogen and Sulfur in Co-Doped Graphene and Synergetic Effect in Supercapacitor
abstract: The co-doping of graphene with nitrogen and sulfur was investigated aiming at understanding their interactions with the presence of oxygen in graphene. The co-doped graphene (NS-G) was synthesized via a one-pot hydrothermal route using graphene oxide as starting material and L-cysteine, an amino acid containing both N and S, as the doping agent. The obtained NS-G with a three-dimensional hierarchical structure containing both macropores and mesopores exhibited excellent mechanical stabilities under both wet and dry conditions. As compared to N or S singly doped graphene, the co-doped sample contains significantly higher concentrations of N and S species especially pyrollic N groups. The co-doped sample considerably outperformed the singly doped samples when used as free-standing electrode in supercapacitors due to enhanced pseudocapacitance. The simultaneous incorporation of S and N species with the presence of oxygen significantly modified the surface chemistry of carbon leading to considerably higher doping levels, although directly bonding between N and S is neither likely nor detected. Hence, the synergetic effect between N and S occurred through carbon atoms in neighboring hexagonal rings in a graphene sheet.
zh_title: 共掺杂石墨烯中氮和硫的相互作用及超级电容器的协同效应
zh_abstract: 研究了石墨烯与氮和硫的共掺杂，旨在了解它们与石墨烯中氧的相互作用。以氧化石墨烯为起始原料，L-半胱氨酸（一种含有N和S的氨基酸）为掺杂剂，通过一锅水热法合成了共掺杂石墨烯（NS-G）。所得NS-G具有同时包含大孔和中孔的三维分级结构，在潮湿和干燥条件下均表现出优异的机械稳定性。与N或S单掺杂石墨烯相比，共掺杂样品含有明显更高浓度的N和S物质，尤其是吡咯N基团。当用作超级电容器中的独立电极时，由于赝电容增强，共掺杂样品的性能明显优于单掺杂样品。尽管N和S之间的直接键合既不可能也没有被检测到，但S和N物质与氧的存在同时结合显着改变了碳的表面化学性质，导致显着更高的掺杂水平。因此，N和S之间的协同效应通过石墨烯片中相邻六角环中的碳原子发生。

title: High-Performance Flexible All-Solid-State Supercapacitor from Large Free-Standing Graphene-PEDOT/PSS Films
institutions: ARC Centre of Excellence for Electromaterials Science
abstract: Although great attention has been paid to wearable electronic devices in recent years, flexible lightweight batteries or supercapacitors with high performance are still not readily available due to the limitations of the flexible electrode inventory. In this work, highly flexible, bendable and conductive rGO-PEDOT/PSS films were prepared using a simple bar-coating method. The assembled device using rGO-PEDOT/PSS electrode could be bent and rolled up without any decrease in electrochemical performance. A relatively high areal capacitance of 448 mF cm(-2) was achieved at a scan rate of 10 mV s(-1) using the composite electrode with a high mass loading (8.49 mg cm(-2)), indicating the potential to be used in practical applications. To demonstrate this applicability, a roll-up supercapacitor device was constructed, which illustrated the operation of a green LED light for 20 seconds when fully charged.
zh_title: 由大型独立式石墨烯-PEDOT/PSS 薄膜制成的高性能柔性全固态超级电容器
zh_abstract: 尽管近年来可穿戴电子设备受到了极大的关注，但由于柔性电极库存的限制，高性能的柔性轻质电池或超级电容器仍然不易获得。在这项工作中，使用简单的棒涂方法制备了高度柔性、可弯曲和导电的 rGO-PEDOT/PSS 薄膜。使用rGO-PEDOT/PSS电极组装的装置可以弯曲和卷起，而不会降低电化学性能。使用高质量负载(8.49 mg cm(-2))的复合电极在10 mV s(-1)的扫描速率下实现了448 mF cm(-2)的相对较高的面积电容，表明了在实际应用中的潜力。为了证明这种适用性，我们构建了一个卷式超级电容器装置，该装置展示了绿色 LED 灯在充满电后可工作 20 秒。

title: Hybrid structure of zinc oxide nanorods and three dimensional graphene foam for supercapacitor and electrochemical sensor applications
institutions: Nanjing University of Posts and Telecommunications
abstract: A hybrid structure of zinc oxide (ZnO) on three dimensional (3D) graphene foam has been synthesized by chemical vapor deposition (CVD) growth of graphene followed by a facial in situ precipitation of ZnO nanorods under hydrothermal conditions. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and X-ray diffraction (XRD) are used to characterize the morphology and structure of graphene/ZnO hybrids. The results show that the ZnO nanorods have high crystallinity and cluster uniformly on graphene skeleton to form flower-like nanostructures. Serving as a free-standing electrode, the electrochemical and biosensing performance of graphene/ZnO hybrids are studied by cyclic voltammetry, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, galvanostatic charge–discharge and amperometric measurements. It is found that the graphene/ZnO hybrids display superior capacitive performance with high specific capacitance (∼400 F g−1) as well as excellent cycle life, making them suitable for high-performance energy storage applications. Furthermore, the graphene/ZnO hybrids exhibit high sensitivity for detection of [Fe(CN)6]3+ and dopamine, with the extrapolated lower detection limits of ∼1.0 μM and ∼10.0 nM respectively. These results demonstrate the potential of free-standing graphene/ZnO hybrid electrodes for the development of highly sensitive electrochemical sensors.
zh_title: 用于超级电容器和电化学传感器应用的氧化锌纳米棒和三维石墨烯泡沫的混合结构
zh_abstract: 通过化学气相沉积 (CVD) 生长石墨烯，然后在水热条件下原位沉积 ZnO 纳米棒，合成了三维 (3D) 石墨烯泡沫上氧化锌 (ZnO) 的杂化结构。使用扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和X射线衍射（XRD）来表征石墨烯/ZnO杂化物的形态和结构。结果表明，ZnO纳米棒具有较高的结晶度，均匀地聚集在石墨烯骨架上形成花状纳米结构。作为独立电极，石墨烯/ZnO 杂化物的电化学和生物传感性能通过循环伏安法、电化学阻抗谱、恒电流充放电和电流测量进行研究。研究发现，石墨烯/ZnO杂化材料表现出优异的电容性能，具有高比电容（∼400 F g−1）以及优异的循环寿命，使其适合高性能储能应用。此外，石墨烯/ZnO杂化物对[Fe(CN)6]3+和多巴胺的检测表现出高灵敏度，推断的检测下限分别为~1.0 μM和~10.0 nM。这些结果证明了独立式石墨烯/ZnO 混合电极在开发高灵敏度电化学传感器方面的潜力。

title: Nickel Cobalt Oxide-Single Wall Carbon Nanotube Composite Material for Superior Cycling Stability and High-Performance Supercapacitor Application
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C
abstract: The electron conductivity of electrode material has always been a problem that hinders the practical application of supercapacitor. In this contribution, we report a facile synthesis of highly conductive nickel cobalt oxide-single wall carbon nanotube (NiCo 2 O 4 –SWCNT) nanocomposite by controlled hydrolysis process in ethanol–water mixed solvent. Ultrafine NiCo 2 O 4 nanocrystals with a diameter around 6–10 nm are formed on the functionalized SWCNT bundles. This novel material not only exhibits a high specific capacitance of 1642 F g –1 within a 0.45 V potential range but also shows an excellent cycling stability of 94.1% retention after 2000 cycles at high mass loading. Our method provides a promising facile and high-performance strategy for supercapacitor electrode application.
zh_title: 镍钴氧化物-单壁碳纳米管复合材料，具有卓越的循环稳定性和高性能超级电容器应用
zh_abstract: 电极材料的电子传导性一直是阻碍超级电容器实际应用的问题。在这篇文章中，我们报告了通过在乙醇-水混合溶剂中受控水解过程轻松合成高导电镍钴氧化物-单壁碳纳米管（NiCo 2 O 4 –SWCNT）纳米复合材料。在功能化的 SWCNT 束上形成直径约为 6-10 nm 的超细 NiCo 2 O 4 纳米晶体。这种新型材料不仅在 0.45 V 电位范围内表现出 1642 F g –1 的高比电容，而且在高质量负载下循环 2000 次后表现出优异的循环稳定性，保留率为 94.1%。我们的方法为超级电容器电极应用提供了一种有前途的简便且高性能的策略。

title: Solid-State High Performance Flexible Supercapacitors Based on Polypyrrole-MnO2-Carbon Fiber Hybrid Structure
institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
abstract: A solid-state flexible supercapacitor (SC) based on organic-inorganic composite structure was fabricated through an "in situ growth for conductive wrapping" and an electrode material of polypyrrole (PPy)-MnO2 nanoflakes-carbon fiber (CF) hybrid structure was obtained. The conductive organic material of PPy greatly improved the electrochemical performance of the device. With a high specific capacitance of 69.3 F cm(-3) at a discharge current density of 0.1 A cm(-3) and an energy density of 6.16 × 10(-3) Wh cm(-3) at a power density of 0.04 W cm(-3), the device can drive a commercial liquid crystal display (LCD) after being charged. The organic-inorganic composite active materials have enormous potential in energy management and the "in situ growth for conductive wrapping" method might be generalized to open up new strategies for designing next-generation energy storage devices.
zh_title: 基于聚吡咯-MnO2-碳纤维混合结构的固态高性能柔性超级电容器
zh_abstract: 通过“导电包裹原位生长”技术制备了基于有机-无机复合结构的固态柔性超级电容器（SC），并获得了聚吡咯（PPy）-MnO2纳米片-碳纤维（CF）杂化结构的电极材料。 PPy导电有机材料极大地提高了器件的电化学性能。该器件在0.1 A cm(-3)放电电流密度下具有69.3 F cm(-3)的高比电容，在0.04 W cm(-3)功率密度下能量密度为6.16×10(-3) Wh cm(-3)，充电后可驱动商用液晶显示器(LCD)。有机-无机复合活性材料在能源管理方面具有巨大潜力，“导电包裹原位生长”方法可能会得到推广，为设计下一代储能设备开辟新策略。

title: Synthesis of Biomass-Derived Nitrogen-Doped Porous Carbon Nanosheests for High-Performance Supercapacitors
institutions: China University of Petroleum, East China
abstract: Graphene-like two-dimensional carbon nanosheets with properly modulated compositions and porosity are of particular importance for robust capacitance harvesting. Nevertheless, the large-scale and cost-effective production of such nanostructures still remains a great challenge. Herein, we innovatively produce nitrogen-doped porous carbon nanosheets using pine nut shells, an abundant biomass waste, as the precursor, under the synergetic effect of KOH and melamine during the activation process. The sole activation of the precursors with KOH can produce only traditional activated carbon particles of several micrometers, while interestingly, the extra introduction of melamine results in nitrogen-doped porous carbon nanosheets possessing high tunability. By construction of a two-electrode configuration, the supercapacitors with optimal nanosheets as the electrode materials can deliver a superior specific capacitance of 324 F g –1 at 0.05 A g –1, outstanding rate capability of 258 F g –1 at 20 A g –1, and extraordinary cyclic stability of 94.6% after 10 000 cycles at 2 A g –1 in an aqueous electrolyte of 6 M KOH. Such a facile strategy proposed here may contribute to new possibilities of synthesizing graphene-like porous carbon nanosheets in a sustainable manner for energy-related applications.
zh_title: 用于高性能超级电容器的生物质源氮掺杂多孔碳纳米片的合成
zh_abstract: 具有适当调节成分和孔隙率的类石墨烯二维碳纳米片对于稳健的电容收集特别重要。然而，大规模且经济高效地生产这种纳米结构仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在此，我们以松子壳（一种丰富的生物质废物）为前驱体，在活化过程中KOH和三聚氰胺的协同作用下，创新性地生产氮掺杂多孔碳纳米片。仅用 KOH 活化前体只能产生几微米的传统活性炭颗粒，而有趣的是，额外引入三聚氰胺导致氮掺杂多孔碳纳米片具有高可调性。通过构建双电极配置，以最佳纳米片作为电极材料的超级电容器可以在 0.05 A g –1 条件下提供 324 F g –1 的优异比电容，在 20 A g –1 条件下具有 258 F g –1 的出色倍率性能，以及在 6 M KOH 水电解质中在 2 A g –1 条件下循环 10 000 次后达到 94.6% 的非凡循环稳定性。这里提出的这种简单的策略可能有助于以可持续的方式合成类石墨烯多孔碳纳米片用于能源相关应用的新可能性。

title: Graphene decorated with MoS <sub>2</sub> nanosheets: a synergetic energy storage composite electrode for supercapacitor applications
abstract: The two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenide nanosheet-carbon composite is an attractive material for energy storage because of its high Faradaic activity, unique nanoconstruction and electronic properties. In this work, a facile one step preparation of a molybdenum disulfide (MoS2) nanosheet-graphene (MoS2/G) composite with the in situ reduction of graphene oxide is reported. The structure, morphology and composition of the pure MoS2 and composites were comparatively analyzed by various characterization techniques. The electrochemical performance of the pure MoS2, graphene oxide and the MoS2/G composite electrode materials was evaluated by cyclic voltammogram, galvanostatic charge-discharge and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy. The MoS2/G composite showed a higher specific capacitance (270 F g(-1) at a current density of 0.1 A g(-1)) compared to the pure MoS2 (162 F g(-1)) in a neutral aqueous electrolyte. Moreover, the energy density of the composite electrode is also higher (12.5 Wh kg(-1)) with a high power density (2500 W kg(-1)) compared to the pure MoS2. In addition, the MoS2/G composite electrode showed excellent cyclic stability even after 1000 cycles. The enhancement in specific capacitance, excellent cyclic stability and high energy density of the composite electrode are mainly due to the interconnected conductive network of the composite as well as the synergetic effect of the pure MoS2 and graphene. The experimental results demonstrated that the MoS2/G composite is a promising electrode material for high-performance supercapacitors.
zh_title: MoS 2 纳米片修饰的石墨烯：用于超级电容器应用的协同储能复合电极
zh_abstract: 二维（2D）过渡金属二硫属化物纳米片-碳复合材料因其高法拉第活性、独特的纳米结构和电子特性而成为一种有吸引力的储能材料。在这项工作中，报道了一种通过原位还原氧化石墨烯轻松一步制备二硫化钼（MoS2）纳米片-石墨烯（MoS2/G）复合材料的方法。通过各种表征技术对纯MoS2和复合材料的结构、形貌和成分进行了比较分析。通过循环伏安法、恒电流充放电和电化学阻抗谱评估了纯MoS2、氧化石墨烯和MoS2/G复合电极材料的电化学性能。与纯MoS2（162 F g(-1)）相比，MoS2/G复合材料在中性水性电解质中表现出更高的比电容（在0.1 A g(-1)电流密度下为270 F g(-1)）。此外，与纯MoS2相比，复合电极的能量密度也更高（12.5 Wh kg(-1)），功率密度较高（2500 W kg(-1)）。此外，MoS2/G复合电极即使在1000次循环后也表现出优异的循环稳定性。复合电极比电容的增强、优异的循环稳定性和高能量密度主要归功于复合材料互连的导电网络以及纯MoS2和石墨烯的协同效应。实验结果表明MoS2/G复合材料是一种有前景的高性能超级电容器电极材料。

title: High-Performance Asymmetric Supercapacitor Designed with a Novel NiSe@MoSe<sub>2</sub> Nanosheet Array and Nitrogen-Doped Carbon Nanosheet
abstract: Herein, a novel asymmetric supercapacitor (ASC) with high energy density is fabricated based on the NiSe@MoSe 2 nanosheet arrays and the nitrogen-doped pomelo mesocarps-based carbon nanosheet (N-PMCN) as a positive electrode and a negative electrode, respectively. The novel NiSe@MoSe 2 nanosheet arrays are designed and prepared by a facile one-step hydrothermal growth method from nickel foam as a nickel precursor and nucleation framework. The N-PMCN is prepared using simultaneous CaCl 2 activation and urea nitrogen-doped processes from thepomelo mesocarps as a biomass-based carbon precursor. Because of the unique nanosheet array architecture of NiSe@MoSe 2 and interconnected sheet-like porous morphology with high nitrogen content (∼9 wt %) of N-PMCN, they exhibit a maximum specific capacity of 128.2 mAh g –1 and high specific capacitance of 223 F g –1 at a current density of 1 A g –1 . Moreover, the assembled novel NiSe@MoSe 2 //N-PMCN ASC device with a maximum operating voltage of 1.65 V has demonstrated a high energy density of 32.6 Wh kg –1 at a power density of 415 W kg –1 and outstanding cycling stability with 91.4% capacitance retention after 5000 cycles in aqueous electrolyte.
zh_title: 采用新型 NiSe@MoSe2 纳米片阵列和氮掺杂碳纳米片设计的高性能非对称超级电容器
zh_abstract: 在此，基于NiSe@MoSe 2 纳米片阵列和氮掺杂柚子中果皮碳纳米片（N-PMCN）分别作为正极和负极，制备了一种具有高能量密度的新型非对称超级电容器（ASC）。新型NiSe@MoSe 2 纳米片阵列是通过一种简便的一步水热生长方法以泡沫镍作为镍前驱体和成核框架设计和制备的。 N-PMCN 是使用同步CaCl 2 活化和尿素氮掺杂工艺从柚中果皮作为生物质基碳前体制备的。由于NiSe@MoSe 2 独特的纳米片阵列结构和具有高氮含量（∼9 wt%）的N-PMCN互连片状多孔形态，它们在1 A g –1 的电流密度下表现出128.2 mAh g –1 的最大比容量和223 F g –1 的高比电容。此外，组装的新型NiSe@MoSe 2 //N-PMCN ASC器件最大工作电压为1.65 V，在功率密度为415 W kg –1时表现出32.6 Wh kg –1的高能量密度，以及出色的循环稳定性，在水性电解质中循环5000次后电容保持率为91.4%。
