abstract: Transforming heavy carbon precursors with complex structures into high specific surface area porous carbons for supercapacitors typically relies on harsh alkali‐based activation—however, this process often comes at the expense of graphitization, yielding amorphous structures that severely impede high‐rate performance, a bottleneck particularly pronounced in thick electrodes. Herein, we construct a “rigid‐flexible” precursor via molecular tailoring to regulate the thermochemical reconstruction behavior of aromatic‐aliphatic groups mediated by molten potassium salts, thereby kinetically accelerating the growth and splicing of carbon microcrystals. 13 C ssNMR, multi‐scale microcrystalline characterization, and ex situ thermal conversion analysis confirm that the optimized precursor configuration and the unique liquid‐phase environment provide the necessary “stitching sites,” sufficient “graphitization feedstock,” and additional kinetic driving forces for the evolution of the graphitized structure, thereby endowing the prepared porous carbon with a high specific surface area of 1266.6 m 2 g −1 and a homogeneous graphitic network, effectively alleviating the trade‐off between porosity and graphitization. title: Hierarchical Nanoporous Carbon with Thermally Tunable Microstructures for Electrochemical Supercapacitors
abstract: Decoupling the structural factors that govern capacitive charge storage in porous carbons remains challenging because pore accessibility, surface state, and local atomic order are often intrinsically intertwined. Here, a hierarchical nanoporous carbon is produced by sequential dealloying and thermally tuned into a correlated series of carbon frameworks with progressively modified microstructures. The as-prepared carbon features a bicontinuous meso-/microporous architecture, but is initially electrochemically inactive because of undesired surface species. Thermal treatment activates the carbon surface and continuously transforms the carbon walls from a highly disordered amorphous state to increasingly ordered graphitic structures, while largely preserving the micropore size distribution. Comparative analyses reveal that, after electronic activation, capacitance is governed jointly by accessible surface area and the intrinsic capacitance efficiency of the carbon surface, the latter being strongly dependent on the local atomic structure of the carbon walls. The hierarchical and highly disordered nanoporous carbon delivers the best overall supercapacitor performance, while thinner electrodes further improve high-rate utilization and also show competitive behavior in organic electrolyte. These findings establish a design principle for porous carbon supercapacitors based on balancing electrical activation, accessible microporosity, local structural disorder, and transport length, while highlighting dealloying-derived hierarchical carbons as a versatile platform for disentangling  …

zh_abstract: 解耦控制多孔碳中电容性电荷存储的结构因素仍然具有挑战性，因为孔隙可及性、表面状态和局部原子顺序通常本质上是相互交织的。在这里，分层纳米多孔碳是通过顺序脱合金产生的，并热调整成一系列相关的碳框架，并逐渐改变微观结构。所制备的碳具有双连续介孔/微孔结构，但由于不需要的表面物质，最初没有电化学活性。热处理激活碳表面并不断将碳壁从高度无序的无定形状态转变为越来越有序的石墨结构，同时在很大程度上保留了微孔尺寸分布。比较分析表明，电子激活后，电容由可接触表面积和碳表面的固有电容效率共同控制，后者强烈依赖于碳壁的局部原子结构。分层且高度无序的纳米多孔碳提供了最佳的超级电容器整体性能，而更薄的电极进一步提高了高倍率利用率，并在有机电解质中表现出竞争行为。这些发现建立了基于平衡电激活、可接近的微孔性、局部结构无序和传输长度的多孔碳超级电容器的设计原则，同时强调脱合金衍生的分级碳作为解开缠结的多功能平台......

abstract: To address increasingly pressing energy and environmental challenges, developing green, high-performance energy storage systems is paramount. Supercapacitors (SCs) garner significant attention due to their high-power density and long cycle life. However, their performance largely depends on advanced electrode materials that combine a high specific surface area with excellent electrical conductivity. Porous carbon (PC) is obtained via the chemical activation process for the mixed carbon precursor of petroleum coke and waste tire oil. Besides, the in-situ S and N incorporation into the carbon skeleton of PC is also realized during the activation process due to the enrichment of S and N elements in the carbon precursor. The systematic structural characterization reveals that PC possesses a specific surface area of up to 2272 m 2 g −1, a hierarchical pore structure, and good hydrophilicity. As an electrode for SCs, the PC electrode exhibits a high specific capacitance of 320 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 in the aqueous electrolyte. Even at an extremely high current density of 100 A g −1, it still retains 88.12% of its initial capacity, demonstrating excellent rate capability. In addition, the PC electrode also affords superior capacitive behavior in terms of capacitance and rate capability in the organic electrolyte, embodying its extraordinary compatibility with different electrolyte systems. Moreover, the PC electrode still delivers satisfactory gravimetric and areal capacitances even at high mass loading of 10 mg cm −2 . title: High-Performance Fiber-Shaped Supercapacitors Enabled by Polyaniline @ MXene Ti3C2Tx Hybrid Graphene Aerogel Fiber
abstract: Developing fiber-shaped supercapacitors (FSCs) with high capacitance, high energy density, and exceptional rate performance is crucial for reliable, stable and high-performance wearable electronics. Here, a polyaniline (PANI) @ MXene Ti3C2Tx/graphene (PTG) aerogel fiber was rationally fabricated via a confined hydrothermal method followed by freeze-drying treatment. The graphene sheets construct the skeleton of the aerogel fiber, which possesses a porous and interlinked structure, providing interconnected diffusion channels and a high specific surface area that promote electrolyte migration and abundant ion adsorption sites. Moreover, the covalent modification between PANI nanoparticles and Ti3C2Tx sheets can significantly improve interfacial coupling and provide abundant redox sites, resulting in a reduced energy barrier of electron transfer, good interfacial stability and superior H+ storage capability. As a consequence, the PTG aerogel fiber electrode delivers an excellent specific mass capacitance of 484.8 F g−1, impressive rate properties (244.4 F g−1 at 10 A g−1) and exceptional cycle ability (85.2% after 5000 cycles). Additionally, the fabricated symmetrical FSC exhibits considerable electrochemical performance, including high capacitance and good energy density. This work depicts a novel route to prepare a graphene fiber-based electrode for high-performance FSCs in an intelligent wearable system.

title: Metal center dependent electrochemical behavior of covalently functionalized graphene oxide phthalocyanine hybrids in symmetric supercapacitors
journal: Journal of Materials Science Materials in Electronics
abstract: Abstract Understanding the role of metal centers in interfacial charge storage remains an important issue in the development of graphene-based energy storage materials. In this study, graphene oxide was covalently functionalized with cobalt and nickel-centered phthalocyanine conjugates through ester linkages, yielding two nanohybrids with comparable structural frameworks but different metal centers. This approach allows a direct comparison of metal-dependent electrochemical responses under symmetric two-electrode conditions. Spectroscopic analyses, including FT-IR, Raman, and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, support the formation of covalent linkages while indicating that the structural features of both graphene oxide and phthalocyanine units are largely preserved. Electrochemical measurements reveal that the charge storage behavior depends on the nature of the metal center. The GO–CoPc hybrid shows a higher contribution from faradaic processes at low current densities, which can be associated with accessible cobalt redox transitions. In contrast, the GO–NiPc hybrid exhibits a more capacitive response with lower polarization and improved rate performance, suggesting more efficient charge transport at the interface. Both materials were evaluated in an aqueous KOH electrolyte within the studied potential range, where a maximum specific capacitance of 132 F g −1 was obtained for GO–CoPc. institutions: S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences
abstract: The development of energy storage systems for wireless and wearable electronics requires electrode materials that combine high energy density, mechanical flexibility, and long-term cycling stability. Here, we present a laser-engineering strategy for Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene electrodes that induces surface oxidation and forms a hybrid structure comprising in-situ grown TiO 2 nanostructures embedded on a conductive MXene matrix. This laser processing restructures the Ti 3 C 2 T x electrode surface into a porous, heterogeneous interface that enhances ion accessibility, suppresses sheet restacking, and introduces additional Ti 4+ /Ti 3+ redox-active sites. Electrochemical characterisation reveals enhanced areal capacitance and rate performance across aqueous, redox-active, and quasi-solid-state gel electrolytes compared to untreated Ti 3 C 2 T x and laser-induced graphene electrodes. Laser-induced Ti 3 C 2 T x -based supercapacitors exhibit a two-fold increase in specific areal capacitance compared to the laser-induced graphene-based cell, along with an excellent cycling stability over 20,000 charge-discharge cycles. Furthermore, integrating these cells with low-power electronic components, including wireless card readers, validates the potential of this approach for practical energy storage in next-generation portable devices. • Laser processing of Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene enhances electrode porosity, ion transport, and charge transfer. • The treated electrode doubles areal capacitance compared to laser-induced graphene cells. • The resulting supercapacitor powers a wireless card reader,  …

title: Tailoring 3D Carbon Nanofiber Architectures for Enhanced Li+/PF6− Storage in Dual-Carbon Electrodes of High-Performance Lithium-Ion Capacitors
abstract: Abstract Lithium-ion capacitors (LICs) are promising energy storage devices that combine the high energy density of lithium-ion batteries and the outstanding power density of supercapacitors. In this study, a dual-carbon LIC utilizing etched vertical graphene-grown carbon nanofibers (eVG@CNFs) as anode and etched hollow carbon nanofibers (ehCNFs) as cathode was presented. The eVG@CNFs feature mesoporous surfaces integrated with vertically aligned graphene sheets, enabling efficient Li + insertion, diffusion, and adsorption for excellent capacity and rate performance. The ehCNFs, derived by carbonization of polymeric core–shell nanofibers, possess hollow nanochannels and an ultrahigh specific surface area of 2884.4 m 2 g −1 with favorable porosity for PF 6 ⁻ adsorption. The eVG@CNF//ehCNF LIC operates over a wide operating voltage of 0.8–4.0 V and delivers a specific cell capacity of 47.9 mAh g −1 at 30 A g −1 . The hybrid dual-carbon LIC achieves a maximum energy density of 268.5 Wh kg −1 and maintains 115.0 Wh kg −1 even at an ultrahigh power density of 72 kW kg −1 . Moreover, it shows great cycling stability, retaining over 84.4% capacitance after 12000 charge–discharge cycles. This work highlights the potential of tailored CNF architectures for high-performance energy storage applications.

abstract: The sustainable bio-activated carbon platelets were synthesized from tamarind (tamarind indicia) fruit seed shells (TFSs) by a pyrolysis approach with an inert gas atmosphere. The carbonization process was carried out at 800 °C under an inert argon atmosphere, yielding both pure TFS-AC and chemically activated TFS-AC (KOH) carbon materials. Microscopic surface morphological analysis confirmed the formation of thin, interconnected porous carbon platelet nanosheets with enhanced surface structural uniformity. Raman spectroscopy revealed characteristic D- and G-bands, signifying the presence of graphitic domains and partial structural disorder. BET surface area analysis indicated a significant improvement from 48.54 m2/g in TFS-AC to 124.72 m2/g in TFS-AC (KOH), suggesting enhanced pore development and surface accessibility due to KOH activation. Electrochemical two-electrode performance was evaluated in symmetric device configurations using 3M KOH aqueous electrolyte. The TFS-AC (KOH) device exhibited a remarkable specific capacitance, which delivered 129.03 F/g at 0.5A/g, compared to the pure TFS-AC device. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) further confirmed low internal resistance and favorable ion transport. These findings confirm that KOH-activated TFS-derived carbon nanosheets have higher electrochemical stability, retaining 98.2% capacitance over 10,000 cycles. title: Proposal: Hempoxies 74 Platform: Multiscale Bio-Carbon Reinforcement in Structural Vitrimer Composites
journal: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
abstract: This proposal outlines the development of Hempoxies—a class of structural bio-nanocomposites utilizing multiscale hemp-derived carbon reinforcement (nanosheets, biochar, short carbon fiber) within a fully bio-based vitrimer matrix. The central hypothesis posits that wrinkled, porous hemp carbon nanosheets will outperform pristine graphene in epoxy and bioepoxy composites due to superior mechanical interlocking, lower cost ($500/ton vs. $100–$1,000/g for CVD graphene), and comparable electrical conductivity in supercapacitor applications. The matrix is formulated from epoxidized hempseed oil, maleanized hempseed oil, furfuryl glycidyl ether (FGE), citric acid, vanillic acid, and zinc acetate as a transesterification catalyst, yielding a dynamic covalent network capable of reprocessing, welding, and recycling. ### References and Resources - https://doi.org/10.3390/nano14020429 - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compositesa.2021.106351 - https://eureka.patsnap.com/materials/transesterification-vitrimer - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eurpolymj.2020.109881 - https://doi.org/10.1007/s13233-023-00190-1 - https://doi.org/10.1039/D0GC03946B - https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12156394/ - https://doi.org/10.1002/pls2.10173 - https://doi.org/10.1021/acsomega.4c07518 - https://doi.org/10.3390/batteries12010018 - https://doi.org/10.1007/s42114-025-01414-x - https://lirias.kuleuven.be/retrieve/273154 - https://doi.org/10.1002/ece2.70000 - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.est.2024.107XXX - https://doi.org/10.1002/cplu.202400408 - https://investingnews.com/daily/tech-investing/nanoscience-investing/ …

title: AI-driven sustainable supercapacitors for advanced renewable energy storage applications
abstract: The accelerating transition to renewable energy has intensified the demand for sustainable, high-performance energy storage systems that address intermittency while minimizing environmental impact. Supercapacitors have gained attention due to their high-power density, rapid charge-discharge capability, and long cycle life, making them valuable complements or alternatives to batteries in applications from grid storage to portable and wearable devices. Advances in materials chemistry have driven significant improvements, with innovations in electrode design, electrolyte formulation, and device architecture enhancing energy density and broadening functionality. Sustainability considerations are now central, with emphasis on biomass-derived carbons, eco-friendly electrolytes, recyclable components, and life cycle assessment (LCA) approaches to align progress with circular economy goals. Artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) are also transforming supercapacitor research by accelerating material screening, optimizing nanostructures, predicting electrochemical performance, and guiding autonomous synthesis. These tools reduce costs, shorten development timelines, and improve lifetime prediction through degradation modelling. Nonetheless, challenges persist in closing the energy density gap with batteries, scaling sustainable materials, and standardizing AI integration. This review highlights breakthroughs in materials, sustainability, and AI/ML-enabled approaches shaping next-generation supercapacitor technologies for renewable energy futures.
zh_title: 用于先进可再生能源存储应用的人工智能驱动的可持续超级电容器
zh_abstract: 向可再生能源的加速过渡增加了对可持续、高性能储能系统的需求，这些系统可以解决间歇性问题，同时最大限度地减少对环境的影响。超级电容器因其高功率密度、快速充放电能力和长循环寿命而受到关注，使其成为从电网存储到便携式和可穿戴设备等应用中电池的宝贵补充或替代品。材料化学的进步推动了显着的改进，电极设计、电解质配方和器件结构的创新提高了能量密度并扩大了功能。可持续性考虑现在是核心，重点是生物质衍生的碳、环保电解质、可回收成分和生命周期评估（LCA）方法，以使进展与循环经济目标保持一致。人工智能 (AI) 和机器学习 (ML) 也通过加速材料筛选、优化纳米结构、预测电化学性能和指导自主合成，正在改变超级电容器研究。这些工具可以降低成本，缩短开发时间，并通过退化建模改进寿命预测。尽管如此，在缩小与电池的能量密度差距、扩展可持续材料以及标准化人工智能集成方面仍然存在挑战。本次审查重点介绍了材料、可持续性和人工智能/机器学习方法方面的突破，这些突破塑造了可再生能源未来的下一代超级电容器技术。

title: Dense porous monolithic carbon from Indonesian daikon leaf waste via NaOH–CO2 physicochemical activation for binder-free volumetric supercapacitors
institutions: Institut Bisnis dan Teknologi Pelita Indonesia
Universitas Islam Negeri Sultan Syarif Kasim Riau
abstract: High-performance volumetric supercapacitors are often limited by the trade-off between porosity and electrode density in biomass-derived carbon. Herein, binder-free monolithic carbon electrodes were produced from Indonesian daikon leaf waste through 0.5 M NaOH pretreatment followed by integrated N2–CO2 thermal processing. NaOH activation increased the surface area from 236 to 570 m2 g−1, increasing carbon purity from 88.34 to 95.45 wt% while retaining 4–5 wt% oxygen functionalities. The activated monolithic carbon electrode (VSAC) delivered a volumetric capacitance of 169 F cm−3 at 1 mV s−1 and 185 F cm−3 at 10 mA cm−2 in a symmetric two-electrode configuration without binders or conductive additives. VSAC also retained 83.2% capacitance at high scan rates and achieved 16.01 Wh L−1 at 838 W L−1. The improved performance arises from interconnected ion pathways, preserved electrode density, and surface oxygen functionalities, demonstrating a sustainable strategy for practical volumetric supercapacitors.
zh_title: 通过 NaOH-CO2 物理化学活化从印度尼西亚萝卜叶废料中提取致密多孔整体碳，用于无粘合剂体积超级电容器
zh_abstract: 高性能体积超级电容器通常受到生物质衍生碳的孔隙率和电极密度之间的权衡的限制。在此，采用印度尼西亚萝卜叶废料，通过 0.5 M NaOH 预处理，然后进行综合 N2-CO2 热处理，生产出无粘合剂整体碳电极。 NaOH 活化将表面积从 236 m2 g−1 增加到 570 m2 g−1，将碳纯度从 88.34 wt% 增加到 95.45 wt%，同时保留 4–5 wt% 的氧官能团。活性整体碳电极 (VSAC) 在对称双电极配置中，在没有粘合剂或导电添加剂的情况下，在 1 mV s−1 下提供 169 F cm−3 的体积电容，在 10 mA cm−2 下提供 185 F cm−3 的体积电容。 VSAC 在高扫描速率下还保留了 83.2% 的电容，并在 838 W L−1 时实现了 16.01 Wh L−1。性能的改进源于互连的离子通道、保留的电极密度和表面氧功能，展示了实用体积超级电容器的可持续策略。

title: Influence of Oxidative and Hydrothermal Pre-Treatments on KOH Activation of Coconut Fiber for Enhanced Supercapacitor Performance
institutions: Centro de Investigación y de Estudios Avanzados del Instituto Politécnico Nacional
abstract: The development of sustainable electrode materials for supercapacitors requires a deeper understanding of the relationship between precursor structure, processing, and electrochemical performance. In this work, coconut-fiber-derived activated carbons were synthesized via KOH activation, and the influence of oxidative and hydrothermal pre-treatments was systematically investigated. The materials were characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman spectroscopy, and Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), while electrochemical performance was evaluated using cyclic voltammetry and galvanostatic charge–discharge measurements in a three-electrode system with 1 M H2SO4 electrolyte. The results show that hydrothermal pre-treatment leads to improved electrochemical performance, with CF-HTC-AC exhibiting a specific capacitance of ~332 F g−1 at 0.5 A g−1 and enhanced rate capability. In contrast, the oxidatively treated sample (CF-OC-AC) presents a higher diffusion-controlled contribution, indicating a stronger pseudocapacitive behavior associated with oxygen-containing functional groups. These findings demonstrate that electrochemical performance is governed by a balance between capacitive and diffusion-controlled processes rather than by a single structural parameter. The hydrothermal pre-treatment provides an effective strategy to optimize this balance, highlighting precursor conditioning as a key factor in the design of biomass-derived carbon electrodes for supercapacitor applications.
zh_title: 氧化和水热预处理对 KOH 活化椰子纤维增强超级电容器性能的影响
zh_abstract: 超级电容器可持续电极材料的开发需要更深入地了解前体结构、加工和电化学性能之间的关系。在这项工作中，通过 KOH 活化合成了椰子纤维活性炭，并系统研究了氧化和水热预处理的影响。通过 X 射线衍射 (XRD)、拉曼光谱和傅里叶变换红外光谱 (FTIR) 对材料进行了表征，同时在具有 1 M H2SO4 电解质的三电极系统中使用循环伏安法和恒电流充放电测量来评估电化学性能。结果表明，水热预处理可提高电化学性能，CF-HTC-AC 在 0.5 A g−1 下表现出 ~332 F g−1 的比电容，并增强倍率性能。相反，氧化处理的样品（CF-OC-AC）呈现出更高的扩散控制贡献，表明与含氧官能团相关的更强的赝电容行为。这些发现表明，电化学性能是由电容和扩散控制过程之间的平衡决定的，而不是由单一结构参数决定的。水热预处理提供了优化这种平衡的有效策略，突出了前体调节作为超级电容器应用的生物质衍生碳电极设计的关键因素。

title: Characterization of cashew nut shell–derived biochar via O2-CO2 gasification for supercapacitor applications
abstract: Biochar derived from biomass waste has emerged as a promising sustainable electrode material for electrochemical energy storage applications. In this study, cashew nutshell-derived biochar was synthesized through an O 2 –CO 2 gasification process using a single-step self-sustainable reactor operating at approximately 1000 °C. The CO 2 -assisted thermochemical conversion promoted intrinsic activation and generated a mesoporous carbon structure with a specific surface area of approximately 45 m 2 /g. Despite the relatively low surface area and absence of chemical activation, the obtained biochar exhibited favorable electrochemical performance. In a three-electrode configuration using 6 M KOH electrolyte, the electrode delivered a high specific capacitance of 382 F/g at 1 A/g, indicating efficient charge storage behavior. A symmetric two-electrode device demonstrated with a low internal resistance of 2 Ω gives a specific capacitance of 58 F/g at 1 A/g, with a maximum energy density of 15.6 Wh/kg and a power density of 3500 W/kg. Furthermore, the device exhibited excellent cycling durability, retaining 105.8% of its initial capacitance after 5000 charge–discharge cycles. The enhanced electrochemical performance is attributed to the synergistic contribution of accessible mesopores, defect-rich carbon structure, and improved ion transport characteristics induced by the O 2 –CO 2 gasification environment. title: Construction of Cu–Ag@MnS–NiS <sub>2</sub> –Co <sub>3</sub> S <sub>4</sub> Composites with Core–Shell Structure for High Energy Density Supercapacitors
abstract: To overcome the intrinsic limitations of metal–organic frameworks in energy storage, such as poor conductivity and stability, we designed a unique core–shell heterostructure. This is achieved by in situ growth, conversion of MOFs to layered double hydroxide, and a subsequent sulfidation strategy, which transforms ZIF-67-decorated Cu–Ag nanowires into a robust Cu–Ag@MnS–NiS 2 –Co 3 S 4 (CAMNCS) complex. This rational design results in superior electrochemical performance, including a specific capacity of 295.5 mAh g –1 and excellent cycling stability. Meanwhile, the nitrogen-doped Ginkgo biloba -derived carbon material (NGLC) prepared by the pyrolysis–activation method exhibited a specific capacitance of 277.2 F g –1 under the same test conditions. When paired with a biomass-derived carbon anode, the assembled device achieves an energy density of 109.4 Wh kg –1, validating our material design concept. This research introduces new ideas and methods for the design and preparation of high-performance electrodes.
zh_title: 高能量密度超级电容器核壳结构Cu–Ag@MnS–NiS 2 –Co 3 S 4 复合材料的构建
zh_abstract: 为了克服金属有机框架在储能方面的固有局限性，如导电性和稳定性差等，我们设计了一种独特的核壳异质结构。这是通过原位生长、将 MOF 转化为层状双氢氧化物以及随后的硫化策略来实现的，该策略将 ZIF-67 修饰的 Cu-Ag 纳米线转化为坚固的 Cu-Ag@MnS-NiS 2 -Co 3 S 4 (CAMNCS) 复合物。这种合理的设计带来了卓越的电化学性能，包括 295.5 mAh g –1 的比容量和出色的循环稳定性。同时，通过热解-活化方法制备的氮掺杂银杏叶碳材料（NGLC）在相同的测试条件下表现出277.2 F g –1 的比电容。当与生物质衍生的碳阳极配合使用时，组装的装置可实现 109.4 Wh kg –1 的能量密度，验证了我们的材料设计理念。该研究为高性能电极的设计和制备引入了新的思路和方法。

title: Design of Novel Fe-Doped NiCo-LDH/NiFeCo-Oxide Composite Nanosheets Grown on Carbon Fiber Cloth for High-Performance Flexible Asymmetric Supercapacitor
abstract: Layered double hydroxides (LDH) demonstrate significant potential in flexible superca-pacitors due to their high energy storage capability and adjustable architectures. Never-theless, the practical specific capacitance exhibited by current LDH remains below expec-tations, which is attributed to suboptimal electrode performance and limited active sites. Herein, a novel Fe-doped NiFeCo-LDH/NiFeCoO nanosheet composite supported on car-bon cloth was designed and fabricated as a flexible electrode. In this composite, the Ni-FeCo-LDH supplies numerous reactive centers and accelerates electrochemical kinetics, while the NiFeCoO and carbon cloth significantly improve electrical conductivity and cy-cling stability. Moreover, the heterointerface formed between the LDH and the metal oxide phase further facilitates charge transfer. Owing to such synergistic interactions, the pre-pared NiFeCo-LDH/NiFeCoO@CC electrode demonstrates an excellent areal specific ca-pacitance of 3.282 F cm−2 at a current density of 1 mA cm−2, while maintaining a high ca-pacity preservation reaching 88.09% following 5000 cycles. Furthermore, the assembled NiFeCo-LDH/NiFeCoO@CC//AC asymmetric supercapacitor delivers an outstanding en-ergy density reaching 0.302 mWh cm−2 under a power density of 0.776 mW cm−2, coupled with an excellent capacitance preservation of 85.29% over 5000 cycles. Meanwhile, it can maintain its initial capacitance under varying bending degrees, rendering it widely ap-plicable for future advanced flexible and wearable electronic devices.
zh_title: 碳纤维布上生长的新型铁掺杂NiCo-LDH/NiFeCo-氧化物复合纳米片的设计用于高性能柔性非对称超级电容器
zh_abstract: 层状双氢氧化物（LDH）由于其高能量存储能力和可调节的结构而在柔性超级电容器中表现出巨大的潜力。然而，当前 LDH 所表现出的实际比电容仍然低于预期，这是由于电极性能欠佳和活性位点有限。在此，设计并制造了一种负载在碳布上的新型铁掺杂 NiFeCo-LDH/NiFeCoO 纳米片复合材料作为柔性电极。在这种复合材料中，Ni-FeCo-LDH提供了众多的反应中心并加速了电化学动力学，而NiFeCoO和碳布则显着提高了导电性和循环稳定性。此外，LDH和金属氧化物相之间形成的异质界面进一步促进电荷转移。由于这种协同相互作用，制备的 NiFeCo-LDH/NiFeCoO@CC 电极在 1 mA cm−2 的电流密度下表现出 3.282 F cm−2 的优异面积比电容，同时在 5000 次循环后保持高达 88.09% 的高容量保存率。此外，组装的NiFeCo-LDH/NiFeCoO@CC//AC非对称超级电容器在0.776 mW cm−2的功率密度下提供了高达0.302 mWh cm−2的出色能量密度，并且在5000次循环中具有85.29%的出色电容保持率。同时，它可以在不同弯曲程度下保持其初始电容，使其广泛适用于未来先进的柔性和可穿戴电子设备。

title: Nanoarchitectonics of Hierarchically Porous Carbon Nanospheres via Mild Air Activation for High‐Performance Supercapacitors
abstract: ABSTRACT Hydrothermal carbonization of biomass derivatives typically produces nonporous carbon spheres with limited electrochemical activity. This study reports a mild and environmentally friendly activation strategy for forming a hierarchical pore structure in glucose‐derived carbon nanospheres. Using poly (diallyldimethylammonium chloride) (PDDA) as a soft template during hydrothermal polymerization, the as‐prepared carbon nanospheres are subsequently activated in air at controlled temperatures. The optimized sample activated at 800°C (CNSs‐800) exhibited a high specific surface area of 1131.2 m 2 g −1 , well‐developed micro‐, meso‐, and macropores and a balanced defect/ordered carbon structure (I D /I G = 0.98). In a three‐electrode system, CNSs‐800 delivered a specific capacitance of 206 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 . When assembled into a symmetric supercapacitor, it achieved an energy density of 4.78 Wh kg −1 at 1100 W kg −1 and retained 85% of its initial capacitance after 20,000 charge–discharge cycles at 10 A g −1 . Compared with several recently reported carbon‐based supercapacitors, CNSs‐800 shows competitive performance owing to its morphology‐preserving mild air‐activation strategy and hierarchical micro/mesoporous structure. This work provides a scalable and environmentally friendly route to high‐performance porous carbon nanospheres without extensive use of corrosive chemical activators.
zh_title: 通过温和空气活化的分层多孔碳纳米球纳米结构用于高性能超级电容器
zh_abstract: 摘要生物质衍生物的水热碳化通常产生电化学活性有限的无孔碳球。这项研究报告了一种温和且环保的活化策略，用于在葡萄糖衍生的碳纳米球中形成分级孔结构。在水热聚合过程中使用聚（二烯丙基二甲基氯化铵）（PDDA）作为软模板，所制备的碳纳米球随后在受控温度下在空气中活化。在800°C下活化的优化样品（CNSs-800）表现出1131.2 m 2 g -1 的高比表面积，发达的微孔、介孔和大孔以及平衡的缺陷/有序碳结构（ID / I G = 0.98）。在三电极系统中，CNSs-800 在 1 A g -1 下提供了 206 F g -1 的比电容。当组装成对称超级电容器时，它在1100 W kg -1 下实现了4.78 Wh kg -1 的能量密度，并在10 A g -1 下经过20,000次充放电循环后保留了其初始电容的85%。与最近报道的几种碳基超级电容器相比，CNSs-800 由于其形态保持的温和空气活化策略和分层微/介孔结构而显示出具有竞争力的性能。这项工作为高性能多孔碳纳米球提供了一种可扩展且环保的途径，无需大量使用腐蚀性化学活化剂。

title: Biomass nanoarchitectonics: nitrogen-doped hierarchical porous carbons as electrode materials for high-performance supercapacitors
journal: Bulletin of the Chemical Society of Japan
abstract: Abstract This paper reports on the fabrication of self-nitrogen-doped nanoporous carbon materials via Zinc chloride (ZnCl2) activation of Macrotyloma uniflorum seeds at different carbonization temperatures (600 to 900 °C) and impregnation ratios (0.5 to 3), and on their supercapacitance performance in an aqueous electrolyte (1 M H2SO4). The sample carbonized at 800 °C with a 3:1 impregnation ratio (HGC_Z3_800) demonstrated an optimum surface area of 1518 m2 g−1 and a large pore volume of 1.14 cm3 g−1 due to the presence of hierarchical micro- and mesoporous structures along with a 4.4 at% nitrogen doping, suggesting that ZnCl2 facilitated the formation of nanoporous structures and effectively prevented nitrogen loss during carbonization. The optimal sample exhibited outstanding supercapacitance performance, achieving a high specific capacitance of 441 F g−1 at a current density of 1 A g−1 in a 3-electrode system. The assembled symmetric cell delivered an energy density of 8.4 Wh kg−1 at a power density of 600 W kg−1 and retained 87.2% capacitance after 10,000 charging/discharging cycles. These results highlight the potential of self-nitrogen-doped nanoporous carbons with a tailored pore structure as a sustainable, high-performance electrode material for next-generation energy storage devices.
zh_title: 生物质纳米结构：氮掺杂分级多孔碳作为高性能超级电容器的电极材料
zh_abstract: 摘要：本文报道了在不同碳化温度（600 至 900 °C）和浸渍比（0.5 至 3）下通过氯化锌（ZnCl2）活化大花种子制备自氮掺杂纳米多孔碳材料，及其在水性电解质（1 M H2SO4）中的超级电容性能。在 800 °C 下以 3:1 浸渍比 (HGC_Z3_800) 碳化的样品由于分层微孔和介孔结构以及 4.4 at% 氮掺杂的存在，表现出 1518 m2 g−1 的最佳表面积和 1.14 cm3 g−1 的大孔体积，表明 ZnCl2 促进了纳米孔结构的形成，并有效防止了碳化过程中的氮损失。最佳样品表现出出色的超级电容性能，在三电极系统中在1 A g−1 的电流密度下实现了441 F g−1 的高比电容。组装的对称电池在 600 W kg−1 的功率密度下提供了 8.4 Wh kg−1 的能量密度，并在 10,000 次充电/放电循环后保留了 87.2% 的电容。这些结果凸显了具有定制孔结构的自氮掺杂纳米多孔碳作为下一代储能设备的可持续、高性能电极材料的潜力。

title: Self-Nitrogen-Guided Activation of Algae Biomass into Hierarchical Porous Carbon Electrodes for Aqueous Supercapacitors
abstract: Biomass-derived porous carbons are promising supercapacitor electrodes, but their electrochemical performance is often limited by the trade-off between activation-induced pore formation and heteroatom retention. In this work, algae biomass was used as an intrinsic N/O/S-containing precursor to prepare self-nitrogen-doped hierarchical porous carbon by pre-carbonization followed by controlled KOH activation. A temperature-, dosage- and time-dependent sample library was constructed to correlate activation conditions with textural properties, nitrogen configuration, wettability, charge-transfer resistance and electrochemical behavior. The optimized AHPC-850 sample exhibits a BET surface area of 1486 m2 g−1, a total pore volume of 0.96 cm3 g−1, a retained surface nitrogen content of 2.91 at.%, and a charge-transfer resistance of 0.41Ω. In a three-electrode configuration, AHPC-850 delivers 386 F g−1 at 1 A g−1 and retains 62.4% of its capacitance at 20 A g−1. During 10,000 cycles at 10 A g−1, the electrode maintains 96.3% capacitance retention with a stable coulombic efficiency above 98.8%. A symmetric aqueous device based on AHPC-850 achieves an energy density of 24.8 Wh kg−1 at 250 W kg−1. These results indicate that algae-derived carbon can be improved by balancing pore accessibility, nitrogen retention and transport resistance rather than by maximizing surface area alone.
zh_title: 自氮引导藻类生物质活化成水性超级电容器的分级多孔碳电极
zh_abstract: 生物质衍生的多孔碳是有前途的超级电容器电极，但其电化学性能通常受到活化诱导的孔形成和杂原子保留之间的权衡的限制。在这项工作中，藻类生物质被用作内在含 N/O/S 的前体，通过预碳化和受控 KOH 活化制备自氮掺杂分级多孔碳。构建了温度、剂量和时间依赖性样品库，将活化条件与结构特性、氮构型、润湿性、电荷转移电阻和电化学行为相关联。优化后的 AHPC-850 样品的 BET 表面积为 1486 m2 g−1，总孔体积为 0.96 cm3 g−1，保留表面氮含量为 2.91 at.%，电荷转移电阻为 0.41Ω。在三电极配置中，AHPC-850 在 1 A g−1 时提供 386 F g−1，并在 20 A g−1 时保留 62.4% 的电容。在 10 A g−1 电流下循环 10,000 次后，电极保持了 96.3% 的电容保持率，库仑效率稳定在 98.8% 以上。基于 AHPC-850 的对称水装置在 250 W kg−1 下实现了 24.8 Wh kg−1 的能量密度。这些结果表明，可以通过平衡孔隙通达性、氮保留和运输阻力来改善藻类来源的碳，而不是仅仅通过最大化表面积。

title: Perspective on Small-Angle Scattering for Probing Ion Adsorption in Lignin-Derived Porous Carbon Electrodes for Supercapacitors
abstract: Hierarchical porous carbon derived from lignin has been widely used to fabricate carbon electrodes for supercapacitors. An ideal porous carbon architecture features interconnected micropores, mesopores, and macropores. However, the relationship between the microscopic porous structure and macroscopic electrochemical performance remains elusive, largely due to the complex pore architecture of porous carbon and the technical challenges associated with conducting in situ studies of the charge storage process. These limitations hinder the rational design of high-performance supercapacitors. Techniques such as nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), infrared spectroscopy (IR), and small-angle scattering (SAS) have been employed for in situ characterization. While previous in situ studies have primarily focused on ion adsorption behavior within micropores, the electrochemical performance of hierarchical porous carbon electrodes depends on the synergistic effect of micropores, mesopores, and macropores. In this context, we propose using SAS to assess the overall pore size distribution, reveal open porosity, and enable in situ investigation of electrolyte ion adsorption in lignin-derived porous carbon across multiple length scales. The goal is to elucidate the distribution of electrolyte ions within the micropores, mesopores, and macropores of the working electrode and to establish a clear correlation between the structural features of the lignin-derived porous carbon electrode and its electrochemical properties.
zh_title: 小角散射探测超级电容器木质素多孔碳电极中离子吸附的视角
zh_abstract: 源自木质素的多级孔碳已被广泛用于制造超级电容器的碳电极。理想的多孔碳结构具有相互连接的微孔、中孔和大孔。然而，微观多孔结构和宏观电化学性能之间的关系仍然难以捉摸，这很大程度上是由于多孔碳复杂的孔隙结构以及与进行电荷存储过程的原位研究相关的技术挑战。这些限制阻碍了高性能超级电容器的合理设计。核磁共振（NMR）、红外光谱（IR）和小角散射（SAS）等技术已被用于原位表征。虽然之前的原位研究主要集中在微孔内的离子吸附行为，但分级多孔碳电极的电化学性能取决于微孔、中孔和大孔的协同效应。在这种情况下，我们建议使用 SAS 来评估整体孔径分布，揭示开孔率，并能够在多个长度尺度上原位研究木质素衍生多孔碳中电解质离子的吸附。目标是阐明电解质离子在工作电极的微孔、中孔和大孔内的分布，并在木质素衍生的多孔碳电极的结构特征与其电化学性能之间建立明确的相关性。

title: Sequential MOF-Derived Strategy for Uniformly Dispersed ZnO/Co <sub>3</sub> O <sub>4</sub> Nanocrystals in Porous Carbon Nanofibers for Supercapacitors
abstract: Abstract The development of advanced electrode materials with high specific capacitance and energy density with a long cycle life is critical for next-generation supercapacitors. In this study, we report a composite material comprising nitrogen-doped hierarchical porous carbon nanofibers (PCNFs) embedded with ZnO/Co3O4 nanocrystals, which are encapsulated by a few turbostratic carbon layers. These were synthesized via a sequential strategy using a combination of monometallic (ZIF-8) and bimetallic (Zn/Co ZIFs) metal–organic frameworks, yielding distinct morphologies. The optimized composite electrode demonstrated a specific capacitance of 1066 F g–1 at 1 A g–1 in a three-electrode setup and retained 83% of its capacitance after 10,000 cycles. When assembled in an asymmetric supercapacitor cell, the material achieved an impressive energy density of 19.86 Wh kg–1 at a power density of 50 W kg–1. The outstanding performance is attributed to the synergistic effects of the conductive turbostratic carbon matrix and the pseudocapacitive ZnO/Co3O4 nanocrystals within the hierarchically porous structure. This work presents a solution-processable and potentially scalable strategy for designing MOF-derived carbon nanostructures for high-performance energy-storage applications.
zh_title: 用于超级电容器的多孔碳纳米纤维中均匀分散的 ZnO/Co 3 O 4 纳米晶体的顺序 MOF 衍生策略
zh_abstract: 摘要 开发具有高比电容、能量密度和长循环寿命的先进电极材料对于下一代超级电容器至关重要。在这项研究中，我们报道了一种复合材料，包含嵌入ZnO/Co3O4纳米晶体的氮掺杂分层多孔碳纳米纤维（PCNF），这些纳米晶体被一些乱层碳层封装。这些是通过顺序策略合成的，使用单金属（ZIF-8）和双金属（Zn/Co ZIF）金属有机框架的组合，产生不同的形态。优化的复合电极在三电极设置中在 1 A g-1 下表现出 1066 F g-1 的比电容，并在 10,000 次循环后保留了 83% 的电容。当组装在非对称超级电容器电池中时，该材料在 50 W kg-1 的功率密度下实现了 19.86 Wh kg-1 的令人印象深刻的能量密度。优异的性能归因于分级多孔结构内导电乱层碳基体和赝电容ZnO/Co3O4纳米晶体的协同效应。这项工作提出了一种可溶液加工且具有潜在可扩展性的策略，用于设计用于高性能储能应用的 MOF 衍生碳纳米结构。

title: Kitchen waste-derived activated carbon from Murraya koenigii seeds as an electrode material for supercapacitors
abstract: The growing demand for sustainable, high-performance energy storage systems has spurred intensive research into biomass-derived carbon materials as environmentally friendly electrode candidates for supercapacitors. In this study, Murraya koenigii (curry plant) seed powder was employed as a novel biomass precursor for the synthesis of activated carbon in the presence of ferrous chloride (FeCl 2 ) as an activating agent (MKAC). The FeCl 2 -mediated activation, followed by pyrolysis at 900 °C under an inert atmosphere, facilitated the formation of a hierarchically porous carbon structure rich in electrochemically active sites. Comprehensive structural and chemical characterisation via BET analysis, FTIR, XRD, SEM-EDAX, and Raman spectroscopy confirmed the formation of partially graphitised carbon with an enhanced surface area of approximately 1605.5 m 2 g − 1 . Symmetric supercapacitor cells were assembled using a conductive polymer gel electrolyte based on poly(vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) (PVdF-HFP). Electrochemical evaluation demonstrated that FeCl 2 activation synergistically contributed to low internal resistance and a superior specific capacitance of 221.3 F g − 1 at a current density of 0.5 mA cm − 2 , with an energy density of 15.37 Wh kg − 1 at a power density of 217 W kg − 1 . The fabricated symmetric EDLC device retains ~ 88% of its initial capacitance after 10,000 consecutive charge-discharge cycles with a Coulombic efficiency of ~ 88%, confirming the long-term electrochemical stability and charge reversibility of the MKAC electrode. title: Boron–Carbon-Nitride(BCN) Coated ConductingCarbon Cloth for High-Performance Free-Standing Solid-State Supercapacitor
abstract: The dynamic growth of free-standing electrodes has played a key role in wearable electronics and portable technologies. To meet this demand, our present research introduces a flexible energy storage solution using Boron–Carbon-Nitride (BCN) coated carbon cloth (CC@BCN) as the free-standing electrode material for supercapacitors. The CC@BCN delivered a high areal capacitance of 2384 mF cm<sup>–2</sup> at a current density of 4 mA cm<sup>–2</sup> in a two-electrode configuration using 1 M H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> liquid electrolyte. The electrode exhibited a maximum areal energy density of 0.331 mWh cm<sup>–2</sup> and a power density of 9.996 mW cm<sup>–2</sup>, along with excellent cycling stability by retaining 98.3% of its initial capacitance after 10,000 charge–discharge cycles at 10 mA cm<sup>–2</sup>. The electrode also shows promising performance as a solid-state supercapacitor using a PVA-H<sub>3</sub>PO<sub>4</sub> gel electrolyte, and the assembled solid-state device achieved a specific capacitance of 202 mF cm<sup>–2</sup> at 2 mA cm<sup>–2</sup>. Furthermore, it maintains 87.5% of the capacitance retention value after 5000 cycles at 3 mA cm<sup>–2</sup>. This approach provides a scalable as well as effective pathway to develop robust electrode materials for wearable devices that could be used in next-generation energy storage devices.
zh_title: 用于高性能独立式固态超级电容器的硼碳氮化物（BCN）涂层导电碳布
zh_abstract: 独立式电极的动态增长在可穿戴电子产品和便携式技术中发挥了关键作用。为了满足这一需求，我们目前的研究推出了一种灵活的储能解决方案，使用硼碳氮化物（BCN）涂层碳布（CC@BCN）作为超级电容器的独立式电极材料。 CC@BCN 在使用 1 M H2SO4 液体电解质的双电极配置中，在 4 mA cm–2 的电流密度下提供了 2384 mF cm–2 的高面积电容。该电极的最大面能量密度为0.331 mWh cm-2，功率密度为9.996 mW cm-2，并具有出色的循环稳定性，在10 mA cm-2下进行10,000次充放电循环后仍保留98.3%的初始电容。该电极还显示出作为使用 PVA-H3PO4 凝胶电解质的固态超级电容器的良好性能，并且组装的固态装置在 2 mA cm-2 下实现了 202 mF cm-2 的比电容。此外，在 3 mA cm-2 下循环 5000 次后，它仍保持 87.5% 的电容保持值。这种方法提供了一种可扩展且有效的途径来开发可用于下一代储能设备的可穿戴设备的坚固电极材料。

zh_title: 用于高性能独立式固态超级电容器的硼碳氮化物（BCN）涂层导电碳布
zh_abstract: 独立式电极的动态增长在可穿戴电子产品和便携式技术中发挥了关键作用。为了满足这一需求，我们目前的研究推出了一种灵活的储能解决方案，使用硼碳氮化物（BCN）涂层碳布（CC@BCN）作为超级电容器的独立式电极材料。 CC@BCN 在使用 1 M H 2 SO 4 液体电解质的双电极配置中，在 4 mA cm –2 的电流密度下提供了 2384 mF cm –2 的高面积电容。该电极的最大面能量密度为0.331 mWh cm –2 ，功率密度为9.996 mW cm –2 ，并具有出色的循环稳定性，在10 mA cm –2 下进行10,000次充放电循环后仍保留98.3%的初始电容。该电极还显示出作为使用PVA-H 3 PO 4 凝胶电解质的固态超级电容器的良好性能，并且组装的固态装置在2 mA cm –2 下实现了202 mF cm –2 的比电容。此外，在3 mA cm –2 下循环5000次后，其电容保持率仍保持在87.5%。这种方法提供了一种可扩展且有效的途径来开发可用于下一代储能设备的可穿戴设备的坚固电极材料。

title: Enhanced supercapacitor performance using an anodized stainless steel flexible electrode coated with an electron cyclotron resonance carbon film
abstract: Electrochemically anodized stainless steel (SS) shows promise as a free-standing electrode in flexible supercapacitors due to its low cost, eco-friendly nature, and binder-free characteristics. However, unsatisfactory cycling stability limits its practical use in wearable electronics. Herein, we introduce a conductive carbon film deposited on the surface of the anodized SS electrode as a protective layer via electron cyclotron resonance sputtering. By optimizing the deposition bias voltage and deposition time, the resulting flexible electrode exhibits a specific capacitance of 271.6 mF·cm<sup>-2</sup> at a current density of 1 mA·cm<sup>-2</sup>, representing a 2.24-fold increase over the uncoated counterpart, with 88.7% capacitance retention after 8,000 cycles. The enhanced performance is closely related to the conductivity of the surface coating, which depends on the sp2/sp3 ratio (the relative proportion of graphitic to diamond-like carbon bonding). The carbon film-coated anodized SS electrode is combined with an activated carbon on carbon cloth electrode and a gel electrolyte to produce a flexible supercapacitor. The energy storage device exhibits a wide operating potential window of 1.8 V, a high energy density of 51.70 mWh·cm<sup>-3</sup>, and a power density of 0.50 W·cm<sup>-3</sup>, accompanied by robust flexibility and mechanical stability. These findings may pave the way for the development of high-performance, flexible, and cost-effective supercapacitors compatible with large-scale semiconductor device manufacturin …
zh_title: 使用涂有电子回旋共振碳膜的阳极氧化不锈钢柔性电极增强超级电容器性能
zh_abstract: 电化学阳极氧化不锈钢（SS）由于其低成本、环保和无粘合剂的特性，有望成为柔性超级电容器中的独立电极。然而，循环稳定性不佳限制了其在可穿戴电子产品中的实际应用。在此，我们引入通过电子回旋共振溅射在阳极氧化不锈钢电极表面沉积导电碳膜作为保护层。通过优化沉积偏压和沉积时间，所得柔性电极在1 mA·cm<sup>-2</sup>电流密度下的比电容为271.6 mF·cm<sup>-2</sup>，比未涂层电极增加了2.24倍，8000次循环后电容保持率为88.7%。性能的增强与表面涂层的电导率密切相关，这取决于sp2/sp3比率（石墨与类金刚石碳键合的相对比例）。碳膜涂层阳极氧化不锈钢电极与碳布电极上的活性炭和凝胶电解质相结合，可生产柔性超级电容器。该储能器件具有1.8 V的宽工作电位窗口、51.70 mWh·cm<sup>-3</sup>的高能量密度和0.50 W·cm<sup>-3</sup>的功率密度，并具有强大的灵活性和机械稳定性。这些发现可能为开发与大规模半导体器件制造兼容的高性能、灵活且经济高效的超级电容器铺平道路……

title: Sonochemically manganese doped activated carbon from Bauhinia variegata for dual energy application
abstract: Activated carbon (AC) remains a foundational electrode material in electrochemical double-layer capacitors (EDLCs) owing to its high specific surface area, tunable pore structure, and robust charge–discharge cycling. The performance of EDLCs is closely linked to the physicochemical properties of the carbonaceous electrodes, with an optimal pore-size distribution facilitating rapid electrolyte-ion access while mitigating resistive losses. Recent machine-learning-guided design of biomass-derived activated carbons has predicted electrodes with surface areas approaching ~ 2822 m 2 g −1 and gravimetric capacitances around ~ 322 F g −1 at 1 A g −1 in aqueous KOH, illustrating the dramatic influence of synthesis variables such as activation temperature and chemical activation ratio on capacitive performance [ 1 ]. Parallel efforts in surface functionalization underscore how elemental doping can further unlock performance gains by enhancing wettability and electronic interactions. For example, nitrogen-doped ordered mesoporous carbons derived via hard templating not only achieve ~ 100 F g −1 gravimetric capacitance but also break conventional areal limits for activated carbons with ~ 9.2 µF cm −2 , attributing performance to the creation of highly adsorptive sites for electrolyte ions [ 2 ]. Doped porous carbons also find relevance in hybrid devices, where synergistic charge storage mechanisms combine EDLC and pseudocapacitance contributions. Nitrogen and phosphorus co-doped porous AC electrodes achieve energy densities of ~ 49 Wh kg −1 and power densities up to ~ 13.8 kW kg −1 in  …

zh_abstract: 活性炭（AC）由于其高比表面积、可调的孔隙结构和强大的充放电循环能力，仍然是电化学双层电容器（EDLC）的基础电极材料。 EDLC的性能与碳质电极的物理化学性质密切相关，最佳的孔径分布有利于电解质离子快速进入，同时减少电阻损失。最近以机器学习为指导的生物质活性炭设计预测电极的表面积接近~2822 m 2 g −1，在KOH水溶液中1 A g −1时重量电容约为~322 F g −1，这说明了活化温度和化学活化比等合成变量对电容性能的巨大影响[1]。表面功能化方面的并行努力强调了元素掺杂如何通过增强润湿性和电子相互作用来进一步释放性能增益。例如，通过硬模板衍生的氮掺杂有序介孔碳不仅实现了〜100 F g -1 重量电容，而且还打破了活性炭的传统面积限制，达到〜9.2 µF cm -2 ，将性能归因于电解质离子高吸附位点的创建[2]。掺杂多孔碳在混合器件中也具有相关性，其中协同电荷存储机制结合了 EDLC 和赝电容的贡献。氮磷共掺杂多孔交流电极可实现约 49 Wh kg −1 的能量密度和高达约 13.8 kW kg −1 的功率密度……

title: High-efficiency binding of lignin with cesium acetate: Constructing porous carbon with ultrahigh specific surface area for supercapacitor electrode materials
abstract: This experiment developed a high-performance lignin-based porous carbon electrode material prepared via the cesium acetate template method. Its abundant pore structure and high capacitance demonstrate significant potential for high-performance supercapacitors. The cesium acetate used in this material serves not only as a templating agent but also functions as an activating agent, capable of catalyzing multiple reactions while inducing greater distortion in the carbon network to achieve a higher specific surface area. Due to the "cesium effect," the prepared porous carbon electrode material (LCC-3) exhibits a high specific surface area (3423.15 m 2 g −1 ) and pore volume (2.6842 cm 3 g −1 ), with a specific capacitance of 396 F g −1 (0.5 A g −1 ) in a three-electrode system. Subsequent heteroatom doping experiments further validated the feasibility of nitrogen doping in enhancing electrochemical performance. The sodium lignosulfonate used in this study offers sustainability benefits by combining lignin with cesium acetate to produce an environmentally friendly, high-performance supercapacitor electrode, thereby advancing sustainable energy storage technologies.
zh_title: 木质素与醋酸铯的高效结合：构建超高比表面积的多孔碳用于超级电容器电极材料
zh_abstract: 本实验开发了采用醋酸铯模板法制备的高性能木质素基多孔碳电极材料。其丰富的孔隙结构和高电容显示出高性能超级电容器的巨大潜力。该材料中使用的乙酸铯不仅充当模板剂，还充当活化剂，能够催化多种反应，同时引起碳网络更大的变形，以获得更高的比表面积。由于“铯效应”，所制备的多孔碳电极材料（LCC-3）表现出高比表面积（3423.15 m 2 g -1 ）和孔体积（2.6842 cm 3 g -1 ），在三电极系统中比电容为396 F g -1 （0.5 A g -1 ）。随后的杂原子掺杂实验进一步验证了氮掺杂增强电化学性能的可行性。本研究中使用的木质素磺酸钠通过将木质素与醋酸铯相结合来生产环保、高性能的超级电容器电极，从而提供可持续性效益，从而推进可持续能源存储技术。

title: Activation agent-driven modulation of green tea-derived nitrogen-doped carbons for energy storage applications
journal: South African Journal of Chemical Engineering
abstract: • Green tea waste converted into N-doped carbons for circular energy storage. • KOH and ZnCl 2 tuning pore morphology and graphitic integrity in biomass carbon. • Dual-step synthesis via oxidation and annealing optimizes nitrogen retention. • Achieved 128.08 F/g capacitance and 77.06 mWh/g energy density. • Exceptional 99% capacitance retention during long-term electrochemical cycling. Sustainable energy storage requires low-cost and eco-friendly electrode materials with excellent electrochemical performance. Biomass-derived carbons provide a renewable alternative, but their performance depends on activation chemistry and precursor structure. This study investigates the effects of activating agents (KOH and ZnCl 2 ) and precursor origin on the electrical properties of nitrogen-doped activated carbons. Carbon materials were synthesized by pyrolysis at 800 °C and then chemically activated. Physicochemical and electrochemical tests were performed to understand the structure–function relationships. The as-synthesized samples showed the highest specific capacitance of 128.08 F /g, an energy density of 77.06 mWh /g, and excellent cycling stability of 99% retention. ZnCl 2 activation promoted mesopore formation and nitrogen retention, enhancing charge storage and ion transport. The results indicate that biomass-derived precursors provide a scalable and efficient route to the production of porous materials. Heteroatom-doped carbons modify high-performance supercapacitors. This advancement supports energy sustainability and the value of agricultural waste, promoting affordable, clea …

zh_abstract: • 将绿茶废料转化为掺氮碳，用于循环能源储存。 • KOH 和ZnCl 2 调节生物质碳中的孔隙形态和石墨完整性。 • 通过氧化和退火的双步合成可优化氮保留。 • 实现了128.08 F/g 电容和77.06 mWh/g 能量密度。 • 在长期电化学循环过程中，电容保持率高达 99%。可持续能源存储需要具有优异电化学性能的低成本、环保电极材料。生物质衍生的碳提供了一种可再生替代品，但其性能取决于活化化学和前体结构。本研究研究了活化剂（KOH 和 ZnCl 2 ）和前体来源对氮掺杂活性炭电性能的影响。通过800℃热解合成碳材料，然后进行化学活化。进行物理化学和电化学测试以了解结构-功能关系。合成的样品表现出最高的比电容为128.08 F /g，能量密度为77.06 mWh /g，并且具有99%保留率的优异循环稳定性。 ZnCl 2 活化促进中孔形成和氮保留，增强电荷存储和离子传输。结果表明，生物质衍生的前体为多孔材料的生产提供了一条可扩展且有效的途径。杂原子掺杂碳可以改进高性能超级电容器。这一进步支持能源可持续性和农业废物的价值，促进负担得起的、清洁的……

title: Open-Windowed Hollow Carbon Architectures Enabling Low-Tortuosity Ion Transport for Supercapacitors
abstract: Carbon-based supercapacitors are fundamentally limited by the tortuosity of conventional microporous architectures, which restricts ion transport kinetics and impedes the full utilization of active sites, particularly under high-rate conditions. Herein, we report a molten-salt-assisted topological transformation strategy to fabricate nitrogen-doped hierarchical porous carbon (A-ZC) featuring a distinctive open-windowed hollow architecture. This design effectively mitigates the tortuosity of conventional microporous networks, creating low-resistance pathways that facilitate rapid ion flux and deep electrolyte penetration. Consequently, the symmetric supercapacitor delivers a high energy density of 11 Wh kg−1 at a power density of 250 W kg−1. Moreover, it exhibits outstanding cycling stability, retaining 98.9% of its initial capacitance after 20,000 cycles. By elucidating the correlation between salt-induced microstructural evolution and electrochemical kinetics, this work offers a robust blueprint for overcoming the intrinsic limitations of traditional porous architectures in high-performance energy storage.
zh_title: 开窗中空碳架构实现超级电容器的低曲折离子传输
zh_abstract: 碳基超级电容器从根本上受到传统微孔结构的曲折性限制，这限制了离子传输动力学并阻碍了活性位点的充分利用，特别是在高速率条件下。在此，我们报告了一种熔盐辅助拓扑转变策略，用于制造具有独特开窗中空结构的氮掺杂分层多孔碳（A-ZC）。这种设计有效地减轻了传统微孔网络的曲折性，形成了低电阻通道，有利于快速离子通量和深层电解质渗透。因此，对称超级电容器在 250 W kg−1 的功率密度下提供 11 Wh kg−1 的高能量密度。此外，它还表现出出色的循环稳定性，在 20,000 次循环后仍保留了 98.9% 的初始电容。通过阐明盐引起的微观结构演化与电化学动力学之间的相关性，这项工作为克服高性能储能中传统多孔结构的内在局限性提供了一个强有力的蓝图。

title: Hierarchical Carbon Architecture Derived from Polybenzoxazine–Melamine Composites: A Strategy for High-Rate Electrochemical Performance
abstract: Developing sustainable, low-cost carbon materials for advanced energy storage remains a major challenge. This study reports the synthesis of three-dimensional (3D) hierarchical porous carbon foams using a polybenzoxazine-coated melamine sponge template, followed by carbonization at 600, 700, and 800 °C. The melamine sponge provided an interconnected porous framework, while nitrogen-rich polybenzoxazine enabled the formation of heteroatom-doped carbon structures. Structural analyses (SEM, XRD, Raman, and XPS) showed that carbonization temperature strongly influenced graphitization, pore development, and nitrogen functionalities. Among all samples, the foam carbonized at 800 °C showed the best electrochemical performance, delivering a specific capacitance of 287 F g−1 at 1 A g−1, 84% retention at 10 A g−1, and 94% capacitance retention after 10,000 cycles. Its superior behavior is attributed to the synergistic effect of improved conductivity, hierarchical porosity, and favorable nitrogen doping. These findings demonstrate that controlled carbonization is an effective strategy for designing high-performance carbon electrodes for supercapacitors, with additional potential in catalysis, adsorption, and EMI shielding.
zh_title: 聚苯并恶嗪-三聚氰胺复合材料衍生的分级碳结构：高倍率电化学性能的策略
zh_abstract: 开发用于先进储能的可持续、低成本碳材料仍然是一项重大挑战。该研究报告了使用聚苯并嗪涂层三聚氰胺海绵模板合成三维（3D）分层多孔碳泡沫，然后在 600、700 和 800 °C 下进行碳化。三聚氰胺海绵提供了互连的多孔框架，而富氮的聚苯并恶嗪能够形成杂原子掺杂的碳结构。结构分析（SEM、XRD、拉曼和 XPS）表明，碳化温度强烈影响石墨化、孔隙发育和氮官能度。在所有样品中，800 °C 碳化的泡沫表现出最佳的电化学性能，在 1 A g−1 下的比电容为 287 F g−1，在 10 A g−1 下的电容保持率为 84%，10,000 次循环后的电容保持率为 94%。其优异的性能归因于改善的电导率、分级孔隙率和有利的氮掺杂的协同效应。这些发现表明，受控碳化是设计超级电容器高性能碳电极的有效策略，在催化、吸附和 EMI 屏蔽方面具有额外的潜力。

title: Thick, asymmetric electrodes enable high-energy-density 3D-printed flexible quasi-solid-state micro-supercapacitors
abstract: Achieving thick electrodes concurrent with efficient ion and electron transport remains a critical bottleneck in enhancing the areal energy density of micro-supercapacitors (MSCs). Herein, a quasi-solid-state MSC with bicontinuous thick electrodes is constructed, in which an asymmetric geometry composed of nickel hexacyanoferrate (NiHCF) and activated carbon (AC) is employed. This electrode architecture provides both continuous electron pathways and interconnected porosity, supporting high mass loading simultaneously with fast transport dynamics. The resulting NiHCF//AC MSCs show a wide potential window of 1.6 V, a superior areal capacitance up to 1826 mF cm −2 at 1 mA cm −2 , a notable energy density of 649 μWh cm −2 , and excellent cycling stability (90.2% retention of the initial capacitance after 2000 cycles). Moreover, the MSCs demonstrate excellent mechanical toughness and can be integrated into series–parallel configurations for tunable output. title: MOF-derived graphene/chromium oxide hybrids via laser processing for enhanced planar micro-supercapacitors
institutions: Jiangsu University of Science and Technology
abstract: Metal–organic framework (MOF)-derived carbons have emerged as exceptional electrode materials for supercapacitors, benefiting from their ultrahigh surface areas, tunable porous structures, and inherent metal/metal oxide species. This work demonstrates a one-step laser-scribing strategy to directly convert a polyimide/MIL-101(Cr) composite film into an integrated electrode of porous laser-induced graphene (LIG) and mixed-valence chromium oxides (CrOx) for flexible in-plane micro-supercapacitors. The resulting LIG/CrOx composite exhibits a threefold enhancement in specific surface area (130.45 m2/g) compared to pristine LIG, along with a narrow pore size distribution (3–5 nm). The incorporated mixed-valence CrOx nanoparticles provide pseudocapacitance and enhance interfacial charge transfer, while the robust LIG network ensures mechanical flexibility and structural integrity. These synergistic structural and electrical optimizations yield an extraordinary 18-fold increase in areal capacitance, achieving 13.48 mF/cm2 for LIG/CrOx-based planar micro-supercapacitors. The hybrid electrode maintains good cycling stability and mechanical flexibility. This study provides an efficient manufacturing pathway for high-performance flexible energy storage devices and advances the direct integration of MOFs into laser-fabricated electronic systems.
zh_title: 通过激光加工获得 MOF 衍生的石墨烯/氧化铬混合物，用于增强平面微型超级电容器
zh_abstract: 金属有机骨架（MOF）衍生的碳已成为超级电容器的特殊电极材料，受益于其超高的表面积、可调节的多孔结构和固有的金属/金属氧化物种类。这项工作展示了一种一步激光划片策略，可将聚酰亚胺/MIL-101（Cr）复合薄膜直接转化为多孔激光诱导石墨烯（LIG）和混合价氧化铬（CrOx）的集成电极，用于柔性面内微型超级电容器。与原始LIG相比，所得LIG/CrOx复合材料的比表面积增加了三倍（130.45 m2/g），并且孔径分布较窄（3-5 nm）。掺入的混合价 CrOx 纳米颗粒可提供赝电容并增强界面电荷转移，而强大的 LIG 网络可确保机械灵活性和结构完整性。这些协同的结构和电气优化使面积电容显着增加了 18 倍，基于 LIG/CrOx 的平面微型超级电容器达到 13.48 mF/cm2。混合电极保持良好的循环稳定性和机械灵活性。这项研究为高性能柔性储能器件提供了一条高效的制造途径，并促进了 MOF 直接集成到激光制造的电子系统中。

title: “Laser‐Powered Precision at Scale: Revolutionizing Supercapacitor Manufacturing Cost‐Effectively”
abstract: ABSTRACT Miniaturized and flexible energy storage systems are critical for next‐generation microelectronics, yet scalable fabrication remains a fundamental challenge. Here, we demonstrate a rapid, ambient‐processable strategy to fabricate flexible micro‐supercapacitors (MSCs) by direct laser‐induced carbonization of Co@ZIF‐based (a combination of ZIF‐8 and ZIF‐67) metal–organic framework (MOF) films deposited on commercial cellulose paper. This substrate‐integrated approach combines a simple vacuum filtration process with CO 2 laser scribing, enabling the in situ formation of porous carbon–metal oxide hybrid electrodes in seconds, without the need for high‐temperature or inert‐atmosphere processing. We show that the morphology and electrochemical performance of the MSCs can be precisely tuned by adjusting the laser scribing parameters, with optimal performance achieved at a scan speed of 650 mm s −1 . The resulting devices exhibit an areal capacitance of 724.86 µF cm −2 , robust cycling stability over 9000 cycles, and dual‐polarity operation. Integration into a low‐voltage, USB‐powered circuit further validates the device's functional applicability. This work introduces a cost‐effective, sustainable, and scalable platform for high‐performance micro‐energy storage, bridging the gap between laboratory‐scale concepts and real‐world implementation.
zh_title: “大规模激光驱动精度：经济有效地彻底改变超级电容器制造”
zh_abstract: 摘要 小型化和灵活的能量存储系统对于下一代微电子学至关重要，但可扩展的制造仍然是一个基本挑战。在这里，我们展示了一种快速、环境可加工的策略，通过直接激光诱导碳化沉积在商用纤维素纸上的 Co@ZIF 基（ZIF-8 和 ZIF-67 的组合）金属有机框架（MOF）薄膜来制造柔性微型超级电容器（MSC）。这种基板集成方法将简单的真空过滤工艺与CO 2 激光划片相结合，能够在几秒钟内原位形成多孔碳-金属氧化物混合电极，无需高温或惰性气氛处理。我们表明，可以通过调整激光划片参数来精确调节 MSC 的形貌和电化学性能，并在 650 mm s -1 的扫描速度下实现最佳性能。由此产生的器件表现出 724.86 µF cm -2 的面积电容、超过 9000 次循环的强大循环稳定性以及双极性操作。集成到低电压、USB 供电电路中进一步验证了该器件的功能适用性。这项工作引入了一种经济高效、可持续且可扩展的高性能微能量存储平台，缩小了实验室规模概念与现实世界实施之间的差距。

title: Recent advances in carbon material and covalent organic framework composites with a focus on supercapacitors
abstract: In recent years, numerous carbon material and covalent organic framework (COF) composites have been reported, demonstrating remarkable potential as high-performance electrode materials for supercapacitors (SCs). COFs possess advantages such as tunable frameworks, variable pore environments, and pre-designed structures. When appropriately combined with carbon materials, these composites can not only overcome the poor conductivity of COFs but also facilitate rapid mass transport in permanently open channels and provide dense active sites for efficient adsorption of electrolyte ions. This review summarizes the representative research progress of carbon material-COF composites for SC applications, focusing on structural design strategies including the introduction of redox-active sites, interfacial bonding engineering, and controlled composite construction. The applications of these composites in various SC devices are systematically discussed, covering symmetric and asymmetric configurations, as well as flexible and micro-supercapacitor devices. Moreover, we provide a critical overview of the key challenges currently facing this field, such as insufficient structural and electrochemical stability, limited ion transport in stacked structures, difficulties in achieving large-scale and reproducible synthesis, as well as inferior interfacial contact between components. On this basis, future research directions are proposed to promote the rational design and practical development of high-performance carbon-material-COF composite electrodes for advanced supercapacitors.
zh_title: 以超级电容器为重点的碳材料和共价有机骨架复合材料的最新进展
zh_abstract: 近年来，大量碳材料和共价有机骨架（COF）复合材料被报道，显示出作为超级电容器（SC）高性能电极材料的巨大潜力。 COF 具有可调谐框架、可变孔隙环境和预先设计结构等优点。当与碳材料适当结合时，这些复合材料不仅可以克服COF较差的导电性，而且可以促进永久开放通道中的快速传质，并为有效吸附电解质离子提供致密的活性位点。本文总结了用于 SC 应用的碳材料-COF 复合材料的代表性研究进展，重点关注结构设计策略，包括引入氧化还原活性位点、界面键合工程和受控复合材料结构。系统地讨论了这些复合材料在各种 SC 器件中的应用，涵盖对称和非对称配置，以及柔性和微型超级电容器器件。此外，我们对该领域目前面临的主要挑战进行了重要概述，例如结构和电化学稳定性不足、堆叠结构中的离子传输有限、实现大规模和可重复合成的困难以及组分之间的界面接触较差。在此基础上，提出未来的研究方向，以促进先进超级电容器用高性能碳材料-COF复合电极的合理设计和实际开发。

institutions: Shaanxi University of Science and Technology
abstract: Abstract Through a synergistic strategy combining cation doping and carbon hybridization, we have successfully achieved the rational design and fabrication of an Fe-doped and carbon-hybridized Fe-NiCoSe/CTPC/CC electrode. We first investigated the effect of Fe ions on the electrochemical performance by systematically varying the iron content, aiming to introduce an appropriate amount of Fe to enhance the capacitance of NiCoSe. Subsequently, we incorporated pitch-derived carbon (CTPC) to improve the material stability and also to increase the electrical conductivity. In the preliminary experiments, the control NiCoSe/CC electrode delivered a specific capacitance of 726 mF cm–2 at 1 mA cm–2, and after 5000 charge–discharge cycles, its capacitance decayed to only 50.08% of its initial value. In contrast, the optimized Fe-NiCoSe/CTPC/CC-3 electrode achieved a superior specific capacitance of 1535 mF cm–2 at the same current density and retained 84.41% of its initial capacitance after 5000 cycles, fully demonstrating the effectiveness of carbon hybridization. The flexible asymmetric supercapacitor (FASC) assembled with this material was tested within a wide voltage window of 0–1.4 V, delivering a specific capacitance of 264.9 mF cm–2. At a power density of 354.7 μW cm–2, the device achieved a high energy density of 23.55 μWh cm–2 and retained 85.41% of its initial capacitance after 10,000 cycles. However, electrode materials are often limited by sluggish ion transport, low utilization of electroactive sites, and unstable integration between redox‐active phases and conductive frameworks. title: Electrochemical performance of Co₃S₄/Ti₃C₂Tx nanocomposites for aqueous charge storage
institutions: Iran University of Science and Technology
abstract: In this work, the Co₃S₄-x Ti₃C₂Tₓ (x=0, 20, 25, 30, and 35 wt.%) composites were prepared through an in-situ solvothermal method using thioacetamide as sulfur source in a mixed ethanol-water solvent. The diffraction peaks of Co 3 S 4 and Ti₃C₂Tₓ phases were distinctly detectable in the composites. The Co 3 S 4 nanoparticles were uniformly dispersed on the surfaces and edges of Ti₃C₂Tₓ nanosheets. The Co₃S₄-25 wt.% Ti₃C₂Tₓ composite displayed a high specific capacity of (1420 C g -1 (3550 F g -1 ) at 1 A g -1 , far superior to pure Co₃S₄ (748.8 C g -1 (1872 F g -1 )) and Ti₃C₂Tₓ (370 C g -1 (925 F g -1 )). Furthermore, the Co 3 S 4 /Ti 3 C 2 T x electrode exhibited a rate capability of 46% when the current density was increased from 1 to 10 Ag - ¹ and a capacity retention of 81% at 10 Ag - ¹ after 2000 cycles. The Co 3 S 4 -25 wt.% Ti 3 C 2 T x //activated carbon (AC) capacitor exhibited a high specific capacity of 120.9 C g -1 (80.6 F g -1 ) at 1 A g -1 , leading to an energy density of 25.2 Wh kg -1 and a power density of 745 W kg -1 . The asymmetric supercapacitor exhibited 75% capacity retention after 3000 charge/discharge cycles at 5 A g -1 .

title: Tungsten-doped polypyrrole/activated carbon asymmetric supercapacitor: design, fabrication, and performance evaluation
abstract: In this work, polypyrrole (PPy) electrodes with varying tungsten (W) doping levels were synthesized, and the energy storage performance of a W/PPy//AC asymmetric supercapacitor constructed by combining the optimal W/PPy electrode with an activated carbon (AC) electrode was systematically examined. All electrochemical measurements were carried out in 1 M Na₂SO₄ electrolyte, using a potential window of − 1 to 1 V for the three-electrode configuration and 0 to 1 V for the asymmetric device. The electrodes were thoroughly characterized to assess their structural and surface properties. Electrochemical testing showed that the 5% W-doped PPy electrode delivered the highest specific capacity of 1252.2 mF cm⁻². The corresponding W/PPy//AC asymmetric supercapacitor achieved a specific capacity of 104.4 mF cm⁻², with energy and power densities of 0.385 Wh kg⁻¹/0.0145 mWh cm − 2 and 6.77 W kg⁻¹/0.255 mW cm⁻², respectively. Remarkably, at a current density of 5 mA cm⁻², the device retained 98.0% of its initial capacitance after 20,000 GCD cycles, along with a Coulombic efficiency of 94.2%. The high cycling stability suggests that tungsten incorporation may help mitigate structural degradation during repeated charge–discharge processes.

title: Sustainable Energy Solutions via Graphene Quantum Dots‐Functionalized 3D‐Printed Materials
institutions: National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
abstract: Incorporating graphene quantum dots (GQDs) in 3D printing offers a promising route toward sustainable energy devices. Owing to the interesting optoelectronic properties of GQDs, the performance of 3D-printed energy products is improved: Solar cells gain charge transport enhancement with engineered light-absorbing structures; Batteries increase energy density with optimized porous electrodes, while supercapacitors achieve cycling stability with a precisely engineered network of porosity. Besides conventional applications, this hybridization can lead to innovative, flexible, and integrated energy solutions. Nevertheless, ink stability, large-scale production, and eco-friendly materials remain main concerns. This review discusses the advances made in the application of GQDs for printing inks and their combination with advanced additive manufacturing processes, specifically fused deposition modeling (FDM), direct ink writing (DIW), stereolithography (SLA), and inkjet printing. It is imperative to encourage new strategies around hybrid printing technologies and material design through machine learning toward preparing the field for commercialization. When today's expense and scale dilemmas are solved, GQD-enabled three-dimensional printing will bring forth meaningfully advanced sustainable energy technologies by integrating advanced manufacturing with nanomaterials research. This report also provides a thorough overview of the developments in the field while pointing out future research directions that are necessary for unlocking the potential of this technology.
zh_title: 通过石墨烯量子点功能化 3D 打印材料实现可持续能源解决方案
zh_abstract: 在 3D 打印中结合石墨烯量子点 (GQD) 为可持续能源设备提供了一条有前途的途径。由于 GQD 有趣的光电特性，3D 打印能源产品的性能得到了改善：太阳能电池通过工程光吸收结构获得电荷传输增强；电池通过优化的多孔电极提高能量密度，而超级电容器则通过精确设计的孔隙网络实现循环稳定性。除了传统应用之外，这种混合还可以带来创新、灵活和集成的能源解决方案。尽管如此，墨水稳定性、大规模生产和环保材料仍然是主要问题。本综述讨论了 GQD 在印刷油墨中的应用及其与先进增材制造工艺的结合，特别是熔融沉积建模 (FDM)、直接墨水书写 (DIW)、立体光刻 (SLA) 和喷墨打印。当务之急是通过机器学习鼓励围绕混合打印技术和材料设计的新策略，为该领域的商业化做好准备。当当今的费用和规模难题得到解决后，支持 GQD 的三维打印将通过将先进制造与纳米材料研究相结合，带来有意义的先进可持续能源技术。该报告还全面概述了该领域的发展，同时指出了释放该技术潜力所必需的未来研究方向。

title: A Synergistic Pretreatment–3D Printing Strategy for High-Performance Lignin-Based Porous Electrodes
institutions: Academy of Agricultural and Forestry Sciences
abstract: Direct ink writing (DIW) technology enables the transformation of two-dimensional biomass electrodes into three-dimensional thick electrodes, thereby facilitating the development of high-performance supercapacitors (SCs). Nevertheless, the rigidity and poor rheological properties of lignin have constrained research on biomass inks, limiting advancements primarily to low-carbon cellulose. This study presents a strategy in which bamboo powder is treated in a maleic acid/water system to synthesize maleated bamboo lignin, which is subsequently formulated into printable ink and applied for the first time in the field of SCs. Maleated bamboo lignin was combined with F127 to formulate a printable ink exhibiting excellent rheological properties (storage modulus G ′ = 28,471 Pa). The resulting MFLK carbon electrodes exhibit a hierarchical porous structure, a high specific surface area (1831.2 m 2 ·g –1 ), pore sizes of 3–10 nm, and a mass loading up to 90 mg·cm –2 . The areal capacitance is 31.67 F·cm –2, representing a 42.85% improvement over fully dense electrodes. Symmetric devices based on MFLK demonstrate superior electrochemical performance (areal capacitance of 5.3 F·cm –2, energy density of 0.73 mWh·cm –2 ) compared to fully dense and partially MXenes/graphene oxide electrodes. In summary, this work establishes a “pretreatment–3D printing” synergistic refinement framework, providing an efficient pathway from biomass precursors to high-performance energy storage devices.
zh_title: 高性能木质素基多孔电极的协同预处理-3D打印策略
zh_abstract: 直接墨水书写（DIW）技术能够将二维生物质电极转变为三维厚电极，从而促进高性能超级电容器（SC）的开发。然而，木质素的刚性和较差的流变特性限制了生物质墨水的研究，主要限制了低碳纤维素的进展。本研究提出了一种策略，将竹粉在马来酸/水体系中处理，合成马来化竹木质素，随后将其配制成可印刷油墨，并首次应用于SC领域。将马来化竹木质素与 F127 结合，配制出具有优异流变性能（储能模量 G ' = 28,471 Pa）的可印刷油墨。所得的MFLK碳电极表现出分级多孔结构、高比表面积(1831.2 m 2 ·g –1 )、孔径为3–10 nm、质量负载高达90 mg·cm –2 。面积电容为31.67 F·cm –2，比全致密电极提高了42.85%。与完全致密和部分MXenes/氧化石墨烯电极相比，基于MFLK的对称器件表现出优异的电化学性能（面积电容为5.3 F·cm –2 ，能量密度为0.73 mWh·cm –2 ）。综上所述，这项工作建立了“预处理-3D打印”协同细化框架，提供了从生物质前驱体到高性能储能器件的有效途径。

title: Emerging trends in functional chitosan-based composites: applications in environmental remediation, energy storage, and biomedical solutions
abstract: BACKGROUND: Chitosan, derived from marine resources and insects, is biodegradable, non-toxic, and chemically tunable, which makes it a good candidate in green technology. Recent improvements in chitosan composites indicate their potential for wastewater treatment, including the removal of heavy metals, dyes, and pesticides through adsorption and photodegradation, as well as for improving soil quality and minimizing pollution. In the energy area, high conductivity and stability of carbon materials derived from chitosan have been used as the electrode and the electrolyte materials in supercapacitors for constructing a low-carbon energy storage device. In biomedicine, owing to chitosan's biocompatibility, antimicrobial, and modifiable surface chemistry properties, it has already been employed in wound dressings, drug delivery, as well as tissue engineering. AIM OF REVIEW: This review elucidates the growing potential of functional chitosan-derived composites for environmental, energy, and biomedical applications. Key Scientific Concepts of Review: Nevertheless, cost-effective mass production on large scales while maintaining mechanical stability in acidic environment devices and ensuring structural uniformity for the batch is still challenging. Subsequent research needs to incorporate green extraction technologies involving ionic and deep eutectic solvents, nanoengineering high-surface-area composites, and new strategies of functionalization without any crosslinker. title: Advanced materials for flexible and wearable energy storage devices
abstract: The rapid advancement of wearable electronics has intensified the need for lightweight, flexible, deformable, and self-sustaining energy-storage systems. Flexible supercapacitors (FSCs) have emerged as promising options for wearable energy-storage applications due to their high-power density, short charge-discharge times, long cycling stability, and mechanical flexibility. Recent advancements in materials engineering, additive manufacturing, and self-sustaining systems have improved the electrochemical and mechanical efficacy of FSCs. This review discusses recent advancements in improved materials, fabrication techniques, and integrated self-charging systems for next-generation wearable supercapacitors. It covers most of the reported materials, including conductive polymers, carbon nanomaterials, MXenes, metal oxides, metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), covalent organic frameworks (COFs), and hybrid nanocomposites. Advanced fabrication techniques, such as three-dimensional (3D) printing, microfluidic spinning, wet spinning, dry spinning, coating deposition, screen printing, laser writing, and hybrid UV-assisted 3D printing, are highlighted concerning their impact on electrode structure, ion transport, conductivity, and mechanical integrity. Hybrid material that integrate electrical double-layer capacitance (EDLC) with pseudocapacitive charge-storage processes are highlighted as efficient approaches to improve energy density and electrochemical performance. title: 3D‐Printed Flexible Microliquid Metal Supercapacitors and Their Energy Storage Characteristics
institutions: Chongqing University of Arts and Sciences
abstract: The growing demand for wearable devices has created an urgent need for flexible, high‐energy‐density micropower sources, traditional supercapacitors, which are limited by brittle materials and high‐risk liquid electrolytes, struggle to meet this challenge. To overcome the limitations in flexibility and energy density of conventional supercapacitors and address the power supply requirements of wearable electronics, this study employs 3D printing technology to fabricate an integrated flexible microsupercapacitor using liquid metal as the core electrode. The device combines an EGaIn eutectic alloy with a polymer electrolyte, utilizing a composite system comprising a flexible PET substrate and liquid metal–PVA/epoxy electrolyte. It achieves both a high volumetric energy density of 16.0 mWh/cm 3 and outstanding mechanical robustness, maintaining 92% capacitance retention after 5000 bending cycles. Through in‐depth mechanistic investigation, a synergistic enhancement effect in interfacial charge storage was revealed. This work not only systematically optimizes the manufacturing process but also elucidates the synergistic energy storage mechanism via in situ electrochemical analysis, paving the way for innovative power solutions in flexible electronics and providing practical theoretical guidance and technical strategies for realizing high‐performance, highly reliable miniaturized power systems.

Their electrochemical and other related properties can easily be effectively regulated and optimized due to changes in parameters such as material composition, microstructure, and electronic structure. title: Biomass‐Derived Activated Carbon for Next‐Generation Supercapacitors: From Sustainable Precursors to Flexible Device‐Level Advances
abstract: ABSTRACT The rapid evolution of modern electronic devices has significantly increased the demand of energy storage systems that are lightweight, durable, and capable of delivering both high energy and power densities. Among emerging electrode materials, biomass‐derived activated carbon (BDAC) has gained significant attention as a sustainable and scalable alternative to conventional carbon materials for supercapacitors (SCs). This interest stems from its abundant availability, low cost, tunable porous structure, excellent electrochemical performance, and eco‐friendly production approach. This review systematically summarizes recent advances in BDAC synthesis, structural engineering, composite fabrication, electrolyte selection, and device architecture for SC applications. Particular emphasis is placed on composite engineering strategies integrating metal oxides, conducting polymers (CPs), and MXenes to enhance pseudocapacitive contributions and improve overall energy density. The influence of electrolyte systems including aqueous, organic, and solid‐state configurations on voltage window expansion, ionic transport, and device stability is critically examined. Recent progress in flexible and wearable SC architectures is also highlighted. Finally, key challenges related to scalability, reproducibility, green processing, and long‐term stability are discussed, along with future directions toward industrial‐scale manufacturing of sustainable carbon electrodes. Overall, BDAC‐based SCs represent a promising pathway toward next‐generation eco‐friendly energy storage technologies for …
