title: A Review Article on Electrochemical Supercapacitors: Materials Innovations, Performance Limits, and Commercial Realities
journal: International Journal of Multidisciplinary Science and Innovation
abstract: Growing pressure on the global energy system to accommodate a higher share of intermittent renewables has intensified interest in electrochemical storage devices that can absorb and release power on demand within fractions of a second. Supercapacitors fill exactly that role, storing charge through ion adsorption at high-surface-area electrodes or through fast, surface-confined redox reactions, rather than the slower bulk intercalation chemistry that governs battery operation. The result is a device class with power densities one to two orders of magnitude above those of lithium-ion batteries, cycle lives routinely exceeding one hundred thousand chargedischarge events, and charge times measured in seconds rather than hours. What supercapacitors trade away is volumetric and gravimetric energy density, and closing that gap without sacrificing the power and longevity advantages that make these devices useful is the defining challenge of the field today. This review traces the evolution of supercapacitor electrode chemistry from early activated-carbon and electrodeposited metal oxide thin-film systems [5,6,7,8] through graphene- and carbon nanotube-based architectures to the MXene composites and metal-organic framework derivatives that now push laboratory energy densities toward battery territory. It also examines electrolyte development, from aqueous and organic solutions to ionic liquid gels that enable flexible, wearable devices, and discusses candidly the manufacturing, cost, and device-level engineering obstacles that stand between current laboratory performance and broad c …
zh_title: 关于电化学超级电容器的评论文章：材料创新、性能限制和商业现实
zh_abstract: 全球能源系统承受更大份额的间歇性可再生能源的压力越来越大，这增强了人们对能够在几分之一秒内按需吸收和释放电力的电化学存储设备的兴趣。超级电容器恰好填补了这一角色，通过高表面积电极上的离子吸附或通过快速的表面限制氧化还原反应来存储电荷，而不是控制电池运行的较慢的本体嵌入化学反应。其结果是一种设备类别的功率密度比锂离子电池高一到两个数量级，循环寿命通常超过十万次充电放电事件，充电时间以秒而不是小时为单位。超级电容器所牺牲的是体积和重量能量密度，而在不牺牲使这些设备有用的功率和寿命优势的情况下缩小这一差距是当今该领域的决定性挑战。这篇综述追溯了超级电容器电极化学的演变，从早期的活性炭和电沉积金属氧化物薄膜系统[5,6,7,8]到基于石墨烯和碳纳米管的架构，再到现在将实验室能量密度推向电池领域的MXene复合材料和金属有机框架衍生物。它还研究了电解质的开发，从水和有机溶液到离子液体凝胶，以实现灵活的可穿戴设备，并坦诚地讨论了当前实验室性能和广泛应用之间的制造、成本和设备级工程障碍……

title: MXene-Based Electrodes for Flexible Supercapacitors: From Material Synthesis to Device Integration
abstract: With the rapid advancement of portable wearable electronics, flexible supercapacitors have ushered in new development opportunities. In recent years, MXene and its composites have demonstrated potential as advanced supercapacitor electrode materials due to their outstanding theoretical capacitance, specific surface area, conductivity, hydrophilicity, and mechanical flexibility. This review traces the development of MXene and summarizes common synthesis strategies, with a focus on the effects of different preparation methods on its structure and properties. Departing from previously reported work, this review draws from the practical requirements of flexible supercapacitors to conduct an in-depth analysis of the key factors influencing the charge storage, rate capability, cycling life, and mechanical flexibility of the devices. It summarizes common design strategies for MXene composites currently used to enhance device performance. Additionally, this study analyzes key challenges facing MXene-based electrode materials, including issues such as self-stacking of layers, insufficient oxidation stability, limited energy density, and structural degradation under complex deformation conditions. Mitigation strategies are summarized, including optimizing synthesis methods and constructing composite systems integrating carbon materials, conducting polymers, and transition metal compounds. Finally, future research directions for MXene in flexible energy storage are explored, emphasizing the need to achieve a balance between performance and manufacturability through synergistic regulat …
zh_title: 用于柔性超级电容器的 MXene 电极：从材料合成到设备集成
zh_abstract: 随着便携式可穿戴电子产品的快速进步，柔性超级电容器迎来了新的发展机遇。近年来，MXene及其复合材料因其出色的理论电容、比表面积、导电性、亲水性和机械柔性而展现出作为先进超级电容器电极材料的潜力。本文回顾了MXene的发展历程，总结了常见的合成策略，重点讨论了不同制备方法对其结构和性能的影响。与之前报道的工作不同，本文从柔性超级电容器的实际需求出发，对影响器件电荷存储、倍率性能、循环寿命和机械柔性的关键因素进行了深入分析。它总结了目前用于增强器件性能的 MXene 复合材料的常见设计策略。此外，本研究还分析了 MXene 基电极材料面临的主要挑战，包括层的自堆叠、氧化稳定性不足、能量密度有限以及复杂变形条件下的结构退化等问题。总结了缓解策略，包括优化合成方法和构建碳材料、导电聚合物和过渡金属化合物的复合体系。最后，探讨了 MXene 在柔性储能方面的未来研究方向，强调需要通过协同调节来实现性能和可制造性之间的平衡……

title: Carbon/Inorganic Hybrid Multifunctional Composites: Interface Engineering, Coupled Functions and Application-Ready Design
abstract: Carbon/inorganic hybrid composites have evolved from filler-reinforced materials into design platforms for coupled electromagnetic, thermal, sensing, environmental, protective and energy-related functions. Their distinctive value lies in the possibility of combining a conductive, polarizable or porous carbon phase with an inorganic phase that contributes dielectric, magnetic, catalytic, ionic, thermally conductive or barrier behavior. This review examines carbon/inorganic hybrid multifunctional composites from the viewpoint of structure–property relationships, with emphasis on interfacial design, percolation, anisotropy, hierarchical architecture, processing and metrology. Selected graphitic composite studies are discussed as case studies for broadband dielectric spectroscopy, microwave shielding, high-frequency contact metrology, thermal diffusivity analysis and impedance-monitored graphene filters; these case studies are integrated with the broader international literature on CNT and graphene polymer composites, MXene films and foams, graphene/metal oxide photocatalysts, boron nitride/carbon thermal networks, biochar–graphene adsorbents, smart coatings, sensors, supercapacitors and water remediation systems. The central argument is that credible multifunctionality requires more than measuring several properties on the same material. It requires simultaneous or service-relevant co-optimization under constraints of thickness, density, processability, aging, humidity, corrosive media, regeneration, toxicity, economic feasibility and scalable fabrication. The review concludes …

zh_abstract: 碳/无机杂化复合材料已从填料增强材料发展成为耦合电磁、热、传感、环境、保护和能源相关功能的设计平台。它们的独特价值在于可以将导电、可极化或多孔碳相与有助于介电、磁性、催化、离子、导热或阻隔行为的无机相相结合。这篇综述从结构-性能关系的角度研究了碳/无机杂化多功能复合材料，重点是界面设计、渗滤、各向异性、层次结构、加工和计量。选定的石墨复合材料研究作为宽带介电谱、微波屏蔽、高频接触计量、热扩散率分析和阻抗监测石墨烯滤波器的案例研究进行讨论；这些案例研究与碳纳米管和石墨烯聚合物复合材料、MXene薄膜和泡沫、石墨烯/金属氧化物光催化剂、氮化硼/碳热网络、生物炭-石墨烯吸附剂、智能涂层、传感器、超级电容器和水修复系统等更广泛的国际文献相结合。核心论点是，可靠的多功能性需要的不仅仅是测量同一材料的多种特性。它需要在厚度、密度、可加工性、老化、湿度、腐蚀性介质、再生、毒性、经济可行性和可扩展制造的约束下进行同步或与服务相关的协同优化。审查得出结论……

title: Partially Wrapped Ti <sub>3</sub> C <sub>2</sub> Nanosheets Over Pillar Layered Co(Btc)(Dabco)MOF as Electrode Material for Integrated Energy Storage and Real‐Time Monitoring of Basic Hand Movements
institutions: Institute of Polymers, Composites and Biomaterials
abstract: ABSTRACT In this work, we report a hybrid electrode in which a pillar‐layered Co(btc)(dabco)MOF is partially wrapped by Ti 3 C 2 nanosheets to form a Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF composite via a facile 14 h in situ solvothermal synthesis. Strong interfacial interactions, including H‐bonding between the dabco N atoms and Ti 3 C 2 ─OH terminations, and mechanical anchoring via the crest–trough rod morphology increases the MXene interlayer spacing and ensures intimate electrical contact. Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF delivers a high specific capacitance of 632 F g −1 at 5 mA cm −2 , arising from the synergistic pseudocapacitance of Co redox centers and Ti‐based surface redox, combined with electric double‐layer charging. An asymmetric device using Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF and activated carbon operating stably between 0 and 1.2 V, exhibits a specific capacitance of 196 F g −1 at 0.6 mA cm −2 , and retains 100% capacitance after 10 000 cycles. A symmetric ammonium‐ion supercapacitor (AISC) (Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF//Ti 3 C 2 ) delivers up to 118.8 F g −1 and a maximum energy density of 28 Wh kg −1 at 382 W kg −1 , while retaining 93.3% of its initial capacitance after 10 000 cycles. Finally, the AISC device is exploited as a flexible, self‐powered pressure sensor capable of detecting touch, finger, wrist bending, and wrist pulse waveforms.
zh_title: 柱状层状 Co(Btc)(Dabco)MOF 上部分包裹的 Ti 3 C 2 纳米片作为电极材料，用于集成能量存储和基本手部运动的实时监测
zh_abstract: 摘要：在这项工作中，我们报道了一种混合电极，其中柱状层状 Co(btc)(dabco)MOF 被 Ti 3 C 2 纳米片部分包裹，通过简单的 14 小时原位溶剂热合成形成 Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF 复合材料。强界面相互作用，包括 dabco N 原子和 Ti 3 C 2 ─OH 末端之间的 H 键合，以及通过峰谷杆形态的机械锚定，增加了 MXene 层间距并确保紧密的电接触。 Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF 在 5 mA cm -2 下具有 632 F g -1 的高比电容，这是由于 Co 氧化还原中心和 Ti 基表面氧化还原的协同赝电容与双电层充电相结合而产生的。使用Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF和活性炭的不对称器件在0和1.2 V之间稳定工作，在0.6 mA cm -2 下表现出196 F g -1 的比电容，并在10 000次循环后保持100%的电容。对称铵离子超级电容器（AISC）（Ti 3 C 2 @Co(btc)(dabco)MOF//Ti 3 C 2 ）可提供高达 118.8 F g −1 和 382 W kg −1 下 28 Wh kg −1 的最大能量密度，同时在 10 000 次循环后保留其初始电容的 93.3%。最后，AISC 设备被用作灵活的自供电压力传感器，能够检测触摸、手指、手腕弯曲和手腕脉搏波形。

title: MXENE MODIFICATION METHODS TO ENHANCE THE CAPACITANCE PERFORMANCE OF ENERGY STORAGE DEVICES
journal: Bulletin of Shakarim University Technical Sciences
abstract: This review comprehensively analyzes and systematizes modern modification methods aimed at improving the capacitance characteristics of two-dimensional MXene materials, primarily Ti₃C₂Tₓ and related compounds, for their use in supercapacitors and hybrid energy storage devices. The high electronic conductivity, layered structure, and chemically active surface of MXene materials make them promising electrode materials for energy storage devices. However, their practical application is characterized by a number of limitations, such as layer re-densification, limited availability of active centers, and reduced structural stability during long-cycle operation. In this review, the main modification strategies affecting the electrochemical properties of MXene materials are considered, including intercalation-based interlayer spacing control, functionalization of surface terminal groups, composite formation with carbon nanomaterials and transition metal oxides, heteroatom doping, morphological engineering, and various post-processing methods. The impact of these approaches on the ionic and electronic conductivity, pseudocondensation fraction, and cyclic stability of electrode materials is comparatively evaluated. Based on the literature data, a generalized analysis is carried out on the specific capacitance and long-term cyclic stability indicators, and practical recommendations and future research directions for optimizing MXene-based electrodes are formulated.
zh_title: 增强储能器件电容性能的MXENE修饰方法
zh_abstract: 本综述全面分析并系统化了现代改性方法，旨在改善二维 MXene 材料（主要是 Ti₃C2Tₓ 及相关化合物）的电容特性，以用于超级电容器和混合储能设备。 MXene材料的高电子电导率、层状结构和化学活性表面使其成为有前景的储能设备电极材料。然而，它们的实际应用存在许多限制，例如层再致密化、活性中心的可用性有限以及长周期运行期间结构稳定性降低。在这篇综述中，考虑了影响MXene材料电化学性能的主要改性策略，包括基于插层的层间距控制、表面末端基团的功能化、碳纳米材料和过渡金属氧化物的复合形成、杂原子掺杂、形态工程和各种后处理方法。比较评估了这些方法对电极材料的离子和电子电导率、假缩合分数和循环稳定性的影响。基于文献数据，对比电容和长期循环稳定性指标进行概括分析，并制定优化MXene基电极的实用建议和未来研究方向。

title: Sustainable biomass-derived activated carbons for supercapacitors: tailoring porosity and surface chemistry for enhanced energy storage
abstract: Supercapacitors (SCs) offer high power density, rapid charge-discharge capability, and excellent cycling stability; however, their relatively low energy density remains a major limitation for applications requiring sustained energy delivery. Biomass-derived activated carbons have emerged as sustainable, low-cost, and renewable alternatives to conventional carbon electrodes owing to their tunable porous structures and surface chemistry. This review critically analyzes recent advances in biomass-derived activated carbons, with particular emphasis on the synergistic effects of pore architecture and surface chemistry on electrochemical performance. Analysis of the available literature demonstrates that the electrochemical performance of biomass-derived carbons is not governed by specific surface area alone but by pore accessibility and the balance between ultramicropores for charge storage and mesopores for rapid ion transport. Consequently, reported specific capacitances range from approximately 100 to over 600 F g −1 , depending on the biomass precursor and synthesis strategy. Furthermore, heteroatom doping, particularly with N, B, S, P, and co-doping strategies, significantly enhances electrical conductivity, electrolyte wettability, charge-transfer kinetics, and pseudocapacitive contributions. Representative studies show that nitrogen doping can nearly double the specific capacitance (e.g., from 178 to 324 F g −1 ) by improving interfacial electrochemical processes. The present review establishes an integrated structure-property-performance framework linking biomass precurs …
zh_title: 用于超级电容器的可持续生物质活性炭：定制孔隙率和表面化学以增强能量存储
zh_abstract: 超级电容器（SC）具有高功率密度、快速充放电能力和优异的循环稳定性；然而，它们相对较低的能量密度仍然是需要持续能量传输的应用的主要限制。由于其可调节的多孔结构和表面化学性质，生物质衍生的活性炭已成为传统碳电极的可持续、低成本和可再生替代品。这篇综述批判性地分析了生物质活性炭的最新进展，特别强调孔结构和表面化学对电化学性能的协同效应。对现有文献的分析表明，生物质衍生碳的电化学性能不仅仅取决于比表面积，还取决于孔的可达性以及用于电荷存储的超微孔和用于快速离子传输的介孔之间的平衡。因此，报道的比电容范围从大约 100 到超过 600 F g -1 ，具体取决于生物质前体和合成策略。此外，杂原子掺杂，特别是 N、B、S、P 和共掺杂策略，可显着增强电导率、电解质润湿性、电荷转移动力学和赝电容贡献。代表性研究表明，氮掺杂可以通过改善界面电化学过程使比电容几乎加倍（例如，从 178 F g -1 到 324 F g -1 ）。本综述建立了一个将生物质前体联系起来的综合结构-性能-性能框架……

title: Structural and material optimization approaches for nanofiber separators in all-textile supercapacitors
abstract: All-textile supercapacitors were fabricated using carbon fiber nonwoven electrodes in combination with electrospun nanofiber separators. Four polymers—polyurethane, polyacrylonitrile (PAN), polyvinylidene fluoride, and polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)—were evaluated as potential separator materials. PVA nanofiber webs were subjected to thermal treatment and glutaraldehyde (GA) crosslinking to enhance their water stability. Constant current charge–discharge (CCCD) measurements revealed that the tested PAN and thermally treated PVA separators were electrochemically nonfunctional due to short-circuiting, whereas GA-crosslinked PVA exhibited stable charge–discharge behavior within a 1 V operating window. Within the framework of this study, effective electrochemical performance was observed only when the separator thickness exceeded 32 μm, corresponding to an average pore size of approximately 0.37 μm. After 24 h of electrolyte exposure, the GA-crosslinked PVA separator maintained structural integrity and exhibited an increase in capacitance from 0.385 to 0.420 mF/cm2, indicating chemical resistance and sustained electrochemical performance. These results demonstrate that GA-crosslinked PVA nanofiber separators are promising materials for flexible all-textile supercapacitors in wearable energy storage applications.
zh_title: 全纺织超级电容器中纳米纤维隔膜的结构和材料优化方法
zh_abstract: 全织物超级电容器是使用碳纤维非织造电极与电纺纳米纤维隔膜相结合制造的。四种聚合物——聚氨酯、聚丙烯腈（PAN）、聚偏二氟乙烯和聚乙烯醇（PVA）——被评估为潜在的隔膜材料。 PVA 纳米纤维网经过热处理和戊二醛 (GA) 交联，以增强其水稳定性。恒流充放电 (CCCD) 测量表明，测试的 PAN 和热处理 PVA 隔膜由于短路而在电化学上不起作用，而 GA 交联 PVA 在 1 V 操作窗口内表现出稳定的充放电行为。在本研究的框架内，只有当隔膜厚度超过 32 μm（相当于平均孔径约为 0.37 μm）时，才能观察到有效的电化学性能。暴露于电解质 24 小时后，GA 交联的 PVA 隔膜保持了结构完整性，并且电容从 0.385 mF/cm2 增加到 0.420 mF/cm2，表明耐化学性和持续的电化学性能。这些结果表明，GA 交联的 PVA 纳米纤维隔膜是可穿戴储能应用中柔性全纺织超级电容器的有前途的材料。

title: N/O-Codoped Hierarchically Porous Carbon Enables High-Energy-Density and Self-Discharge-Resistant Zinc-Ion Hybrid Supercapacitors
abstract: Abstract Aqueous zinc-ion hybrid supercapacitors (ZIHCs) with conventional activated carbon cathodes mainly rely on electric-double-layer storage, limiting energy density and electrochemical performance. Although heteroatom doping can tailor electronic structures, introduce active sites, and enhance pseudocapacitance, it often intensifies self-discharge. Herein, DFT calculations show that N/O codoping synergistically regulates the local electronic structure and magnetic-moment distribution of activated carbon, enhances electron localization around N–O–C configurations, and lowers Zn²⁺ adsorption energy, thereby strengthening Zn-ion adsorption and charge storage. It also reduces the diffusion barrier of hydrated Zn(H2O)62+ ions in carbon slit pores, promoting rapid ion transport. Guided by this mechanism, an N/O-codoped hierarchical porous carbon cathode was prepared from banana-peel biomass using melamine as an external nitrogen source. The optimized cathode combines accessible pores, abundant active sites, and favorable ion-transport kinetics, enabling high-capacity storage with suppressed self-discharge. The assembled ZIHC delivers 540.5 F g-1 at 0.1 A g-1 and 160 Wh kg-1 at 192.18 W kg-1, retains 85.5% capacity after 5000 cycles, and maintains 93.7% voltage retention during the 2–12 h rest period. This work offers a rational route toward high-energy, fast-transport, and low-self-discharge aqueous ZIHCs.
zh_title: N/O共掺杂分级多孔碳可实现高能量密度和抗自放电锌离子混合超级电容器
zh_abstract: 摘要 具有传统活性炭阴极的水系锌离子混合超级电容器（ZIHC）主要依靠双电层存储，限制了能量密度和电化学性能。尽管杂原子掺杂可以调整电子结构、引入活性位点并增强赝电容，但它通常会加剧自放电。 DFT计算表明，N/O共掺杂协同调节活性炭的局域电子结构和磁矩分布，增强N-O-C构型周围的电子局域化，并降低Zn²⁺吸附能，从而加强Zn离子吸附和电荷存储。它还降低了碳狭缝孔中水合 Zn(H2O)62+ 离子的扩散势垒，促进快速离子传输。在此机制的指导下，利用三聚氰胺作为外部氮源，由香蕉皮生物质制备了N/O共掺杂分级多孔碳阴极。优化的阴极结合了可接近的孔隙、丰富的活性位点和有利的离子传输动力学，可实现高容量存储并抑制自放电。组装好的 ZIHC 在 0.1 A g-1 下提供 540.5 F g-1，在 192.18 W kg-1 下提供 160 Wh kg-1，在 5000 次循环后保留 85.5% 的容量，并在 2-12 小时休息期间保持 93.7% 的电压保留。这项工作为高能量、快速传输和低自放电水系 ZIHC 提供了一条合理的途径。

title: 3DGraphene-likeMicroporous Carbon for Ultralong-LifeLithium-Ion Capacitors
abstract: The hybrid Li-ion capacitor (LIC) is one of the most promising energy storage platforms, offering the advantages of the energy density of the Li-ion battery (LIB) and the power density of the supercapacitor. However, challenges remain in developing high-performance LICs due to the sluggish ion diffusion at the LIB anode and the fast electrostatic interaction of the ions at the supercapacitor cathode, resulting in an imbalance of ion transfer between the electrodes. Here, we report the exceptionally high LIC performance of 3D graphene-like microporous zeolite-templated carbon (ZTC). The ZTC was synthesized by using beta zeolite as a hard template and ethylene as a carbon source. The resultant ZTC was characterized by the sp2 framework with a high surface area of 3400 m2 g–1 and a high Li-ion storage capacity of 1870 mA h g–1. The prelithiated ZTC electrode (ZTCLi) was used as the LIB anode, and the as-made ZTC electrode was used as the supercapacitor cathode in the hybrid LIC (ZTCLi // ZTC). The ZTCLi // ZTC LIC demonstrated remarkably high energy and power densities and cycling stability for over 30,000 cycles. These outcomes were attributed to the facilitated Li-ion adsorption/desorption by the ion desolvation in the pore environment with narrow size distribution (ca. 1 nm in diameter).
zh_title: 用于超长寿命锂离子电容器的 3D 类石墨烯微孔碳
zh_abstract: 混合锂离子电容器（LIC）是最有前途的储能平台之一，具有锂离子电池（LIB）的能量密度和超级电容器的功率密度的优势。然而，由于锂离子电池阳极的离子扩散缓慢和超级电容器阴极的离子快速静电相互作用，导致电极之间离子转移的不平衡，开发高性能LIC仍然面临挑战。在这里，我们报告了 3D 类石墨烯微孔沸石模板碳 (ZTC) 具有极高的 LIC 性能。以β沸石为硬模板、乙烯为碳源合成了ZTC。所得 ZTC 的特点是 sp2 骨架具有 3400 m2 g-1 的高表面积和 1870 mA h g-1 的高锂离子存储容量。在混合LIC（ZTCLi // ZTC）中，预锂化的ZTC电极（ZTCLi）用作LIB阳极，而制成的ZTC电极用作超级电容器阴极。 ZTCLi // ZTC LIC 表现出极高的能量和功率密度以及超过 30,000 次循环的循环稳定性。这些结果归因于在尺寸分布窄（直径约 1 nm）的孔隙环境中离子去溶剂化促进了锂离子的吸附/解吸。

title: Conductive Layered Cellulose-Based Aerogel Films forSupercapacitor Electrodes and Flexible Sensors
abstract: Sophisticated structural designs play a pivotal role in enabling wearable energy storage devices and flexible sensors to achieve optimal performance. In this study, a simple yet effective approach integrating directed freezing, freeze-drying, and hot pressing was adopted for the fabrication of aerogel films. These films consist of cellulose nanofibrils (CNF), carbon nanotubes (CNT), activated carbon (AC), and manganese dioxide (MnO<sub>2</sub>). Within this composite system, CNT act as efficient electron transport channels, while AC/MnO<sub>2</sub> contributes to the energy storage performance based on pseudocapacitance. CNF, on the other hand, forms the main backbone, thereby endowing the films with excellent mechanical properties and a lamellar structure and promoting the uniform dispersion of CNT, AC, and MnO<sub>2</sub> via synergistic hydrogen bonding, electrostatic repulsion, and steric hindrance. The AC/MnO<sub>2</sub> particles interact with the conductive layered 3D porous network structure formed by the entangled CNF and CNT, which results in strong interfacial bonding. Benefiting from this conductive layered structure, the CNF/CNT-AC/MnO<sub>2</sub> (CCAM) aerogel films exhibit promising electrochemical performance when they are used as supercapacitor (SC) electrode materials. Specifically, at a current density of 1 mA cm<sup>–2</sup>, the mass-specific capacitance and area-specific capacitance achieve 342.8 F g<sup>–1</sup> and 1.35 F cm<sup>–2</sup>, respectively. title: Oxygen/sulphur self-doped tunnel-like porous carbon from yellow bamboo for advanced supercapacitor applications
journal: International Journal of Power Electronics and Drive Systems/International Journal of Electrical and Computer Engineering
institutions: Institut Sains dan Teknologi Terpadu Surabaya
National Research, Development and Innovation Office
abstract: The 3D hierarchical pore structure with tunnel-like pores is essential to the performance of porous activated carbon (AC) materials used in symmetric supercapacitors. This study aimed to effect of adding (0.3, 0.5, and 0.7) M KOH reagent and heat treatment on the formation of 3D porous, tunnel-like AC derived from yellow bamboo (YB) through N2-CO2 pyrolysis at 850 °C. The AC produced had a high concentration of nanopores, becoming a valuable storage medium with favorable physical-electrochemical properties. The results showed that 0.5-YBAC had the best physical and electrochemical properties, with a carbon purity, 89.16%, micro crystallinity of 7.374 Å, and excellent amorphous porosity. Furthermore, 3D hierarchical pore structure, enriched naturally occurring heteroatoms, dopant of oxygen (10.14%) and sulfur (0.10%). A maximum surface area of 421.99 m² g⁻¹, along with a dominant combination of micro-mesopores. The electrochemical performance test of the 0.5-YBAC electrode showed a Csp of 214 F g⁻¹, with Esp 24.7 Wh kg⁻¹ and Psp 19.2 W kg⁻¹. In conclusion, this study showed the potential of YB stems to enhance the development of supercapacitors, offering superior porosity characteristics for efficient energy storage applications.
zh_title: 用于先进超级电容器应用的黄竹氧/硫自掺杂隧道状多孔碳
zh_abstract: 具有隧道状孔隙的 3D 分层孔隙结构对于对称超级电容器中使用的多孔活性炭 (AC) 材料的性能至关重要。本研究旨在探讨添加（0.3、0.5 和 0.7）M KOH 试剂和热处理对黄竹 (YB) 通过 N2-CO2 在 850 °C 热解形成 3D 多孔隧道状 AC 的影响。所产生的AC具有高浓度的纳米孔，成为具有良好物理电化学性质的有价值的存储介质。结果表明，0.5-YBAC具有最佳的物理和电化学性能，碳纯度为89.16%，微结晶度为7.374 Å，具有优异的非晶态孔隙率。此外，3D分层孔隙结构、丰富的天然杂原子、氧（10.14％）和硫（0.10％）的掺杂剂。最大表面积为 421.99 m² g-1，并以微中孔为主。 0.5-YBAC电极的电化学性能测试显示，Csp为214 F g-1，Esp为24.7 Wh kg-1，Psp为19.2 W kg-1。总之，这项研究显示了 YB 茎在促进超级电容器发展方面的潜力，为高效储能应用提供卓越的孔隙率特性。

title: Sustainable Ni/NiO-carbon aerogel composite derived from water hyacinth for high-performance supercapacitor electrodes
institutions: Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City
Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology
abstract: The pursuit of sustainable and high-performance electrode materials is crucial for advancing next-generation energy storage technologies. In this work, a Ni/NiO–carbon aerogel composite (Ni/NiO–CAC) was synthesized from water hyacinth (WH) an abundant and renewable biomass source, through a green and facile multi-step process involving NaOH pretreatment, aerogel formation, carbonization, and nickel incorporation, where the alkaline treatment improved cellulose purity and structural homogeneity. The integration of Ni/NiO nanoparticles within the carbon aerogel framework endowed the material with hierarchical porosity, enlarged surface area, and abundant redox-active sites. Among the prepared samples, the Ni/NiO–CA-10 composite (containing 10 wt% Ni loading) exhibited a remarkably high specific surface area of 1054 m 2 g⁻¹ and delivered a specific capacitance of 312.5 F g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹ , while retaining 87 % of its capacitance after 1700 charge–discharge cycles at 10 A g⁻¹ , demonstrating outstanding rate capability and cycling durability. Electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) revealed reduced internal resistance and enhanced ion transport efficiency in the Ni/NiO composite compared to pristine carbon aerogels. This study provides a sustainable approach for converting invasive aquatic biomass into high-value electrode materials, highlighting the synergistic effects of the Ni/NiO-carbon interface in boosting supercapacitor performance. • Ni/NiO–CAC synthesized from water hyacinth via a sustainable green process. • Optimized Ni/NiO–CAC-10 delivered 312.5 F g⁻¹ at 1 A g⁻¹  …

title: Soyabean Husk-Assisted Green Synthesis of rGO/CuO Nanocomposite for Supercapacitor Applications
journal: Journal for Research in Applied Sciences and Biotechnology
abstract: The rising global demand for green energy storage systems has led to the development of studies aimed at finding environmentally friendly electrode materials to use in supercapacitors. The conventional approach to producing graphene-based nanocomposites usually requires the use of toxic chemicals, a high amount of energy as well as non-renewable materials and this is of concern to the environment and poses a question of scalability. Another variant that has come up as a feasible alternative in this direction and integrates material efficacy with sustainability is biomass-assisted green synthesis. This paper provides a detailed analysis of green synthesis of reduced graphene oxide/copper oxide (rGO/CuO) nanocomposites using soybean husks and their application as high-performance electrodes to supercapacitors. Our reducing and stabilizing agent, which was a natural by-product (soybean husk), was used to reduce graphene oxide and simultaneously produce CuO nanoparticles due to the sufficient amount of polyphenols and reducing sugars in soybean husk. The existence of the structural, morphological, and electrochemical characteristics of the successful formation of the composite demonstrated the presence of increased surface area, uniform distribution of the nanoparticle, and electrical conductivity. Electrochemical determinations reflected high-quality specific capacitance, great rate performance and great cycling stability as compared to pristine rGO and CuO electrodes. zh_abstract: 全球对绿色能源存储系统的需求不断增长，导致了旨在寻找用于超级电容器的环保电极材料的研究的发展。生产石墨烯基纳米复合材料的传统方法通常需要使用有毒化学品、大量能源以及不可再生材料，这会影响环境并带来可扩展性问题。另一种将材料功效与可持续性结合起来的可行替代方案是生物质辅助绿色合成。本文详细分析了利用大豆皮绿色合成还原氧化石墨烯/氧化铜（rGO/CuO）纳米复合材料及其作为超级电容器高性能电极的应用。我们的还原剂和稳定剂是一种天然副产品（大豆皮），由于大豆皮中含有足够量的多酚和还原糖，因此可以还原氧化石墨烯，同时生产氧化铜纳米颗粒。复合材料成功形成的结构、形态和电化学特征的存在证明了纳米粒子表面积增加、纳米粒子分布均匀和导电性的存在。与原始 rGO 和 CuO 电极相比，电化学测定反映了高质量的比电容、出色的倍率性能和出色的循环稳定性。 rGO-CuO 相互作用是协同的，能够刺激电荷的有效转移并增强……

title: Porous Carbon-Modified Silk-Derived Carbon Mesh for High-Performance Transparent All-Solid Supercapacitors
abstract: The practical application of transparent supercapacitors (TSCs) is limited by the inherent trade-off between transparency and conductivity, as well as the environmental and economic drawbacks of electrode materials. This study presents a novel and scalable method for fabricating porous carbon-modified silk-derived carbon fiber meshes as electrode materials for transparent supercapacitors. The process involves the in situ growth of a cobalt organic complex on a silk mesh, followed by carbonization to produce a flexible, transparent carbon fiber mesh with a hierarchical porous structure (specific surface area: 570 m2/g). The resulting material exhibits good mechanical properties and electrical conductivity due to the nanographene-like structure formed during the cobalt-catalyzed carbonization process. This TSC achieves an optical transparency of up to 65% and an aerial capacitance of 9.65 mF/cm2 at a scan rate of 0.01 V/s, surpassing many existing transparent electrodes. Additionally, the device demonstrates outstanding electrochemical stability, retaining 89% of its initial capacitance after 2000 cycles at a scan rate of 0.5 V/s, showcasing superior durability. This study presents a pioneering method for developing TSCs by utilizing sustainable silk-derived carbon materials and a cost-effective fabrication process.
zh_title: 用于高性能透明全固态超级电容器的多孔碳改性丝衍生碳网
zh_abstract: 透明超级电容器（TSC）的实际应用受到透明度和电导率之间固有的权衡以及电极材料的环境和经济缺点的限制。这项研究提出了一种新颖且可扩展的方法，用于制造多孔碳改性丝衍生碳纤维网作为透明超级电容器的电极材料。该过程涉及在丝网上原位生长钴有机络合物，然后碳化以生产具有分层多孔结构的柔性透明碳纤维网（比表面积：570 m2/g）。由于钴催化碳化过程中形成的纳米石墨烯状结构，所得材料表现出良好的机械性能和导电性。该TSC在0.01 V/s的扫描速率下实现了高达65%的光学透明度和9.65 mF/cm2的空气电容，超越了许多现有的透明电极。此外，该器件表现出出色的电化学稳定性，在 0.5 V/s 的扫描速率下循环 2000 次后仍保留 89% 的初始电容，展现出卓越的耐用性。这项研究提出了一种利用可持续丝源碳材料和经济高效的制造工艺来开发 TSC 的开创性方法。

title: A Flexible All-Solid-StateAsymmetric SupercapacitorBased on a Nanocomposite of Vanadium Oxide/Graphene and PolyanilineHydrogel with Excellent Operational Stability and Energy Density
abstract: Porous polymer-based materials of high electrical conductivity are essential for a wide range of applications. An innovative nanocomposite of V<sub>2</sub>O<sub>5</sub>/rGO/polyaniline hydrogel (VG/PANi-HG) was synthesized using in situ oxidative polymerization in the presence of V<sub>2</sub>O<sub>5</sub>/rGO (VG) and phytic acid on a carbon fiber substrate. Subsequently, the corresponding electrode was employed as a flexible free-standing electrode and examined through a range of electrochemical methods to assess its performance in high-rate supercapacitors. The VG/PANi-HG supercapacitor demonstrated an excellent specific capacitance of 982 F g<sup>–1</sup> at a current density of 2.7 A g<sup>–1</sup>. Furthermore, an asymmetric all-solid-state (ASC) device was assembled using VG/PANi-HG as a positive electrode in combination with a graphene oxide electrode as a negative electrode and a polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) hydrogel electrolyte. This flexible asymmetric device exhibited an impressive cycle life stability and a power density of 2 kW kg<sup>–1</sup> at an energy density of 29.44 Wh kg<sup>–1</sup>. Our results reveal that the VG/PANi-HG electrode material is a promising candidate for future electrochemical energy storage devices.
zh_title: 一种基于氧化钒/石墨烯和聚苯胺水凝胶纳米复合材料的柔性全固态不对称超级电容器，具有优异的运行稳定性和能量密度
zh_abstract: 高导电率的多孔聚合物基材料对于广泛的应用至关重要。在碳纤维基材上，在 V2O5/rGO (VG) 和植酸存在下，采用原位氧化聚合合成了一种创新的 V2O5/rGO/聚苯胺水凝胶 (VG/PANi-HG) 纳米复合材料。随后，相应的电极被用作柔性独立式电极，并通过一系列电化学方法进行检查，以评估其在高倍率超级电容器中的性能。 VG/PANi-HG 超级电容器在 2.7 A g-1 的电流密度下表现出 982 F g-1 的优异比电容。此外，使用VG/PANi-HG作为正极，氧化石墨烯电极作为负极以及聚乙烯醇（PVA）水凝胶电解质，组装了不对称全固态（ASC）器件。这种灵活的不对称器件表现出令人印象深刻的循环寿命稳定性，在能量密度为 29.44 Wh kg-1 时功率密度为 2 kW kg-1。我们的结果表明，VG/PANi-HG 电极材料是未来电化学储能设备的有希望的候选材料。

title: Development of A Novel Fiber-Type Supercapacitor by Hydrothermal Recrystallize Method
institutions: Instituto de Ciencia de Materiales de Sevilla
abstract: Wearable technologies have emerged as transformative tools in both daily life and healthcare. However, achieving optimal performance in wearable electronic devices necessitates energy sources that are efficient, convenient, and flexible—particularly under extreme conditions such as space exploration, military operations, and deep-sea environments. To address this critical need, we have developed a novel energy device technology based on wire-type supercapacitors. In this study, graphene oxide (GO) was selected as the primary material due to its high specific surface area, excellent electrical conductivity, and robust mechanical properties [1, 2]. Furthermore, the hydrophilic functional groups on the surface of GO enhance its bridging capabilities. However, the two-dimensional (2D) GO sheets are relatively loose and prone to fragmentation along the interlayer gaps. To enhance the mechanical strength and integrity of the wire structure, single-walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs) were incorporated to bridge the GO sheets. The aligned and continuous nature of SWCNTs improves longitudinal mechanical behavior and electron transport, thereby reinforcing the structural integrity. Since the pristine surface of SWCNTs lacks active functional groups for effective integration, we utilized nitric acid treatment to introduce hydrophilic functional groups. Ethylenediamine, containing NH2- functional groups, was employed as a bridging agent to chemically bond GO and the modified SWCNTs. zh_title: 水热再结晶法开发新型纤维型超级电容器
zh_abstract: 可穿戴技术已成为日常生活和医疗保健领域的变革性工具。然而，要实现可穿戴电子设备的最佳性能，就需要高效、方便和灵活的能源，特别是在太空探索、军事行动和深海环境等极端条件下。为了满足这一迫切需求，我们开发了一种基于线型超级电容器的新型能源设备技术。在这项研究中，氧化石墨烯（GO）因其高比表面积、优异的导电性和强大的机械性能而被选为主要材料[1, 2]。此外，GO表面的亲水官能团增强了其桥联能力。然而，二维 (2D) GO 片材相对松散，容易沿着层间间隙碎裂。为了增强线结构的机械强度和完整性，采用单壁碳纳米管 (SWCNT) 来桥接 GO 片。单壁碳纳米管的排列和连续性质改善了纵向机械行为和电子传输，从而增强了结构完整性。由于单壁碳纳米管的原始表面缺乏有效集成的活性官能团，我们利用硝酸处理引入亲水官能团。含有 NH2- 官能团的乙二胺被用作桥联剂，以化学方式键合 GO 和改性 SWCNT。为了制备复合材料，GO 和改性 SWCNT 分别分散在水溶液中……

title: A Flexible, Lightweight,and High-Performance SupercapacitorMade of Nanofibrous Polypyrrole Electrodes
abstract: High-performance and lightweight supercapacitors are in high demand in personal electronics and electric vehicles. In this work, the pseudocapacitance of a metal-free symmetric supercapacitor made of polypyrrole (PPy) membrane electrodes and a gel electrolyte containing 3% poly(vinyl alcohol) (PVA) dissolved in 1 M sulfuric acid (PVA-H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub>) was investigated. It was observed that the soft PPy membrane synthesized through docusate sodium and methyl orange-assisted interfacial polymerization (PPy-AOT) had a unique nanofibrous structure throughout the thickness of 1 mm. The PPy-AOT/PVA-H<sub>2</sub>SO<sub>4</sub> electrode is flexible, lightweight, free-standing, and free of metal, showing a lower environmental impact with respect to that of the high-performance supercapacitors using metals. A hypothetic mechanism was proposed to explain how such a nanofibrous structure is formed. The weight-based performance of the device was compared with different categories of supercapacitors and batteries, with its advantages and disadvantages discussed. The supercapacitor and electrode material were analyzed with various analytical techniques. Without using metals and carbon materials, the polymeric supercapacitor recorded a high areal capacitance of 4817.9 mF/cm<sup>2</sup> and gravimetric capacitance of 430.0 F/g, with energy densities of 0.4 mWh/cm<sup>2</sup> and 14.6 Wh/kg and power densities of 0.6 mW/cm<sup>2</sup> and 174.6 W/kg. Such polymeric supercapacitors may find applications in cost- and environmentally sensitive areas.
zh_title: 由纳米纤维聚吡咯电极制成的柔性、轻质、高性能超级电容器
zh_abstract: 个人电子产品和电动汽车对高性能和轻型超级电容器的需求很高。在这项工作中，研究了由聚吡咯（PPy）膜电极和含有溶解在1 M硫酸中的3％聚乙烯醇（PVA）（PVA-H2SO4）的凝胶电解质制成的无金属对称超级电容器的赝电容。结果发现，通过多库酯钠和甲基橙辅助界面聚合（PPy-AOT）合成的软PPy膜在整个1毫米的厚度上具有独特的纳米纤维结构。 PPy-AOT/PVA-H2SO4电极具有柔性、轻质、独立且不含金属的特点，与使用金属的高性能超级电容器相比，对环境的影响更低。提出了一种假设机制来解释这种纳米纤维结构是如何形成的。该设备的基于重量的性能与不同类别的超级电容器和电池进行了比较，并讨论了其优缺点。使用各种分析技术对超级电容器和电极材料进行了分析。在不使用金属和碳材料的情况下，聚合物超级电容器的面电容为4817.9 mF/cm2，重量电容为430.0 F/g，能量密度为0.4 mWh/cm2和14.6 Wh/kg，功率密度为0.6 mW/cm2和174.6 W/kg。这种聚合物超级电容器可能会在成本和环境敏感领域得到应用。

title: Structure of Bifunctional Planar Micro Supercapacitor and Electrochromic by Screen Printing Technology
abstract: A planar micro-supercapacitor(MSC) has characteristics between battery and capacitor. MSC sandwich structure’s limitation includes short circuit with two electrodes, electrodes should be loaded with as many active materials as possible to improve the energy storage capacity of the device, both of which will increase the ion transfer impedance, resulting in low power density. On the other hand, the sandwich structure is difficult to integrate into micro electronic devices. In recent years, the cross-fertilization of electrochromic technology with other fields has given rise to a variety of emerging smart devices and technologies by combining with supercapacitors, smart energy storage devices and smart windows. This paper focuses on hybrid of MSC and electrochromic device structure to verify bifunctional device structure by asymmetric interdigital electrodes. They require same hydrogel and electrode layer to enhance their performance, which are pursued with reduction in width, size, power consumption and price in the field of portable, etc. The material of Ag/Carbon/PVA/KCL/PEDOT:PSS(ACPKP)for new structure will be printed as to ensure device’s energy-storage and display. As expected, the micro-supercapacitor based on PET film can deliver areal capacitance up to 6.5 mF/cm2. Even if, micro-supercapacitor undergoes continuous 800 cycles, the performance of device can still remain nearly 79.4%. With printing technology, low cost, large area and green products demonstrate its great application in next-generation flexible electronics.
zh_title: 双功能平面微型超级电容器结构及丝网印刷技术电致变色
zh_abstract: 平面微型超级电容器（MSC）具有介于电池和电容器之间的特性。 MSC夹层结构的局限性包括两个电极短路，电极上应负载尽可能多的活性材料以提高器件的储能能力，这两者都会增加离子传输阻抗，导致功率密度低。另一方面，三明治结构难以集成到微电子器件中。近年来，电致变色技术与其他领域的交叉融合，与超级电容器、智能储能器件、智能窗等相结合，催生了多种新兴的智能器件和技术。本文重点研究MSC和电致变色器件结构的混合，通过不对称叉指电极验证双功能器件结构。它们需要相同的水凝胶和电极层来增强其性能，这是便携式等领域追求的宽度、尺寸、功耗和价格的降低。用于新结构的Ag/Carbon/PVA/KCL/PEDOT:PSS(ACPKP)材料将被印刷，以确保设备的能量存储和显示。正如预期的那样，基于 PET 薄膜的微型超级电容器可以提供高达 6.5 mF/cm2 的面积电容。即使微型超级电容器连续800次循环，器件的性能仍能保持近79.4%。凭借印刷技术，低成本、大面积、绿色环保的产品展示了其在下一代柔性电子产品中的巨大应用。

title: Ionic liquid integrated high-voltage polymer gel electrolyte to improve thecapacitance and cyclic stability of supercapacitors
abstract: With the rapidly increasing demand for the most promising electrical energy storage devices, supercapacitors (SCs) have attracted widespread interest due to their high capacity, specific power density and long cyclic performance. To date, symmetric electrodes made of various types of porous carbons such as activated carbon (AC), carbon nanofibers, carbon nanotubes (CNT), and graphene/reduced graphene oxide (rGO) are commonly used for commercial electrical double layer capacitors (EDLCs) or supercapacitors [1]. Electrolytes also play an important role for supercapacitor devices through their physical, thermal and electrochemical properties. Because of high ionic conductivity, simple processing, low cost and good interfacial (electrode/electrolyte) properties of aqueous electrolytes and organic liquid-based electrolytes have been widely used for SCs. However, lower voltage windows, lower cycle life, corrosion, leakage problem, flammability and safety issues limit their commercialization [2]. To address the above-mentioned issues, ionic liquids (ILs) integrated solid/semi-solid polymer electrolytes have attracted wide interest as an alternative electrolyte in electrochemical energy storage due to their wide potential windows (≥3V), high ionic conductivity (10−4Ω−1 cm−1 ), leakage free, low flammability, good thermal stability, flexibility, tunable chemical functionalities and self-healing capabilities [3,4]. Significant efforts have also been devoted to integrating various ionic liquids (ILs) into solid/semi-solid polymer electrolytes for emerging SCs. In this work, 1-Ethyl-3- …
zh_title: 离子液体集成高压聚合物凝胶电解质提高超级电容器电容和循环稳定性
zh_abstract: 随着对最有前途的电能存储设备的需求迅速增长，超级电容器（SC）因其高容量、比功率密度和长循环性能而引起了广泛的兴趣。迄今为止，由各种类型的多孔碳制成的对称电极，如活性炭（AC）、碳纳米纤维、碳纳米管（CNT）和石墨烯/还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）通常用于商业双电层电容器（EDLC）或超级电容器[1]。电解质还通过其物理、热和电化学特性对超级电容器装置发挥着重要作用。由于水性电解质和有机液体电解质具有高离子电导率、加工简单、成本低和良好的界面（电极/电解质）性能，已被广泛用于SC。然而，较低的电压窗口、较低的循环寿命、腐蚀、泄漏问题、可燃性和安全问题限制了它们的商业化[2]。为了解决上述问题，离子液体（IL）集成的固体/半固体聚合物电解质作为电化学储能的替代电解质，由于其宽电位窗（≥3V）、高离子电导率（10−4Ω−1 cm−1）、无泄漏、低可燃性、良好的热稳定性、灵活性、可调节的化学功能和自修复能力而引起了广泛的兴趣[3,4]。人们还致力于将各种离子液体（IL）集成到新兴 SC 的固体/半固体聚合物电解质中。在这项工作中，1-乙基-3-…

title: Synthesis of rGO/PANi/MnO<sub>2</sub> ternary nanocomposite used for supercapacitor electrode by 3D printing and electrodeposition techniques
journal: Vietnam Journal of Catalysis and Adsorption
institutions: Vietnam Academy of Science and Technology
Hanoi University of Science and Technology
abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) printing has emerged as a promising method for fabricating advanced electrode materials. In this study, a ternary nanocomposite film of reduced graphene oxide (rGO), polyaniline (PANi), and MnO2 nanoparticles was prepared by 3D printing and electrochemical deposition for high-performance supercapacitors. A printable GO/aniline ink (1:1 mass ratio) was printed and electrochemically treated in 0.1 M H2SO4: first reduced at –0.8 V for 30 s, then electropolymerized by cyclic voltammetry (–0.4 to +0.95 V). MnO₂ was subsequently electrodeposited at +0.6 V for 200 s in MnSO4/H2SO4/KCl solution. FE-SEM/EDX confirmed uniform MnO2 distribution (~2 wt%). Electrochemical tests in 1 M H2SO4 showed enhanced capacitance and stability, with the rGO/PANi/MnO2 electrode reaching 740 F/g at 1 A/g and retaining 97% capacitance after 5000 cycles at 15 A/g.
zh_title: 3D打印和电沉积技术合成超级电容器电极用rGO/PANi/MnO<sub>2</sub>三元纳米复合材料
zh_abstract: 三维（3D）打印已成为制造先进电极材料的一种有前途的方法。在这项研究中，通过3D打印和电化学沉积制备了还原氧化石墨烯（rGO）、聚苯胺（PANi）和MnO2纳米颗粒的三元纳米复合薄膜，用于高性能超级电容器。在 0.1 M H2SO4 中印刷可印刷的 GO/苯胺墨水（1:1 质量比）并进行电化学处理：首先在 –0.8 V 下还原 30 秒，然后通过循环伏安法（–0.4 至 +0.95 V）进行电聚合。随后将MnO 2 在MnSO4/H2SO4/KCl溶液中以+0.6V电沉积200秒。 FE-SEM/EDX 证实 MnO2 分布均匀（~2 wt%）。 1 M H2SO4 中的电化学测试显示电容和稳定性增强，rGO/PANi/MnO2 电极在 1 A/g 电流下达到 740 F/g，并在 15 A/g 电流下循环 5000 次后仍保留 97% 的电容。

title: Nickel-Loaded 3D-Printed Electrode for In Situ ElectrochemicalConversion to a Prussian Blue Analogue: Synthetic Parameter Optimizationfor Pseudocapacitor Applications
abstract: Developing cost-effective and scalable energy storage devices is critical for advancing sustainable technologies. This study presents the fabrication of a novel 3D-printed PLA/Gr/NiHCF electrode, leveraging the benefits of additive manufacturing and a systematic factorial design of experiments (DOE) approach. The motivation stems from the need for simplified production methods that deliver high-performance materials while reducing waste and energy consumption. The electrode was synthesized through a two-step process involving 3D printing of a PLA/graphite/nickel acetate (PLA/Gr/Ni) composite followed by electrochemical conversion of nickel hexacyanoferrate (NiHCF) particles. The factorial DOE methodology optimized the composition of the PLA/Gr matrix and the electrochemical deposition conditions, ensuring a robust process with reproducible outcomes. The structural and electrochemical properties of the materials were evaluated using FTIR, Raman, SEM, EDS, CV, and EIS. The PLA/Gr/NiHCF electrode exhibited outstanding electrochemical performance, with a specific capacitance (C<sub>s</sub>) of 37.33 mF cm<sup>–2</sup> at 0.1 mA cm<sup>–2</sup> in a three-electrode system, significantly outperforming the control PLA/Gr electrode (0.58 mF cm<sup>–2</sup>). In a two-electrode symmetrical configuration, the system delivered a C<sub>s</sub> of 40.4 mF cm<sup>–2</sup> at 0.1 mA cm<sup>–2</sup>, with excellent retention (95% over 100 cycles) and reversible Coulombic efficiency (98.3%). The electrode’s pseudocapacitive behavior, driven by the surface-confined redox activity of NiHCF, w …
zh_title: 用于原位电化学转化为普鲁士蓝类似物的负载镍 3D 打印电极：赝电容器应用的合成参数优化
zh_abstract: 开发具有成本效益且可扩展的储能设备对于推进可持续技术至关重要。本研究展示了一种新型 3D 打印 PLA/Gr/NiHCF 电极的制造，利用增材制造和系统因子实验设计 (DOE) 方法的优势。其动机源于对简化生产方法的需求，以提供高性能材料，同时减少浪费和能源消耗。该电极通过两步过程合成，包括 3D 打印 PLA/石墨/醋酸镍 (PLA/Gr/Ni) 复合材料，然后对六氰基铁酸镍 (NiHCF) 颗粒进行电化学转化。阶乘 DOE 方法优化了 PLA/Gr 基质的成分和电化学沉积条件，确保了稳健的过程和可重复的结果。使用 FTIR、拉曼、SEM、EDS、CV 和 EIS 评估材料的结构和电化学性能。 PLA/Gr/NiHCF 电极表现出出色的电化学性能，在三电极系统中，0.1 mA cm-2 下的比电容 (Cs) 为 37.33 mF cm-2，显着优于对照 PLA/Gr 电极 (0.58 mF cm-2)。在两电极对称配置中，该系统在 0.1 mA cm–2 电流下的 Cs 为 40.4 mF cm–2，具有出色的保留率（100 个循环后为 95%）和可逆库仑效率（98.3%）。电极的赝电容行为由 NiHCF 的表面限制氧化还原活性驱动，w …

title: Fluorinated Carbon Nanofibrous Aerogel Electrode Material Derived from Hydrofluoric Acid Treatment on Stabilized Polyacrylonitrile for High-Performance Supercapacitors
institutions: North Carolina Agricultural and Technical State University
abstract: Carbon nanofibrous materials from electrospinning are good candidate electrode materials for supercapacitor applications due to their straightforward processability, chemical stability, high porosity, and large surface area. In this research, a straightforward and effective way was revealed to significantly enhance the electrochemical performance of carbon nanofibrous electrode material from electrospinning of polyacrylonitrile (PAN). Fluorination of the electrospun carbon nanofibers (ECNF) was studied by comparing two types of hydrofluoric acid (HF) treatment, i.e., direct HF acid treatment on ECNF (Type I) vs. HF acid treatment on the stabilized PAN (Type II) followed by carbonization. The latter was found to be an advantageous way to introduce C-F bonds in the resultant carbon nanofibrous electrode material that contributed to pseudocapacitance. Furthermore, the Type II HF acid treatment demonstrated exciting synergistic effects with ECNF aerogel formation on carbon structure and porosity development and generated a superior fluorinated electrospun carbon nanofibrous aerogel (ECNA-F) electrode material for supercapacitor uses. The resultant ECNA-F electrode material demonstrated excellent electrochemical performance with great cyclic stability due to the large improvements in both pseudocapacitance and electrical double-layer capacitance. ECNA-F achieved a specific capacitance of 372 F/g at a current density of 0.5 A/g with 1 M H2SO4 electrolyte, and the device with ECNA-F and 1 M Na2SO4 electrolyte possessed an energy density of 29.1 Wh/kg at a power density of 275 W/kg …
zh_title: 用于高性能超级电容器的稳定聚丙烯腈氢氟酸处理氟化碳纳米纤维气凝胶电极材料
zh_abstract: 静电纺丝碳纳米纤维材料由于其简单的可加工性、化学稳定性、高孔隙率和大表面积，是超级电容器应用的良好候选电极材料。在这项研究中，揭示了一种直接有效的方法，可以显着提高聚丙烯腈（PAN）静电纺丝碳纳米纤维电极材料的电化学性能。通过比较两种类型的氢氟酸 (HF) 处理，即直接对 ECNF 进行 HF 酸处理（I 型）与对稳定 PAN（II 型）进行 HF 酸处理然后碳化，研究了电纺碳纳米纤维 (ECNF) 的氟化。后者被认为是在所得碳纳米纤维电极材料中引入 C-F 键的有利方式，从而有助于赝电容。此外，II 型 HF 酸处理与 ECNF 气凝胶形成对碳结构和孔隙率发展表现出令人兴奋的协同效应，并产生了用于超级电容器用途的优质氟化电纺碳纳米纤维气凝胶 (ECNA-F) 电极材料。由于赝电容和双电层电容的大幅改善，所得的 ECNA-F 电极材料表现出优异的电化学性能和良好的循环稳定性。 ECNA-F 使用 1 M H2SO4 电解质在 0.5 A/g 的电流密度下实现了 372 F/g 的比电容，使用 ECNA-F 和 1 M Na2SO4 电解质的器件在功率密度为 275 W/kg 时拥有 29.1 Wh/kg 的能量密度……

title: Ti3C2Tx MXene reinforcement: a nickel–vanadium selenide/MXene based multi-component composite as a battery-type electrode for supercapacitor applications†
journal: Iowa State University Digital Repository (Iowa State University)
abstract: Designing innovative microstructures and implementing efficient multicomponent strategies are still challenging to achieve high-performance and chemo-mechanically stable electrode materials. Herein, a hierarchical three-dimensional (3D) graphene oxide (GO) assisted Ti3C2Tx MXene aerogel foam (MXene-GAF) impregnated with battery-type bimetallic nickel vanadium selenide (NiVSe) has been prepared through a hydrothermal method followed by freeze-drying (denoted as NiVSe–MXene-GAF). 3D-oriented cellular pore networks benefit the energy storage process through the effective lodging of NiVSe particles, improving the access of the electrolyte to the active sites, and alleviating volume changes during redox reactions. The 3D MXene-GAF conductive matrix and heterostructured interface of MXene–rGO and NiVSe facilitated the rapid transport of electrical charges and ions during the charge–discharge process. As a result of the synergism of these effects, NiVSe–MXene-GAF exhibited remarkable electrochemical performance with a specific capacity of 305.8 mA h g−1 at 1 A g−1 and 99.2% initial coulombic efficiency. The NiVSe–MXene-GAF electrode delivered a specific capacity of 235.1 mA h g−1 even at a high current density of 12 A g−1 with a 76.8% rate performance. The impedance measurements indicated a low bulk solution resistance (Rs = 0.71 Ω) for NiVSe–MXene-GAF. Furthermore, the structural robustness of NiVSe–MXene-GAF guaranteed long-term stability with a 91.7% capacity retention for successive 7000 cycles. Thus, developing NiVSe–MXene-GAF provides a progressive strategy for fabricating h …
zh_title: Ti3C2Tx MXene 增强材料：镍钒硒化物/MXene 基多组分复合材料，作为超级电容器应用的电池型电极†
zh_abstract: 设计创新的微观结构和实施有效的多组分策略仍然是实现高性能和化学机械稳定的电极材料的挑战。在此，通过水热法和冷冻干燥制备了一种分层三维（3D）氧化石墨烯（GO）辅助的Ti3C2TX MXene气凝胶泡沫（MXene-GAF），其浸渍有电池型双金属镍钒硒化物（NiVSe）（表示为NiVSe-MXene-GAF）。 3D 导向的细胞孔隙网络通过有效容纳 NiVSe 颗粒、改善电解质与活性位点的接触以及减轻氧化还原反应期间的体积变化，有利于能量存储过程。 3D MXene-GAF 导电基质以及 MXene-rGO 和 NiVSe 的异质结构界面促进了充放电过程中电荷和离子的快速传输。由于这些效应的协同作用，NiVSe-MXene-GAF表现出卓越的电化学性能，在1 A g−1时比容量为305.8 mA h g−1，初始库仑效率为99.2%。即使在 12 A g−1 的高电流密度下，NiVSe-MXene-GAF 电极也能提供 235.1 mA h g−1 的比容量和 76.8% 的倍率性能。阻抗测量表明 NiVSe-MXene-GAF 具有较低的本体溶液电阻 (Rs = 0.71 Ω)。此外，NiVSe-MXene-GAF 的结构坚固性保证了长期稳定性，连续 7000 次循环后容量保持率为 91.7%。因此，开发 NiVSe-MXene-GAF 为制造 h 提供了一种渐进策略……

title: Facile synthesis of triple‐network organo‐hydrogel for all‐temperature flexible supercapacitors
abstract: Abstract A new triple‐network organo‐hydrogel with high anti‐freezing and thermally‐stable performance is prepared for application in all‐temperature flexible supercapacitor. It is composed of boric acid/graphene/polyvinyl alcohol matrix and H 2 SO 4 /dimethyl sulfoxide mixing solution. The incorporation of graphene and boric acid into polymer matrix can improve thermal stability and ionic conductivity of organo‐hydrogel. The H 2 SO 4 and dimethyl sulfoxide are key roles for improving anti‐freezing of organo‐hydrogel. The organo‐hydrogel exhibits high ionic conductivity of 1.6 and 3.1 S/m at −80 and 90°C, respectively. As a result, the assembled supercapacitor delivers a high capacitance retention of 84.5% and 113.3% at ultra‐low temperature (−80.0°C) and high temperature (90.0°C), respectively. The work provides a new route to design and prepare flexible supercapacitor with wide temperature range.
zh_title: 用于全温柔性超级电容器的三网络有机水凝胶的简便合成
zh_abstract: 摘要 制备了一种具有高抗冻性和热稳定性能的新型三网络有机水凝胶，用于全温柔性超级电容器。它由硼酸/石墨烯/聚乙烯醇基质和H 2 SO 4 /二甲亚砜混合溶液组成。将石墨烯和硼酸掺入聚合物基质中可以提高有机水凝胶的热稳定性和离子电导率。 H 2 SO 4 和二甲基亚砜在提高有机水凝胶的抗冻性方面发挥着关键作用。有机水凝胶在-80°C和90°C下分别表现出1.6和3.1 S/m的高离子电导率。因此，组装的超级电容器在超低温（-80.0°C）和高温（90.0°C）下分别具有84.5%和113.3%的高电容保持率。该工作为设计和制备宽温度范围柔性超级电容器提供了新途径。

title: Integration of Polymorphic CoxSey on MXene-Incorporated Self-Templated Three-Dimensional Graphene Foam to Augment Supercapacitor Performance through Componential and Structural Modifications
journal: Iowa State University Digital Repository (Iowa State University)
abstract: Transition metal selenides (TMSes) possess rich redox chemistry and, consequently, are potential candidates for supercapacitor applications. Unfortunately, the actual capacitance behavior of TMSes is generally lower than the theoretical value due to a small number of exposed active sites, sluggish charge transfer, and inferior ion diffusivity. Moreover, the dramatic volume changes during the charge/discharge process adversely affects the stability of active materials. Herein, polymorphic CoxSey (Co0.85Se and CoSe2) have been synthesized and integrated into Ti3C2Tx MXene flake reinforced three-dimensional (3D) rGO foam (denoted as CoxSey@TC/rGOF) through a self-templating hydrothermal method. The well-constructed foam-like architecture with 3D buildup of Ti3C2Tx MXene and rGO sheets provides fast ion/mass transport to a large number of accessible active sites of spatially arranged CoxSey in three dimensions, decreases ion diffusion distance, and provides an additional carbon content that enables capacitive characteristics. The structural advantages and intercomponent synergy lead to a superior charge storage performance for CoxSey@TC/rGOF. Accordingly, CoxSey@TC/rGOF delivers high specific capacities of 243.1 mAh g–1 at 1 A g–1 and 178 mAh g–1 at 12 A g–1, greater than its counterparts, i.e., CoxSey@rGOF (147.2 mAh g–1 at 1 A g–1) and CoxSey (79.4 mAh g–1 at 1 A g–1). The specific capacity and Coulombic efficiency for CoxSey@TC/rGOF retain 91.3 and 93.8% of their initial value after 5000 charge/discharge cycles, respectively. zh_title: 将多晶型 CoxSey 集成到 MXene 自模板化三维石墨烯泡沫上，通过成分和结构修改来增强超级电容器性能

title: MOFs-derived 3D porous ZnCo2O4 nanocubes intercalated 3D graphene electrode for Superior lifespan hybrid supercapacitors.
abstract: Despite the escalating energy crisis and mounting environmental concerns, it is evident that conventional energy storage can no longer fulfil the demands of modern society. Consequently, supercapacitors have gained significant popularity as energy storage devices owing to their outstanding efficiency. Nevertheless, the limited energy density of this substance restricts its potential applications. Herein, the robust and controllable design of ultra-porous zinc cobaltite nanocubes (ZnCo2O4 Nc) is successfully fabricated using a MOFs-templated approach. The ZnCo2O4 Nc is interconnected with 3D graphene nanosheets (ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr) as electrodes for hybrid storage devices. However, the (ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr) nanocomposite electrode exhibits better specific capacity/capacitance of (824.4 C/g, 1374 F/g) at a current density of 1 A /g compared to pristine ZnCo2O4 Nc (567 C/g, 954 F/g). For Full cell device configuration, the designed hybrid supercapacitor (HSC) is constructed using ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr (positive) and 3DGr (negative) electrodes. The constructed ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr //3DGr hybrid device delivers a maximum energy density of 60 Wh/kg with a power density of 800 W/kg and ultralong lifetime with a minimum ~7% capacitance loss up to 11,000 cycles.
zh_title: MOF 衍生的 3D 多孔 ZnCo2O4 纳米立方体插层 3D 石墨烯电极，用于超长寿命混合超级电容器。
zh_abstract: 尽管能源危机不断升级，环境问题日益严重，但传统储能显然已无法满足现代社会的需求。因此，超级电容器因其出色的效率而作为储能设备而受到广泛欢迎。然而，这种物质有限的能量密度限制了其潜在的应用。在此，使用 MOF 模板方法成功制造了超多孔钴酸锌纳米立方体 (ZnCo2O4 Nc) 的稳健且可控的设计。 ZnCo2O4 Nc 与 3D 石墨烯纳米片 (ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr) 互连，作为混合存储设备的电极。然而，与原始ZnCo2O4 Nc（567 C/g，954 F/g）相比，（ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr）纳米复合电极在1 A /g的电流密度下表现出更好的比容量/电容（824.4 C/g，1374 F/g）。对于全电池器件配置，设计的混合超级电容器 (HSC) 使用 ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr（正极）和 3DGr（负极）电极构建。所构建的 ZnCo2O4 Nc@3DGr //3DGr 混合器件可提供 60 Wh/kg 的最大能量密度和 800 W/kg 的功率密度，以及超长的使用寿命，在高达 11,000 次循环时电容损失至少约为 7%。

title: Mg-doped NiCoP microflower grown on Ni foam for high-capacity supercapacitor electrode
journal: The European Physical Journal Applied Physics
abstract: In this work, a binder-free electrode Mg-doped NiCoP/Ni foam (MNCP- x /NF) was prepared via hydrothermal and phosphorization process, in which echinoid microflower-like MNCP- x was densely loaded on the NF skeleton. By regulating the Mg 2+ doping amount, remarkable enhancements in the morphology, mass-loading of MNCP, electrode conductivity and overall electrochemical capacitive properties of MNCP- x /NF have been achieved. Particularly, moderate doped MNCP-0.5/NF exhibits the best energy storage performances with a superior specific capacity (4461 mC cm −2 @ 2 mA cm −2 ), acceptable rate capability (retaining 50.1% @ 50 mA cm −2 ), and striking cyclability (retaining 83% over 5000 cycles). Moreover, a solid-state asymmetric supercapacitor constructed with MNCP-0.5/NF as cathode, graphene hydrogel/NF (GH/NF) as anode, PVA/KOH gel as electrolyte, outputs the notable energy density of 39.8 Wh kg −1 (1.8 mWh cm −3 ) and power density of 16674 W kg −1 (750 mW cm −3 ), companied by a superior cyclability (retaining 87% over 5000 cycles).
zh_title: 泡沫镍上生长的镁掺杂 NiCoP 微花用于高容量超级电容器电极
zh_abstract: 本工作通过水热磷化工艺制备了无粘结剂镁掺杂NiCoP/Ni泡沫电极（MNCP-x/NF），其中海胆状微花状MNCP-x致密负载在NF骨架上。通过调节Mg 2+ 掺杂量，MNCP的形貌、质量负载、电极电导率和MNCP- x /NF的整体电化学电容性能得到显着增强。特别是，中等掺杂的MNCP-0.5/NF表现出最佳的储能性能，具有优异的比容量（4461 mC cm -2 @ 2 mA cm -2 ）、可接受的倍率性能（保留50.1％@ 50 mA cm -2 ）和惊人的循环性能（超过5000次循环保留83％）。此外，以MNCP-0.5/NF为阴极、石墨烯水凝胶/NF（GH/NF）为阳极、PVA/KOH凝胶为电解质构建的固态不对称超级电容器输出显着的能量密度为39.8 Wh kg -1 (1.8 mWh cm -3 )和功率密度为16674 W kg -1 (750 mW cm -3 )，并具有优异的循环性能（保留5000 次循环后为 87%）。
